name: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands Beginner
tags: Knee Down Revolved Side Angle Pose
How to do Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands Beginner
How To Do A Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands Beginner
instructions: Begin in a low lunge position with your right foot forward and your left knee on the ground.
Bring your hands together in a prayer position at your heart.
Exhale and twist your torso to the right, placing your left elbow on the outside of your right knee.
Hold for several breaths and then repeat on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Cross Body Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand with a shoulder width stance holding one dumbbell. Push your butt back while leaving your knees MOSTLY extended.
Reach toward the opposing leg. You should feel a stretch in your hamstrings. When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward to complete the rep.
Do not push your hips all the way forward. This will hyperextend your spine. Just go to a normal standing position.

name: Hamstrings Stretch Variation Three
tags: How to do Hamstrings Stretch Variation Three
How To Do A Hamstrings Stretch Variation Three
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg outstretched and the other bent at the knee, foot resting on the opposite inner thigh.
Reach forward to touch the toes of the outstretched leg.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then return to starting position.

name: Landmine Seated Alternating Overhead Press
tags: How To Do A Landmine Seated Alternating Overhead Press
How to do Landmine Seated Alternating Overhead Press
instructions: Start sitting on the ground facing the landmine attachment with your legs open for stability while holding the end of the bar in a neutral grip with your hand resting at your shoulder and your elbow beneath your wrist.

Leaning forward slightly, press the bar up into the air until your arm is fully extended. At the top of the movement, switch which hand is holding the end of the bar and lower the bar back down to the opposite shoulder. Perform again to return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Machine Seated Calf Raises
tags: How to do Machine Seated Calf Raises
How To Do A Machine Seated Calf Raises
instructions: Get comfortable on the machine, then place your lower thighs beneath the padded lever. Place your toes and the balls of your feet onto the foot supports.
Prevent the weight from slipping forward by gripping the handles, and release the safety bar. Lower the weight until your calves are extended.
Push your heels up to lift the padded lever and hold the contracted position, then slowly lower back down to the starting position. Repeat.

name: Cable Bar Reverse Grip Curl
instructions: Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm down. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
instructions: Hold one dumbbell in front rack position and place opposite foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up while keeping chest tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Lat And Shoulder External Rotation Stretch 2 Kneeling Dowel
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench, placing your elbows on with palms facing up while holding the dowel at shoulder width.
Sit your hips back onto your heels, pressing the head in between the arms.
You should feel a stretch in your lats, triceps and deep in the shoulder joint.
You can add movement (bend-extended arms) to mobilise the shoulder joint.

name: Burpee
instructions: Start standing with your feet hip-width apart. Lower your body into a squat position, placing your hands on the ground in front of you.
Quickly jump your feet back into a plank position, keeping your body in a straight line from your head to your toes.
Perform a push-up, keeping your core tight and your elbows close to your body.
Jump your feet back towards your hands, and then jump up into the air, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and immediately lower your body back into the squat position to repeat the movement.

name: Barbell Reverse Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar with a reverse grip.
Lower the bar to your lower chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Bosu Ball Reverse Lunge
tags: How To Do A Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand on Bosu, step backward into a lunge.
Bend knees, lower until the front thigh is parallel.
Push off the back foot, return to starting position.

name: Plate Clean
tags: How To Do A Plate Clean
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the feet.
Bend the knees and hips to pick up the plate, keeping the back straight and core engaged.
Stand up while pulling the plate towards the chest.
Keep shoulder level while keeping the elbows high and in front of the plate.

name: Calf Raises
tags: How To Do A Calf Raises
instructions: Balance on the balls of your feet on the platform or plates, leaning forward to use the wall to assist with balance.
Lower the heels of your feet towards the ground and pause, then push through the balls of your feet like you are standing tip toe, pausing at the apex of the motion.
Repeat as necessary.

name: Child Pose Arms Extended Left Right
tags: How To Do A Child Pose Arms Extended Left Right
How to do Child Pose Arms Extended Left Right
instructions: Begin in a tabletop position with your hands and knees on the ground.
Sit back onto your heels and extend your arms out in front of you to one side.
Rest your forehead on the ground.
Hold for a few breaths and then repeat on the other side.

name: Landmine Lunge
tags: How To Do A Landmine Lunge
instructions: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet hip-width apart and your back straight. Grasp the landmine barbell with one hand, holding it at at your side with your palm facing in towards your leg.

Take a step backward with your foot on the same side that you're holding the barbell, lowering your body into a lunge position. Bend both knees to lower your body down until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, or as low as your flexibility allows. Keep your torso upright, your chest lifted, and your core engaged throughout the movement.
Push through the heel of your front foot to return to the starting position. Repeat for desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Pigeon Pose
tags: How To Do A Pigeon Pose
instructions: Extend your right leg behind you and place your right ankle on top of your left thigh, with your right knee pointing out to the side.
Sitting up straight, use your hands to gently press down on your right knee while at the same time pulling your left buttock back.
Hold for 5-10 deep breaths, then release and repeat on the other side.

name: Bosu Ball Half Burpee
tags: How To Do A Half Burpee
instructions: Stand on Bosu with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into squat position and place hands on Bosu.
Jump feet back to plank, then jump back to squat.

name: Quads Stretch Variation Four
tags: How To Do A Quads Stretch Variation Four
How to do Quads Stretch Variation Four
instructions: Lay flat on your belly. Extend one arm out in front of you, placing your palm on the floor. With your other arm, grab the top of your foot.
Keeping your upper leg flat on the floor, pull your foot towards your buttocks to engage the stretch.
Pause for a few seconds, and then repeat the stretch with your other leg.

name: Standing Knee Raise Hold
instructions: Stand up straight and with a good posture.
Shift your weight onto the supporting leg while driving the other knee.
Your thigh should be parallel to the ground.

name: Plate Forward Lunge
tags: How to do Plate Forward Lunge
How To Do A Plate Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the plate held in front of the torso.
Take a step forward with one foot, bending the front knee to lower the hips into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side by stepping forward with the other foot.

name: Towel Knee Extension
instructions: Sit on the floor and use your palms to lean back into.
Place a rolled towel under your knee so it is slightly bent.
Try to squeeze the towel between the back of your knee and the ground by extending the leg.

name: Dumbbell Swing Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width. Dumbbells at your side.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.

name: Kettlebell Staggered Waiters Bow
instructions: Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
How to do Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand tall with a single dumbbell extended overhead.
Flex at the elbow letting the dumbbell travel behind your body.
Try not to let your elbow flare outward.

name: Medicine Ball Russian Twist
tags: How To Do A Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent, feet off ground.
Twist torso side to side, touching medicine ball to ground.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Clean And Press
instructions: Hold dumbbell between legs, hinge slightly, and pull explosively to shoulder.
Catch dumbbell at shoulder height with knees slightly bent.
Press overhead until arm fully extends, then lower under control.

name: Hamstring Bridge With Elevated Legs Box Unilateral
instructions: Lie on your back. Place one heel on a box or bench, having a 90° angle at hip and knee.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back against the ground).
Push through your heel into the box, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees.

name: Cable Rope Overhead Tricep Extension
tags: How to do Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
How To Do A Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: You can use any attachment. The cable should be all the way to the bottom of the machine. Face away from the machine.
Point your elbows straight up toward the ceiling.
From there, extend your elbows until your fists are pointed straight toward the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Pulse Squat
tags: How to do Dumbbell Goblet Pulse Squat
How To Do A Dumbbell Goblet Pulse Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in goblet position.
Squat down to parallel depth and then halfway back up.
Stay in this short range of motion for the duration of the set.

name: Cardio Sprint In Place
instructions: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, ready to move.
Quickly drive knees up towards chest, alternating legs, pumping arms in rhythm.
Gradually speed up, maintaining high knees and arm movement, breathe steadily.

name: Bodyweight Close Grip Inverted Curl
instructions: Grab the bar with a close grip. Feet on the floor.
Break at the elbow and curl your body toward the bar.

name: Barbell Block Conventional Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your mid-foot under the bar, plates should be on blocks, and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
Stand to your full height and hold.
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.

name: Cable Overhead Tricep Press
instructions: You can use any attachment. The cable should be even with your mid-back. Face away from the machine.
Point your elbows straight forward. Press the weight straight toward the ceiling.
As you return to the start, push your elbows forward. Try to touch your biceps to your forearms at the bottom of each rep.

name: Lower Back Extensions 2
instructions: Lie on your front leaning your forehead on the back of your palms.
Squeeze your glutes and tilt your hips backwards (flattens the front of your hips against the ground).
Raise your chest off the ground and lower it without resting on the ground before the next rep

name: Dorsal Flexion Hold
instructions: From the standing position, raise your toes and balance on your heels for the given duration.
Maintain a good upper body form.

name: Band Tricep Kickback
instructions: Anchor the band to a stable point.
Hinge forward. Extend and flex at the elbow.

name: Bosu Ball Row
instructions: Hold bosu and hinge forward.
Pull bosu towards chest, squeezing shoulder blades.

name: Barbell Figure Four Hip Thrust
instructions: Put your shoulder blades on a bench and cross one leg over the other.
Start with your hips up.
Drop your hips and then push your hips up toward the ceiling.

name: Bosu Serratus Activation Plank
instructions: Support your weight with your forearms on the bosu and toes on the floor (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.

name: Split Squat
tags: How To Do A Split Squat
instructions: Take a split stance. Make sure to keep your chest tall.
Bring your rear knee to the floor or close to it.
Drive through your front heel and your rear foot back to the starting position.

name: Cable Seated Single Arm Face Pull
instructions: Sit facing cable and hold handle with arm extended at shoulder height.
Pull handle toward upper face while driving elbow outward and back.
Squeeze rear delt, then return slowly, maintaining control.

name: Band Bayesian Curl
tags: How to do Band Bayesian Curl
How To Do A Band Bayesian Curl
instructions: Attach band to a low anchor point. Point your palms straight forward.
Flex your elbow until you feel your biceps contract. Then fully extend elbows.

name: Bosu Ball Pike Pushup
tags: How To Do A Pike Pushup
instructions: Place feet on Bosu, hips high, hands on the floor.
Lower the head towards the ground, then push back up.
Keep legs straight and hips elevated throughout.

name: Dumbbell Laying Incline Row
tags: How to do Dumbbell Laying Incline Row
How To Do A Dumbbell Laying Incline Row
instructions: Lay on an incline bench that is between 30-45 degrees high.
Let your arms hang freely. Pull your elbows straight back toward the ceiling.

name: Hand Side Plank Reach Through
instructions: Start in a side plank position.
Reach your top arm under your body.
Return to the plank position.

name: Cardio Band Reverse Fly Jacks
instructions: Grab the band with a double overhand grip. Bring both feet outward while performing a little hop.
As you hop, pull the band apart.

name: Band Glute Kickback
tags: How to do Band Glute Kickback
How To Do A Band Glute Kickback
instructions: Get into a quadruped position. Loop the band around both of your wrists and one of your feet.
Extend your knee and hip straight back until you feel like contraction in the glutes.
Flex at the knee until back in the starting position.

name: Half Monkey Pose
tags: How to do Half Monkey Pose
How To Do A Half Monkey Pose
instructions: Start in a tabletop position with your hands and knees on the floor.
Step your right foot forward, placing it between your hands.
Straighten your right leg and flex your toes towards your face, keeping your hands on the floor for support.
Hold for several breaths, then switch sides and repeat.

name: Glute Hip Rotator Stretch Supine
instructions: Lie on your back with bent knees and feet on the floor.
Cross the ankle of your one leg over the knee of the other.
Reach in between your legs, grabbing the thigh of the leg that is still on the ground.
Pull that leg towards your chest.

name: Barbell Spoto Press
tags: How to do Barbell Spoto Press
How To Do A Barbell Spoto Press
instructions: Start on the bench with your shoulder blades pulled back.
As you initiate the first rep, tuck your elbows slightly until the bar is a few inches off your chest.
Pause just off your chest for 1-3 seconds. Then press explosively.

name: Bosu Ball Superman
instructions: Lie face down on Bosu, arms extended.
Lift arms, chest, and legs off the Bosu.
Hold for a moment, then lower back down.

name: Ez Bar Zercher Squat
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding the bar in the crook of your arms, near your belly. Your palms should be facing towards your body.
Sit back and lower your body down until your thighs are parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and stand back up to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Thruster
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your shoulders, with your palms facing inward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, dip your knees slightly and then quickly extend them as you press the dumbbells upwards.
As you press the dumbbells upwards, also push your hips forward to help generate additional power.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Cable Wood Chopper
tags: How to do Cable Wood Chopper
How To Do A Cable Wood Chopper
instructions: Set the cable at about nipple level. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Incline Twisting Curl
instructions: Sit on incline bench holding dumbbells at sides, palms facing inward.
Curl one dumbbell while twisting palm toward shoulder.
Lower slowly, then repeat with opposite arm.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Row
instructions: Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles.
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Cable Seated Bayesian Reverse Curl
instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine and sit on the bench. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Barbell Hang Clean And Press
instructions: Hold bar just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
Explosively pull bar to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press bar overhead until arms are fully extended.

name: Cable Zercher Good Morning
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding the bar in the crook of your elbows, with your palms facing towards your body.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and lower your torso forward until it is nearly parallel to the ground.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and raise your body back to the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Shoulder Extension
tags: How to do Kettlebell Shoulder Extension
How To Do A Kettlebell Shoulder Extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart bending forward at the hips as far as comfortable. Place off-hand on the same side thigh for stability.
Hold the kettlebell in one hand, straight armed and pointing towards the floor.
Keeping your arm straight, swing the kettlebell behind you as far as comfortable.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Laying Alternating Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back, arms by sides, legs straight.
Lift one leg to a 45-degree angle.
Lower leg, lift opposite leg; alternate smoothly.

name: Bodyweight Staggered Waiters Bow
instructions: Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

name: Kettlebell Box Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart with a kettlebell in a goblet position.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Floor Fly
instructions: Lie on your back holding one dumbbell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arm out wide until elbow lightly touches the floor.
Bring dumbbell back over chest, squeezing pec at the top.

name: L Sit Chin Up
instructions: Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you)
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

name: Machine Horizontal Leg Press Calf Jump
instructions: Start with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Shift your weight onto the balls of your feet and raise stay flat footed. Using your calf muscles, mimic a jumping motion but don't leave the platform.
Explode onto your toes and hold for a second.

name: Medicine Ball Hollow Hold
tags: How To Do A Hollow Hold
instructions: Lie on your back, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the ground, engaging core.
Hold the position while maintaining stability.

name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Arnold Press
How to do Dumbbell Arnold Press
instructions: Stand with both palms facing you.
Begin to press the dumbbells to the ceiling while rotating your palms.
When you reach elbow extension, your palms should be facing forward.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Floor Fly
instructions: Lie on your back holding dumbbells above chest with palms turned downward.
Lower arms out wide while maintaining internal rotation and slight elbow bend.
Bring dumbbells back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.

name: Curtsy Lunge
tags: How To Do A Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Step your left foot diagonally behind your right leg, crossing it behind your body. Bend your knees and lower your hips until your left thigh is parallel to the floor and your right knee is hovering just above the ground.
Push through your right foot to straighten your legs and return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your other leg.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Step Up Knee Drive
instructions: Hold one kettlebell at your side and place opposite foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and core tight.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Cable Single Arm Rolling Pushdown
instructions: Stand facing cable holding handle with palm down, elbow bent, and shoulder flexed.
First extend your shoulder (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbow.

name: Treadmill Sprint
instructions: Get the treadmill up to a speed where you are doing a sprint.

name: Barbell Pronated Pendlay Row
tags: How to do Barbell Pronated Pendlay Row
How To Do A Barbell Pronated Pendlay Row
instructions: Start hinged forward with a flat back and the plates resting on the floor. Make sure your elbows are fully extended.
Pull the bar to your sternum.
Return the plates back to the floor and let the bar come to a full dead stop.
Then initiate the next rep.

name: Landmine Lunge To Overhead Press
tags: How To Do A Landmine Lunge To Overhead Press
How to do Landmine Lunge To Overhead Press
instructions: Stand facing the landmine attachment while holding the end of the bar with one hand at your shoulder on the same side with your elbow tucked to your body underneath your wrist.

Step back with the leg on the same side that you are holding the bar on and with control lower yourself down into a lunge position while keeping your core engaged and torso tall, then drive through your front heel as you step back to the starting position.
Once your feet are back in the starting position, drive the bar up overhead until your arm is fully extended, then lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeated for the desired number of reps, then switch sides.

name: Cable Row Bar Kneeling Crunch
tags: How to do Cable Kneeling Crunch
How To Do A Cable Kneeling Crunch
instructions: Use a double handle attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward then fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.

name: Ring Standing Archer Pushup
instructions: Position rings shoulder-width apart, grasp handles, extend legs behind.
Lower chest to rings, bend one elbow, while extending your other arm out to the side. Push yourself back to the start.
Then switch arms and repeat.

name: Adductor Stretch Dynamic Unilateral 4 Point Position
instructions: From the 4 point position (all fours), extend one leg to the side, placing the foot on the ground.
Start rocking your hips back and forth.
You should feel your adductors and hip joint being stretched.
Try to maintain a neutral spine

name: Barbell Power Snatch
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell over midfoot. Grip the bar wide (outside shoulders), hook grip recommended.
Keep chest up, back straight, and drive through heels to lift the bar off the ground, keeping it close to your body.
As the bar reaches mid-thigh, explode upwards by extending hips, knees, and ankles, shrugging shoulders and pulling the bar high.
Drop under the bar slightly, catching it overhead with arms locked out. Stand up fully to complete the lift.

name: Barbell Banded Back Squat
instructions: Loop resistance bands under your feet and around the barbell. Stand shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core, push hips back, and lower until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels, extend hips and knees, and return to standing tall.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Hang Clean And Jerk
instructions: Hold kettlebell in one hand at thigh level with slight knee bend.
Pull kettlebell explosively to shoulder, catching it in rack position.
Dip slightly, then drive upward to press kettlebell overhead.

name: Band Spanish Squat
tags: How To Do A Band Spanish Squat
How to do Band Spanish Squat
instructions: Anchor a band to a stable point.
Place the loops of the band behind your knees.
Perform a normal squat and extend your knees against the band at the top.

name: Happy Baby
tags: How To Do A Happy Baby
instructions: Lie down on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Lift your feet off the floor and bring your knees towards your chest.
Reach inside your knees and hold onto the outside edges of your feet.
Gently pull your knees towards your armpits and rock side to side for a few breaths.

name: Machine Overhand Row
instructions: Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles with palms facing down, keeping your back straight.
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Half Neck Rolls
tags: How To Do A Half Neck Rolls
How to do Half Neck Rolls
instructions: Sit cross-legged on the floor and interlace your fingers behind your head.
Drop your chin to your chest and roll your head to the right, bringing your right ear towards your right shoulder.
Slowly roll your head back to center, then over to the left so that your left ear is close to your left shoulder.
Repeat the movement from side to side, keeping your shoulders relaxed and breathing deeply.

name: Barbell Front Rack Step Up
tags: How To Do A Barbell Front Rack Step Up
How to do Barbell Front Rack Step Up
instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell at your shoulders with an overhand grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.

name: Adductor Stretch Seated Bilateral Static
instructions: Sit against a wall and bring your feet together, letting the knees spread
Once you reach the end of your range, allow gravity to do the work
If you feel that gravity isn't enough, you can apply gentle downward pressure on your knees with your palms
Try to maintain a straight back while performing the exercise

name: I's Prone
instructions: Lie on your front with your arms extended and above your head.
Point the thumbs up.
Try to raise your arms off the ground keeping them straight.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand tall, holding kettlebells by your sides, feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one leg, lowering until both knees form 90° angles.
Push through front foot, return to start, and switch legs.

name: Seated Doming
instructions: Sit on a bench or box. Press the big toe into the ground till you feel the inside part of your foot raise off the ground
The arch of your foot should now look more pronounced. Do not roll your foot out to lift the inside part of your foot
You should perform the exercise bare foot or with socks, but do not wear shoes.

name: Dumbbell Larsen Press
instructions: Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding dumbbells above chest.
Lower dumbbells toward chest while keeping legs elevated and torso stable.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without arching lower back.

name: Dumbbell Spinal Jefferson Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells in front of thighs with straight arms.
Slowly roll down through spine, reaching dumbbells toward feet.
Reverse motion, rolling back up one vertebra at a time.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Thruster
instructions: Hold dumbbell at shoulder height with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing dumbbell overhead in one motion.
Lower dumbbell as you descend into next rep smoothly.

name: Band Overhead Press
tags: How To Do A Band Overhead Press
How to do Band Overhead Press
instructions: Stand between the two anchored bands, grasp them with an overhand grip, and position the bands at shoulder level.
Brace your core and push the bands overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the bands back to shoulder level, keeping your core engaged and arms straight. Repeat for desired number of reps.

name: Bosu Ball Hand Sideplank Hip Abduction
tags: How To Do A Hand Sideplank Hip Abduction
How to do Hand Sideplank Hip Abduction
instructions: Start in a side plank with hand on Bosu.
Lift the top leg while keeping the body stable.
Lower the leg back down.

name: Landmine Lying Tricep Extension
tags: How to do Landmine Lying Tricep Extension
How To Do A Landmine Lying Tricep Extension
instructions: Start lying on your back perpendicularly to the barbell, holding the bar directly over your shoulder with the hand that's closer to the bar with your palm facing down towards your feet.
While keeping your shoulder steady, bend your elbow and lower the end of the bar back towards your the ground next to your head. Keep your hinging elbow pointed down towards your feet.
Drive through your palm to extend your elbow and return the bar to the starting position, then repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Kettlebell Swing (Double)
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebells outside legs
Hinge at hips, swing kettlebells forward, then back.
Thrust hips to swing kettlebells upward, keeping arms straight.

name: Band Pallof Press
tags: How to do Band Pallof Press
How To Do A Band Pallof Press
instructions: Place the band at an anchor point that is shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Start with your fingers interlocked around the band and your fists connected to your chest.
Extend at the elbows pressing the band away from your body until your elbows are fully extended.

name: Cobra Pose
instructions: Start prone, hands under shoulders.
Inhale, lift chest, arch back.
Elongate neck, gaze up. Breathe, hold. Release, exhale.

name: Cardio Criss Cross Jacks
instructions: Perform a jumping jack while crossing the feet.

name: Cable High Single Arm Rear Delt Fly
tags: How to do Cable Rear Delt Fly
How To Do A Cable Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arm.
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

name: Cardio Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand with feet together, arms at your sides, ready to jump.
Jump while spreading legs and raising arms overhead.
Return to starting position with legs together and arms at your sides. Repeat.

name: Cable Incline Fly Around
instructions: Set cables slightly above shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Fly arm forward and upward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

name: Supermans
instructions: Lie face down on the floor with your arms fully extended in front of you.
Simultaneously raise your arms, legs and chest off of the floor and hold the position.
Slowly lower your arms, legs and chest back to the starting position. Repeat.

name: Barbell Pause Squat
tags: How To Do A Barbell Pause Squat
How to do Barbell Pause Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a barbell resting on your upper back.
Lower your body into a squat position, pausing for a moment at the bottom of the movement before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

name: Single Leg Balance 2
instructions: Stand upright with a braced core.
Choose the supporting leg and shift your weight on that, while lifting the other slightly off the ground.
Try to maintain your balance while bouncing a tennis ball off the wall or ground.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Goblet Squat
How to do Dumbbell Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold the weight tucked into your upper chest area, keeping your elbows in. Your feet should be slightly wider than shoulder width.
Sink down into the squat, keeping your elbows inside the track of your knees.
Push through your heels while keeping your chest up and return to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Rolling Tricep Extension
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Rolling Tricep Extension
How to do Dumbbell Rolling Tricep Extension
instructions: Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling.
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arms to the sides of your head.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Laying Reverse Fly
tags: How to do Dumbbell Laying Reverse Fly
How To Do A Dumbbell Laying Reverse Fly
instructions: With dumbbells in either hand, lay on an incline bench that's at about 15-30 degrees.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Flat Curl
instructions: Lay off the side of a bench with the back of your working arm pressed into the side of the bench. Keep your hips all the way up.
Fully extend your elbow and feel a stretch through your bicep, then curl.
Stop before the dumbbell is pointed at the ceiling to keep tension on your biceps.

name: Single Leg Eccentric Box Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a bench or box. Lift one leg in front you supporting yourself on the other leg.
Try to sit on the box in a controlled manner. Use both legs to stand back up

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Press
instructions: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at chest height with elbow bent.
Brace core and press handle straight forward without rotating torso.
Squeeze chest at extension, then return handle slowly to starting position.

name: Forearms Stretch Variation Four
tags: How to do Forearms Stretch Variation Four
How To Do A Forearms Stretch Variation Four
instructions: Raise your arm to shoulder height at 90 degrees to your body.
Press lightly on your hand and push towards you.
Rotate the arm across your body.
Switch sides and repeat.

name: Cable Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
instructions: Set the cable at nipple level. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Barbell Forward Lunge
tags: How To Do A Barbell Forward Lunge
How to do Barbell Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell at your shoulders with an overhand grip.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.

name: Treadmill Side Shuffle
instructions: Face sideways on the treadmill.
Take a quarter squat position with a wide stance.
Shuffle sideways for a specified amount of time, then switch sides.

name: Ring Standing Chest Fly
instructions: Start by adjusting the rings straps to chest height. Stand facing the rings with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rings' handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Lean forward, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged. Your body should form a slight diagonal line from your ankles to your head.
Slowly bring your arms towards each other, in front of your chest, while keeping your core engaged and your body in a stable position.

name: TRX Split Squat
tags: How To Do A TRX Split Squat
How to do TRX Split Squat
instructions: Hold the two TRX straps and step away until the straps are taut. Take a split stance.
Bring your back knee to the floor and gently tap the floor.
Use your arms and the TRX to help assist you getting back into the starting position.

name: Ankle Circle
instructions: Sit or stand, lift one foot slightly off the ground.
Rotate your ankle in a circular motion.
Complete the allotted amount of reps, then switch directions and repeat on the other foot.

name: Cardio Figure Eight Sprint
instructions: Perform s sprint in a figure eight pattern.
Make sure to stay low.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
tags: How to do Dumbbell Wrist Curl
How To Do A Dumbbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Grip the dumbbell with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Gate Pose Rounding Spine Looking Up
tags: How To Do A Gate Pose Rounding Spine Looking Up
How to do Gate Pose Rounding Spine Looking Up
instructions: Begin in a kneeling position with your knees hip-width apart.
Extend your right leg out to the side, placing your foot flat on the ground.
Reach your right arm overhead and then round your spine, bringing your right hand to your left ear.
Look down towards your left foot as you reach your left arm towards your right foot, feeling a stretch in your side body. Hold for a few breaths and then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Incline Bench Press
tags: How to do Dumbbell Neutral Incline Bench Press
How To Do A Dumbbell Neutral Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Horizontal Hack Squat
instructions: Position yourself in the hack squat machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Press through your heels to the starting position, keeping your core engaged. Repeat for desired reps and sets.

name: Hand Side Plank
tags: How to do Hand Side Plank
How To Do A Hand Side Plank
instructions: Press your hand into the ground and pick up your hip off the ground.
Open your chest and maintain this position for the allotted amount of time.

name: Kneeling Quad Stretch
instructions: Sit on your heels.
Lean back onto your palms.
To increase stretch intensity lift bum off heels.

name: Core Stability 5 Crosslateral Limb Raise Into Knee Elbow Tuck Push Up Position
instructions: Bring yourself to a strict push-up position
Raise opposite limbs till they are parallel to the ground
Hold for a split second and then try to bring your elbow to your opposite knee by driving both towards the centre of the body.
Spine might curve slightly but you should not shift your hips during the movement.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Pendlay Row
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, hinge forward until torso is nearly parallel to floor.
Pick kettlebell from ground with straight arm, keeping back flat and core braced.
Pull elbow straight up to ribs, then lower kettlebell fully back to floor each rep.

name: Medicine Ball Wall Ball
tags: How To Do A Wall Ball
instructions: Hold medicine ball at chest, facing wall.
Squat down, then throw ball at wall.
Catch and repeat for desired reps.

name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
instructions: Place the bar on your back
Start with feet flat on the ground
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: Hamstring Stretch Supine Glide
instructions: Place a theraband around your foot.
Lie back onto the ground.
Raise your leg to stretching point with the aid of the band, keeping a slightly bent knee.
Extend and bend your knee to actively stretch your hamstring.

name: Ez Bar Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Be careful getting the bar into place overhead. Push your elbows forward while keeping your elbows tucked in.
Look for what feels like a stretch in your triceps. Extend your elbows until your fists are pointed at the ceiling.

name: Machine Cable V Bar Push Downs
tags: How to do Machine Cable V Bar Push Downs
How To Do A Machine Cable V Bar Push Downs
instructions: Grip the pulley bar with palms facing down at shoulder width.
Stand straight with a small forward incline. Keep your upper arms close to your body, and slowly bring the pulley bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Pause when you are at the contracted position of the motion, then slowly raise the pulley bar back to the starting point.

name: Bodyweight Knee Tricep Extension
instructions: Begin in kneeling position. Hands shoulder width apart. Break at the elbows while letting your elbows fall to the floor.
Extend your elbows until you are back in the starting position.

name: Serratus Activation Cross Punch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell over your shoulder with a straight arm.
Form the sign of the cross adding a protraction (punch) on every end of the cross, including the middle position.

name: Clamshells 2 Side Lying
instructions: Lay on your side with knees bent. 90° angle at hips, knees and feet.
Lift your top leg slightly so no support is coming from the under leg.
Externally rotate the top knee without dropping your hip back
Hold for a split second (or as indicated by therapist/trainer) and return to starting position

name: Dumbbell Decline Bench Press
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Decline Bench Press
How to do Dumbbell Decline Bench Press
instructions: Lay on a decline bench with both arms extended in front of you.
Break at the elbows and bring your upper arms to your side.
Once your upper arms have reached your side, press the dumbbells back to the ceiling.

name: Femoral Nerve Mobilisation
instructions: While standing, bend your knee and grab your foot.
Bring your knee forward while tucking your chin (head forward).
Pull the leg back while tilting your head backwards (look up).

name: Core Stability 2 Opposite Shoulder Tap 4Pt Position
instructions: Bring yourself to the 4 point position (on all fours). 90° angles at hips and shoulder and neutral spine.
Lift your knees slightly off the ground supporting your weight on palms and toes.
Maintain a toe placement roughly at shoulder width (the wider the leg stance the easier the exercise - the narrower the stance the more difficult it becomes.
Tap your opposite shoulder with your fingertips.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding one dumbbell at your side, palm facing forward.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder, keeping elbow close to your torso.
Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to starting position.

name: Machine Hack Squat
instructions: Position yourself in the hack squat machine with your back against the pad and shoulders under the shoulder pads.
Place feet shoulder-width apart on the platform. Keep your back straight, and slowly lower into a squat position.
Press through your heels to return to the starting position, keeping your core engaged. Repeat for desired reps and sets.

name: Stability Ball Glute Bridge
instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a ball.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the bar.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm High Incline Chest Press
instructions: Sit on high incline bench holding dumbbell at shoulder with arm bent.
Press dumbbell upward and slightly inward until arm fully extends.
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping torso stable and controlled.

name: Mini Band Side To Side
instructions: Loop band above knees, slight athletic stance.
Step laterally, keeping knees pushed outward.
Continue stepping side to side under control.

name: Landmine Overhead Press
tags: How To Do A Landmine Overhead Press
How to do Landmine Overhead Press
instructions: Stand facing the landmine, holding the end of the bar in both hands with your palms facing each other.
Extend your arms upward, pressing the end of the bar up overhead. Pause at the top of the movement, then lower the bar with control back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Kettlebell Guillotine Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench, hold kettlebell with both hands over chest.
Lower kettlebells, elbows flared.
Press kettlebells upward, fully extending arms. Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Rolling Curl
instructions: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips pushed toward the ceiling.
Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Hammer Incline Curl
instructions: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips down.
Take a neutral grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Mini Band Side Laying Hip Abduction
instructions: Loop band above knees, lie on side legs straight.
Lift top leg upward without rotating hips.
Lower slowly, maintaining constant band tension.

name: Mini Band Fire Hydrant
instructions: Loop band above knees, start on hands and knees.
Lift one knee outward, keeping hips level.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Plate Superman
instructions: Lay flat on the ground on your stomach with your arms extended overhead. Hold a plate with a neutral grip.
Lift your legs and chest off the ground simultaneously and hold for a 1 count at the top.
Relax your lower back and lower your legs and chest back to the floor.

name: TRX Ab Rollout
tags: How To Do A TRX Ab Rollout
How to do TRX Ab Rollout
instructions: Grasp the TRX handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your abs engaged, roll forward onto your toes, and extend your arms in front of you.
Slowly lower your body down to the ground, keeping your arms straight and your abs engaged.
When your head gets between your arms, pause for a moment and then use your abs to pull your body back up to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
tags: How to do Dumbbell Concentration Curl
How To Do A Dumbbell Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight.
Lean forward and place your elbow on the inside of your leg.
Curl the dumbbell while keeping your elbow against your leg. Make sure to fully extend your elbow on each rep.

name: Hamstring Bridge Isometric Open Angle
instructions: Lie on your back with knees slightly bent and heels dug in.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back on the ground).
Press the heels into the ground to raise your hips off it.
Hold the position for the specified duration.

name: Mini Band Pull Apart
instructions: Hold band at shoulder height, arms straight.
Pull hands apart, squeezing shoulder blades together.
Return slowly, maintaining tension throughout.

name: Plate Glute Bridge to Chest Press
tags: How To Do A Plate Glute Bridge to Chest Press
How to do Plate Glute Bridge to Chest Press
instructions: Lay flat on the ground with a plate on your chest.
Push your hips up toward the ceiling and maintain that extended position.
With your hips up, press the plate toward the ceiling.

name: Lumbar Rotation 3
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the feet flat on the ground.
Drop your knees towards one side then place your ankle on the opposite knee.
To increase the intensity of the stretch you can reach up with your arms.

name: Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift
How to do Kettlebell Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, lifting one foot off the floor behind you. Hold the kettlebell in the same arm as the lifted leg.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you extend your lifted leg behind you, keeping your back straight - holding out your arm to the side for balance.
Return to the upright position and repeat.

name: Barbell Heels Up Back Squat
tags: How To Do A Barbell Heels Up Back Squat
How to do Barbell Heels Up Back Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your heels on a plate or low step.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Twisting Curl
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Twisting Curl
How to do Dumbbell Twisting Curl
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your sides, with your palms facing inward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders while rotating your wrists so that your palms face your shoulders at the top of the movement.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
tags: How to do Bulgarian Split Squat
How To Do A Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand with your back to a bench (or raised surface) and place one of your feet on the bench.
Squat down until your front leg is about parallel to the floor.
Go back to the starting position. After completing the desired amount of reps, switch legs and repeat.

name: Band Calf Raise
tags: How to do Band Calf Raise
How To Do A Band Calf Raise
instructions: Attach band to a low anchor point.
Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Lean back slightly. Raise your heels straight up and down

name: Vertical Leg Press
instructions: Lay on the pad and place your feet on the foot plate.
Lift the plate up and disengage the holding hook.
Lower the weight. Stop before your lower back rounds off the pad.
Press the weight back to the starting position.

name: Quads Stretch Variation Two
tags: How To Do A Quads Stretch Variation Two
How to do Quads Stretch Variation Two
instructions: Place one foot flat on the ground in front of you at a 90 degree angle. With your other leg, balance upon your knee, placing the tip of your foot against the wall behind you for balance.
Place your hands on your knee in front of you, and lean forward so that your knee extends over your foot.
Pause at the apex of the stretch, and slowly return to starting position. Repeat with your other leg.

name: Cable External Rotation
instructions: Hold the cable handle in one hand,  elbow bent at 90 degrees going across your torso.
Rotate your arm outward, keeping your elbow stable.

name: Cable Single Arm Bench Chest Fly
instructions: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cable just below shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulder should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbow stays in a fixed position.

name: Cardio Row Erg Rower Arms Only
instructions: Make sure your feet are strapped in tightly.
Without bending your legs, pull the handle to your ribcage.
Fully extend your elbows before initiating the next rep.

name: Bodyweight Feet Plank Jack
instructions: Start in high plank, hands under shoulders, body straight.
Jump feet out wide while bracing core and keeping hips level.
Jump feet back together, maintaining plank alignment throughout.

name: Dumbbell Curtsy Deficit Lunge
instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Shoulder Flexion Thoracic Extensions
instructions: Place a tube roller or half tube on the ground parallel to your body.
Lie on the tube making sure your whole back and neck are supported.
Knees bent and on the ground, lower back flat on the tube and chin tucked in.
Bring your arms by you hips and pull shoulders back.
This is your starting position. Raise arms and drop them back towards the ground over your head

name: Bosu Ball Front Raise
tags: How To Do A Front Raise
instructions: Hold the bosu vertically.
Raise the bosu toward the ceiling while keeping your elbows mostly extended.

name: Smith Machine Pushup
instructions: Place hands on the bar, in push-up position.
Lower yourself to the bar, maintaining proper form.

name: Supported Matsyasana Pose
tags: How To Do A Supported Matsyasana Pose
How to do Supported Matsyasana Pose
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs stretched out in front of you.
Place a yoga block behind you, horizontally, at the base of your spine.
Slowly recline over the block, supporting yourself with your forearms, until your back is resting on the block.
Relax your arms at your sides, palms facing up, and breathe deeply.

name: Kettlebell Upright Row Single
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

name: Landmine Alternating Lunge And Twist
tags: How to do Landmine Alternating Lunge And Twist
How To Do A Landmine Alternating Lunge And Twist
instructions: Set up the landmine attachment and load weight.
Stand facing the landmine, holding the weight away from your chest.
Step backward with one leg, lunge down while twisting your torso toward the front leg, return to starting position, and repeat on the other side.

name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
tags: How To Do A Landmine Romanian Deadlift
How to do Landmine Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet hip-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with both hands, palms facing each other, and hold it in front of your thighs.

Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and push your hips back, allowing the landmine to travel down your thighs. Lower the landmine by bending forward at the hips while keeping your back flat, allowing the barbell to move closer to the floor. Continue the movement until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your legs relatively straight but with a slight bend in the knees.
Reverse the movement by pushing your hips forward and driving through your heels while keeping your back straight.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Cardio Row Erg Rower Four Stroke Sprint Start
instructions: Sit on seat, feet strapped in, grip handle with arms extended.
Push with legs, lean back slightly. Do four small pulls with increasing distance on each rep.
Extend arms, lean forward from hips, bend knees to return to start.

name: Bodyweight Squat
tags: How To Do A Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
flex your knees and hips and sit back into the squat while lowering your body
Continue down to full depth
Return to starting position.

name: Band Single Arm Pulldown
instructions: Anchor the band to a high point. Go into a seated position.
Grab the loop of the band and pull your upper arm to your side.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Seated Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Sit tall holding dumbbell overhead with one hand, arm fully extended.
Lower dumbbell behind head by bending elbow slowly.
Extend arm back up, squeezing triceps at the top.

name: TRX Knee Tuck
tags: How To Do A TRX Knee Tuck
How to do TRX Knee Tuck
instructions: Place your feet in the TRX stirrups and get in to a hand plank position.
Pull your knees to your chest and flex your abs.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Step Up
instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold two dumbbells at your shoulders with an overhand grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.

name: Barbell Rack Pull
instructions: Set barbell just below knee height in rack and stand hip-width apart.
Hinge at hips, grip bar firmly, and keep back flat.
Drive hips forward and stand tall, locking out at the top.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Curl
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Goblet Curl
How to do Kettlebell Goblet Curl
instructions: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis.
Raise the kettlebell bending your arms at the elbow until the kettlebell is level with your chest.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

name: Chest Stretch Variation Three
tags: How to do Chest Stretch Variation Three
How To Do A Chest Stretch Variation Three
instructions: Place your arms behind your back and clasp your hands together.
Slowly extend your elbows until they are locked then lift them away from you.
Pause in this position for a few seconds and then return them to starting position.

name: Core Stability 1 Crosslateral Limb Raise 4Pt Position
instructions: Bring yourself to the 4 point position (on all fours)
90° angles at hips and shoulder and neutral spine
Raise opposite limbs till they are parallel to the ground
Hold for a split second and bring back to starting position

name: Prone Single Leg Hip Extension Hold
instructions: Lie on your stomach.
Secure your lower back by tilting your hips backwards.
Raise one leg and hold the position for the specified duration.

name: Cable Single Arm Hammer Curl
tags: How to do Cable Hammer Curl
How To Do A Cable Hammer Curl
instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Medicine Ball Overhead Squat
tags: How To Do A Overhead Squat
instructions: Hold medicine ball overhead.
Squat down, keeping back straight.
Stand back up. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Plate Wood Chopper
tags: How To Do A Plate Wood Chopper
How to do Plate Wood Chopper
instructions: Stand with a shoulder width stance. Begin with the plate near one of your quads.
Rotate at your upper spine to engage the obliques.
You can pivot your back foot to keep from generating too much torque at the knee.

name: Cable Bar Rolling Pushdown
instructions: Stand facing cable holding bar with palms down, elbows bent, and shoulders flexed.
First extend your shoulders (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbows.

name: Mini Band Jump Squat
instructions: Loop band above knees, stand feet shoulder width.
Squat down, knees pushed outward against band.
Explode upward into jump, land softly and reset.

name: Lumbar Rotation 4
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the feet flat on the ground.
Cross your legs. Drop your knees towards one side before moving towards the other.
To increase the intensity of the stretch you can reach up with your arms.

name: Barbell Squat
tags: How To Do A Barbell Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Maintain the natural arch in your back, squeezing your shoulder blades and raising your chest.
Grip the bar across your shoulders and support it on your upper back. Unwrack the bar by straightening your legs, and take a step back.
Bend your knees as you lower the weight without altering the form of your back until your hips are below your knees.
Raise the bar back to starting position, lift with your legs and exhale at the top.

name: Calf Raise 3B Soleus Bias Unilateral
instructions: From the standing position, bend your knees till you get to a squated or semi-squated position. Be close to a pole or squat rack to use for balance
Maintain the squat while shifting your weight onto the working leg and raising the other off the ground
Raise your heel off the ground
Hold the position for a split second before lowering your heel again
Do not rest at the bottom. As soon as you feel your heel touch the ground, repeat the movement

name: Dumbbell Row Bilateral
tags: How to do Dumbbell Row Bilateral
How To Do A Dumbbell Row Bilateral
instructions: Grab both dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips. Make sure you keep a flat back.
The closer your torso is to parallel with the ground the longer the range of motion will be at your shoulder. The better the results you'll get from the exercise.
Let your arms hang freely, and then pull your elbow joint straight back toward the ceiling.

name: Cable Internal Rotation
instructions: Stand tall, hold the cable handle with a neutral grip, your elbow should be at a 90 degree angle.
Rotate your shoulder by bringing your forearm across your body.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Pendlay Row
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, hinge forward until torso is nearly parallel to floor.
Grab dumbbell from floor with straight arm, keeping back flat and core braced.
Pull elbow straight up to ribs, then lower dumbbell fully back to the floor each rep.

name: Barbell Laying Triceps Extensions
tags: How To Do A Barbell Laying Triceps Extensions
How to do Barbell Laying Triceps Extensions
instructions: Lay on a flat bench while holding a barbell with a shoulder-width grip.
Fully extend your elbows until the barbell is directly over your chest.
Begin to flex your elbows and allow the barbell to nearly touch your forehead.
Extend your elbows back to the starting position and repeat.

name: Band Bench Fly
instructions: Lie on bench holding band handles with arms extended above chest.
Lower arms out wide in a controlled arc, keeping slight bend in elbows.
Bring arms back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Row
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Single Arm Row
How to do Dumbbell Single Arm Row
instructions: Start by standing in front of a flat bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Place your other hand on the bench for support, and bend at the waist so that your chest is parallel to the ground.
From this starting position, row the dumbbell up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blade together as you do so.
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: Adjust the machine for your height, sit with your back against the pad, knees bent, feet flat on the platform.
Brace your core, push through your heels, and extend your hips upwards, lifting the weight while squeezing your glutes.
Lower the weight slowly back to the starting position, ensuring controlled movement; repeat for desired reps and sets.

name: Cardio Assault Bike
instructions: Adjust seat and handlebar height for comfort and proper posture on the assault bike.
Start pedaling with even, controlled motion, maintaining your desired resistance level.
Monitor heart rate and intensity; increase or decrease resistance for an effective cardio workout.

name: Plate Squat Hold
tags: How to do Plate Squat Hold
How To Do A Plate Squat Hold
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, with a weight plate held in both hands at chest height.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight and your weight in your heels.
Go down until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then pause for a moment.
Hold the squat position for the desired amount of time, keeping the weight plate steady and your core engaged.

name: Laying Lateral Raise
tags: How to do Laying Lateral Raise
How To Do A Laying Lateral Raise
instructions: Lay on your side on a bench or box. Place one hand on the floor and the other hand is holding the dumbbell.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, raise the dumbbell to the side.
The end of the range of motion is when the dumbbell is pointed toward the ceiling.
Make sure you don't flex and extend your elbow.

name: Landmine Glute Kick Back
tags: How To Do A Landmine Glute Kick Back
How to do Landmine Glute Kick Back
instructions: Start on your hands and knees perpendicular to the barbell with the end of the barbell resting on the inside of your knee that is closer to the bar.
Keeping your core braced, your back flat, and your moving leg bent at a 90 degree angle, drive the heel of your working leg up the ceiling while squeezing your glute.
Follow the movement path as you bring your knee back down to the ground beneath your hip, keeping your knee bent to maintain control of the barbell.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Kettlebell Russian Twist
tags: How to do Kettlebell Russian Twist
How To Do A Kettlebell Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs bent, knees together and feet raised slightly off the floor.

Starting on one side and sitting up straight with your core muscles engaged, lift the kettlebell off the floor with both hands and bring it across your body to the other side, rotating your chest towards the floor as you do so.
Tap the kettlebell lightly on the floor and bring the kettlebell back across your body to the starting position, rotating your chest towards the floor.
Repeat, keeping the legs bent and feet raised throughout the exercise.

name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Sit in a v position.
Pull legs and torso together.
Extend back into the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Lateral Raise
tags: How to do Kettlebell Single Arm Lateral Raise
How To Do A Kettlebell Single Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart holding a kettlebell with one hand at your side.
Keeping your arm straight, swing the kettlebell up and out, away from your body to around head height.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Cable Rope Lat Prayer
instructions: Use a rope attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ears should be between your arms.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.

name: Band Rear Delt Fly
tags: How to do Band Rear Delt Fly
How To Do A Band Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Start by standing between the two anchored bands with your feet shoulder-width apart and the bands positioned at a high point.
Grasp the ends of each band with your hands, keeping your palms facing each other.

Keeping your arms slightly bent and your back straight, slowly pull the bands away from your body until your arms are extended straight out to the sides. Hold for a second, then slowly release back to the starting position. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Calf Raise 3A Soleus Bias Bilateral
instructions: From the standing position, bend your knees till you get to a squated or semi-squated position
Maintain the squat while raising both heels off the ground
Hold the position for a split second before lowering your heels again
Do not rest at the bottom. As soon as you feel your heels touch the ground, repeat the movement

name: Dumbbell Goblet Step Up
instructions: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a dumbbell with a goblet grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box.
Step back down with your right foot.

name: Cable Bar Kneeling Crunch
instructions: Use a bar attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward and fall to a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Swing
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs, grip with one hand, hinge at hips.
Swing kettlebell forcefully forward, using hip thrust, arm straight.
Swing kettlebell back between legs, repeat for desired reps.

name: Bosu Ball Split Squat
tags: How To Do A Split Squat
instructions: Stand in front of Bosu, one foot on the center.
Lower into a lunge position, knee at 90 degrees.
Push off the front foot to return to starting position.

name: Cardio Band Hammer Curl Jacks
instructions: Stand with a band looped under both feet and the band grasped in both hands.
Do a light hop and bring your feet outward while simultaneously flexing the elbows.
Bring both feet back together and extend the elbows.

name: TRX Glute Bridge
tags: How to do TRX Glute Bridge
How To Do A TRX Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet in the foot cradles of the TRX straps, with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your arms by your sides with your palms facing down.
Drive your hips up towards the ceiling, squeezing your glutes and hamstrings at the top of the movement.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row On Bench
instructions: Start by standing in front of a flat bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Place your other hand on the bench for support, and bend at the waist so that your chest is parallel to the ground.
From this starting position, row the kettlebell up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blade together as you do so.
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

name: Calf Raise 1D Bilateral From Box
instructions: Use the edge of a step to place the balls of your feet on
Raise the heels, before lowering them below the level of the step, or until you feel a stretch in the calves
Try pausing on both ends of range for a split second
You should feel your calves working

name: Calf Raise 1A Bilateral Eccentric Floor
instructions: Hold on to something for balance.
Do an explosive jump in which your toes don't leave the floor.
Slowly lower your heels back down toward the ground.

name: Cardio Skater To Single Leg Burpee
instructions: Leap sideways, land on right foot, left leg behind to the side.
Drop into a single-leg burpee, right leg only, hands to ground.
Return to standing on right, leap sideways to left, repeat with left leg.

name: Tree Pose
tags: How To Do A Tree Pose
instructions: Start in mountain pose, standing with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and bend your right knee, bringing the sole of your right foot to the inside of your left thigh.
Bring your hands together in front of your heart, or raise them overhead.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then release and repeat on the other side.

name: Treadmill Walk
instructions: Get the treadmill up to a comfortable speed where you are doing a walk.

name: Calf Raise 2D Unilateral From Box
instructions: Use the edge of a step to place the balls of one foot on
Raise the heel, before lowering it below the level of the step, or until you feel a stretch in the calf
Try pausing on both ends of range for a split second

name: Kettlebell Deadlift (Single)
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Return to standing position and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Half Kneeling Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Place one knee on a bench and hold a kettlebell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Kettlebell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a bench, hold kettlebells above chest.
Lower them to chest, then push up.
Repeat for desired reps, maintaining form.

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
instructions: Stand sideways to cable with handle set low, palm rotated inward before lifting.
Bring arm upward and across chest in an arc, keeping elbow slightly bent.
Squeeze upper chest at the top, then return slowly while maintaining internal rotation.

name: Smith Machine Oblique Crunch
instructions: Lay on your side with your knees bent.
Hold the bar extended over you.
Lift yourself up by flexing your obliques.

name: Band Chest Fly
tags: How to do Band Chest Fly
How To Do A Band Chest Fly
instructions: Secure two resistance bands to a sturdy anchor point (e.g. a door anchor, a post, etc.) at chest height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with feet shoulder-width apart and hold each end of the band in each hand.
Start with arms fully extended and parallel to the floor.
Keeping arms straight, slowly bring your arms together in front of your chest.

name: Trap Bar Deficit Deadlift
instructions: Stand on elevated surface inside trap bar, feet hip-width.
Grip handles, brace core, maintain neutral spine.
Drive through feet, extend hips and knees to stand.
Lower under control, maintaining balance on platform.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Decline Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat pad to match your height.
Press the weight forward until your elbows are nearly extended. Return to the starting position with out letting the weight rest at the bottom until finishing your set.

name: Abdominals Stretch Variation Two
tags: How To Do A Abdominals Stretch Variation Two
How to do Abdominals Stretch Variation Two
instructions: Stand upright.
Reach with both hands upwards until you can interlock your fingers.
With your hands above your head, lean back until a stretch is felt in the abdominals.

name: Smith Machine Assisted Pullup
instructions: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended. Leave your feet on the floor.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar. Use your legs top assist you up.
Lower your body back to starting position.

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Incline Chest Fly
instructions: Stand sideways to cable with handle set low, arm slightly bent.
Bring arm upward and across chest in an arc without rotating torso.
Squeeze upper chest at the top, then return slowly to starting position.

name: Side Plank Reach Through
tags: How To Do A Side Plank Reach Through
How to do Side Plank Reach Through
instructions: Begin in an elbow side plank position.
Reach for the ceiling with your off hand.
Rotate at the mid and upper spine and reach through the open space between the floor and your torso.
Reach backwards, and then rotate back into the starting position.

name: Landmine Alternating Single Arm Press
tags: How To Do A Landmine Alternating Single Arm Press
How to do Landmine Alternating Single Arm Press
instructions: Stand facing the landmine leaning forward slightly with the end of the barbell held in one hand at your shoulder with your elbow positioned beneath your wrist.

While keeping your elbow pointed forward, drive the bar directly overhead, switching hands at the top of the movement. Lower the bar back down to the other side of your body, mirroring the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps, switching hands at the top of each rep.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Overhead Press
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Neutral Overhead Press
How to do Dumbbell Neutral Overhead Press
instructions: Start with both dumbbells near your shoulders in a neutral grip.
Press the dumbbells toward the ceiling.
Make sure you don't arch your back as you fatigue.

name: Downward Dog Toe To Heel
tags: How to do Downward Dog Toe To Heel
How To Do A Downward Dog Toe To Heel
instructions: Begin in a downward-facing dog position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right foot off the mat and place your right toes on top of your left heel.
Press your palms and fingers firmly into the mat and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, deepening the stretch in your hamstrings and calves.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, and then release by slowly walking your hands back out to a downward-facing dog position.

name: Big Toe Abduction
instructions: Sit on a bench with your bare foot on the ground.
Slightly raise your big toe before trying to move it towards the opposite side (abduction).
Expect he range of motion is very limited and the movement to be very difficult.
It helps a lot having your toe on a line as benchmark.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
tags: How to do Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
How To Do A Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend at the waist and place your opposite hand on your knee for support.
From this starting position, extend your arm backwards so that the dumbbell is behind your body.
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

name: Cable Low Single Arm Lateral Raise
tags: How To Do A Cable Lateral Raise
How to do Cable Lateral Raise
