instructions: Use a handle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arm straight out to the side.
Raise until your arm is parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.

name: Biceps Stretch Variation Two
tags: How to do Biceps Stretch Variation Two
How To Do A Biceps Stretch Variation Two
instructions: Stand facing the wall, an arm's width away.
Place your hand on the wall with your fingers pointing down.
Lean slightly into the wall to feel the stretch in your bicep.

name: Pyramid Pose Calf Blocks
tags: How to do Pyramid Pose Calf Blocks
How To Do A Pyramid Pose Calf Blocks
instructions: Start standing with a flat and vertical block on the matt
Bend forward, placing hand on vertical block, and front of foot on the flat block.
Press the bottom of your foot towards the ground, and repeat on each side.

name: Alternating Swipe Around
instructions: Lie on your front, arms above head. Squeeze glutes to protect lower back
Raise your chest and arms off the ground. Adduct (bring your arms by your hips) in an alternating fashion.

name: extended-side-angle-pose
instructions: Begin in a lunge position with your right foot forward and your left foot back.
Place your right hand on a block or the ground on the outside of your right foot.
Reach your left arm overhead and then round your spine, bringing your left hand to your right ear.
Look down towards your right foot as you reach your left arm towards the front of the room, feeling a stretch in your side body. Hold for a few breaths and then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Side Step Up
instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a dumbbell in your hands. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
Place a step or box beside you, and step up onto it with one foot. Your other foot should remain on the ground.
Push off your grounded foot, raising your body up onto the step.
Step back down with the same foot, returning to the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Windmill
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Windmill
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart. Hold the kettlebell in one hand and extend your arm above your head.
Keeping your legs straight and the kettlebell above your head, lower the relaxed arm towards the ground, twisting your body towards the side of the raised arm.
Return to the starting potion, tilt your pelvis forward and repeat.

name: Bodyweight Box Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit on the machine. Adjust the back pad to where the leg pad is just above your knees.
Adjust the leg pad that goes on your lower leg until it's on your achilles.
Use the two handles to push your self back in the chair. Curl your legs as far as possible, and then extend your knees. (Do not hyperextend)

name: Cable Rope Mid Lateral Raise
instructions: Place the cable at the same height as your fist when your arms are at your side and stand with the cable crossing your body.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, lift your arm until it's parallel with the floor.

name: Calf Stretch On Box Bilateral
instructions: Stand on a box. From the standing position, shift your weight onto the balls of one foot.
Lower the heels of your feet toward the ground, and hold the position for the duration specified
You should feel your calf stretching.

name: Hamstring Bridge With Elevated Legs Box Bilateral
instructions: Lie on your back. Place your heels on a box or bench, having a 90° angle at hips and knees.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back against the ground).
Push through your heels into the box, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees.

name: Treadmill Backwards Walk
instructions: Face the opposite direction on the treadmill.
Hold on to the arms to find your balance.
Walk backwards pushing your toes through the front of your shoes.

name: Banded Side Walks
instructions: Place a band either just below or above your knees.
Get into a quarter squat position.
Step side to side without letting there be any slack in the band to keep tension on the band.

name: Smith Machine Inverted Row
instructions: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Chest Press
instructions: Lie on bench holding one kettlebell above chest with arm extended.
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping torso stable.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting.

name: Stability Ball Single Leg Hip Thrust
instructions: Lie on the ball, one foot on the ground.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Machine Hip And Glute Kickback
instructions: Stand on the platform and sideways on the machine.
Place the pad at just above hip height. Place the working leg over the pad.
Extend the working leg backwards and flex your glute at the end of each rep.

name: Barbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
tags: How To Do A Barbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
How to do Barbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips. Place one foot about 6-9 inches in front of the other.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Cable Wrist Curl
tags: How To Do A Cable Wrist Curl
How to do Cable Wrist Curl
instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Start with your elbow at a 90° angle with your palm facing up. Flex and extend at the wrist.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on the machine and press your back into the back pad.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of the foot plate.
Let your heels lower until you feel a stretch in your calves, then press back up until you feel a contraction.

name: Barbell Skullcrusher
tags: How To Do A Barbell Skullcrusher
instructions: Take a shoulder width grip. Break at the elbows. Try to keep your elbows tucked in. Don't let them flare out.
Stop the bar a few inches from your forehead and extend your elbows back up.

name: Glute Stretch Static Unilateral
instructions: Lie on your back.
Bend one knee and pull it towards your chest.
Maintain the stretch for a few seconds before swapping legs.

name: Dumbbell Pullover Eccentrics
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell over your shoulder, straight arm.
Slowly lower your arm towards the ground (overhead position).
Pause in the stretched position.
Bend your elbow to return to the starting position.

name: Long Lever Plank
tags: How to do Long Lever Plank
How To Do A Long Lever Plank
instructions: Start in a hand plank position and walk your hands further out until your ears are between your biceps.
Hold in this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you keep a flat back for the whole set.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Step Up
instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold kettlebells at your shoulders.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.

name: Ring Pull Up
instructions: Grasp the rings with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the rings.
Lower your body back to starting position.

name: L Sit Pull Up
instructions: Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.

name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
instructions: Position the bench between 30 and 45 degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

name: Dead Bugs Same Side
instructions: Lay on your back. Extend your straight arms above the chest and raise your bent knees till they are over your hips.
Lower limbs of the same side towards the ground. You can feel the ground but do not rest on or tap off of the ground.
Maintain a flat lower back throughout the movement (lower back should be in contact with the ground).

name: Cardio Karaoke
instructions: Stand upright, feet together, facing forward, ready to move laterally.
Move right foot behind left, then step left foot to the side.
Alternate crossing and stepping, increase speed, maintain rhythm and balance.

name: TRX W Raise
tags: How to do TRX W Raise
How To Do A TRX W Raise
instructions: Hold the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point.
Pull your elbows back while externally rotating your shoulder joint. Your arms should make a W shape at the back portion of the exercise.

name: Dumbbell Weighted Pull Ups
instructions: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Kneeling Wood Chopper
tags: How to do Dumbbell Kneeling Wood Chopper
How To Do A Dumbbell Kneeling Wood Chopper
instructions: Start in a kneeling position with your shoulder blades pulled back.
The dumbbell should begin by one of your hips.
Rotate at the spine and bring the dumbbell from your hip, 180 degrees around your body. The dumbbell should land at eye level.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Shoulder Extension
instructions: Hold kettlebell at your sides with straight arms and palms neutral.
Move arm backward until you feel lats and rear delts engage.
Lower slowly to starting position under full control.

name: Mini Band Standing Hip Flexion
instructions: Loop band around feet or anchor behind you.
Lift one knee upward to hip height.
Lower slowly without leaning backward.

name: Mini Band Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand on band with one foot, hinge at hips.
Keep back flat, opposite leg extended behind.
Drive hips forward to return upright.

name: Mini Band Standing Glute Kickback
instructions: Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
Extend one leg backward, squeezing glute.
Return slowly without arching lower back.

name: Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift (Single)
tags: How to do Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift
How To Do A Kettlebell Staggered Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, shifting one foot behind you. Hold the kettlebell in both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees and keep your back straight.
Return to the upright position and repeat.

name: Barbell Spinal Jefferson Curl
instructions: Stand on a platform holding barbell in front with feet hip-width apart.
Slowly roll down through spine one vertebra at a time, reaching toward toes.
Reverse the motion, rolling up through spine until standing tall again.

name: Machine Horizontal Leg Press
instructions: Place your legs on the platform with your feet at shoulder width.
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the pad. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.

name: Calf Raise Isometric Unilateral
instructions: From the standing position, shift your weight onto the balls of one foot.
Raise your heel off the ground, and hold the position for the duration specified
You should feel your calf working.

name: Medicine Ball Ball Headlock Squat
tags: How to do Ball Headlock Squat
How To Do A Ball Headlock Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding medicine ball close.
Squat down, keeping ball close to head and chest.
Stand back up, squeezing glutes. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Serratus Activation Active Plank
instructions: Support your weight on your forearms and toes (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.

name: Dumbbell Knee Lawnmower Row
tags: How to do Dumbbell Knee Lawnmower Row
How To Do A Dumbbell Knee Lawnmower Row
instructions: Stand with feet staggered and one hand on your knee. Hold a dumbbell in the opposing hand.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping the back flat, and eyes facing forward. The weight should hang directly below the shoulders.
Start with an overhand grip, as you pull rotate the dumbbell. When your upper arm reaches your side your palm should be facing forward.

name: Bodyweight Stability Ball Crunch
instructions: Start by lying flat on your back on a ball with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent.
Engage your core muscles and flex your spine until you feel your abs contract.

name: Prayer Stretch 2 Roller
instructions: Sit on your heels and reach out your arms on a box or foam roller while pressing the chest towards the ground.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Full Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit tall holding one dumbbell at your side with slight bend in elbows.
Raise arm outward until arms go overhead.
Lower under control, maintaining constant tension on delts.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
instructions: Bring your elbows to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.

name: Standing Neck Flexions
instructions: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Tuck your chin in and drop your head forwards without rounding the back.

name: Bosu Ball Toe Tap
tags: How To Do A Toe Tap
instructions: Stand on Bosu, lift one foot, tap it on the Bosu.
Alternate tapping feet while maintaining balance.
Keep the movement controlled and steady.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Single Arm Deadlift
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Single Leg Single Arm Deadlift
How to do Dumbbell Single Leg Single Arm Deadlift
instructions: Start by standing on one leg with a dumbbell in one hand.
Slowly bend at the hips and lower the dumbbell towards the ground while extending your free leg behind you.
Keep your core engaged and your back straight as you lower the weight.
Once the dumbbell is close to the ground, push through your heel to return to the starting position.

name: Stability Ball Hamstring Curl
instructions: Lie on your back, heels on a stability ball, arms flat, and core engaged.
Lift hips, curl the ball toward you using your hamstrings, keeping control and balance.
Extend legs back to start while keeping hips lifted, then repeat for desired reps.

name: Machine Chest Supported T Bar Row
instructions: Lay on the chest pad and grab the handles. Lift the bar out of the holding hook.
Pull the bar to your chest and then fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.

name: Machine Leg Press
tags: How to do Machine Leg Press
How To Do A Machine Leg Press
instructions: Place your legs on the platform with your feet at shoulder width.
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the pad. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.

name: Barbell Split Jerk
instructions: Start with the barbell on your shoulders in a front rack position, feet hip-width apart. Slightly bend your knees and dip straight down.
Explosively extend your legs and push the barbell upward, generating momentum with your legs.
As the bar rises, quickly split your legs (one forward, one back) and drop under the bar, locking your arms overhead.
Bring your front foot back, then your back foot forward to a stable standing position with the bar locked overhead.

name: Cable Pull Around
instructions: Place cable pin all the way at the top or nearly at the top of the cable stack.
Face sideways and take a half kneeling position.
Grab the handle and reach across the body, begin the pull.
As you pull, imagine you are trying to put your elbow into your pocket.

name: Ring Standing Roll Out
instructions: Grasp the rings, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your abs engaged, roll forward onto your toes, and extend your arms in front of you.
Slowly lower your body down toward the ground, keeping your arms straight and your abs engaged.
When your head gets between your arms, pause for a moment and then use your abs to pull your body back up to the starting position.

name: Standing Mini-Band Hip Flexion
instructions: Wrap a loop band around your feet.
Drive a knee upwards till your thigh is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
Try to maintain balance and a good posture when raising the knee.

name: Hamstring Stretch Dynamic Standing Bilateral
instructions: Standing, split stance.
Dynamically kick your back leg forward and up.
Return to starting position.

name: Skater Squat
instructions: From the standing position shift your weight onto the working leg and keep the other one suspended behind you
Tilt at the hips and lean over as you are bending the loaded knee
Bring your back knee close to the ground before standing back up.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Step Up Knee Drive
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front rack position and place one foot on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping chest tall and core braced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Landmine Calf Raise
tags: How to do Landmine Calf Raise
How To Do A Landmine Calf Raise
instructions: Stand facing the barbell, holding the end of the barbell close to your chest in both hands with your elbows tucked in to your sides.
Drive though the balls of your feet to raise your heels off the ground, squeezing your calves, with a focus on making sure your ankles do not turn out or in.
Lower your heels back down to the ground and repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Cable Seated Rope Face Pull
instructions: Sit facing cable and hold rope with palms facing each other, arms extended.
Pull rope toward upper face while flaring elbows outward.
Squeeze rear delts and mid-traps, then slowly return to start.

name: Kettlebell Wrist Curl
tags: How to do Kettlebell Wrist Curl
How To Do A Kettlebell Wrist Curl
instructions: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, with your forearms facing outwards.
Flex your wrist towards your body until the kettlebell is level with your stomach.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

name: Bosu Ball Feet Elevated Glute Bridge
tags: How To Do A Feet Elevated Glute Bridge
How to do Feet Elevated Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back, place feet on Bosu, knees bent.
Lift hips and squeeze glutes.
Lower hips back down to complete one rep.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch Kneeling Lunge 3
instructions: Bring yourself to kneeling lunge position. Keep a 90° angle at knees.
Back foot should be elevated (the higher the elevation the more the hip flexor/upper quad will stretch).
Slide the front knee forward while gently leaning back.
Squeeze the glute on the side of the leg that's to the front to avoid lower back complaints.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Press
tags: How to do Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Press
How To Do A Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing forward and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, extend your arm upwards so that the dumbbell is overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Machine Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Sit on the machine and place the back of your upper arm on the bench.
Extend your elbows until you feel a contraction in your triceps.
Bring the weight back to the starting position.

name: Medicine Ball Single Leg Deadlift
tags: How To Do A Single Leg Deadlift
How to do Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Hold medicine ball while standing on one leg.
Hinge forward on one leg, extending other leg behind.
Return to starting position. Repeat on other leg.

name: Frog Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands behind head.
Crunch up, flexing the spine and your abs.

name: Cable Tricep Kickback
instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set to hip height.
Hinge forward. Make sure to keep your upper arm glued at your side. Extend your elbows until you feel your triceps contract.

name: Barbell Landmine Sissy Squat
tags: How to do Landmine Sissy Squat
How To Do A Landmine Sissy Squat
instructions: Hold the bar in a goblet position.
Stand tall, push your knees forward until your calves touch your hamstrings.
Make sure to keep your hips extended.

name: Lower back Stretch Variation Three
tags: How To Do A Lower back Stretch Variation Three
How to do Lower back Stretch Variation Three
instructions: Lay on your back with your arms at either side.
Raise your knees so that they are pointing straight towards the ceiling. Keeping your legs pressed together, rotate your hips to either side.
Repeat this motion as necessary.

name: Cardio Step Out Jacks
instructions: Stand tall, feet together, arms by sides, ready to move.
Step right foot out, simultaneously raise arms above head.
Step right foot in, lower arms, repeat left, maintain rhythm.

name: Standing Neck Extensions
instructions: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Lean your head back trying to keep the front of the neck straight.
Point your chin to the ceiling.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Single Arm Lateral Lunge
instructions: Hold kettlebell in front rack.
Step sideways, lunge.

name: Machine Neutral Row
instructions: Sit on the machine, feet flat, and grab the handles with palms facing each other, keeping your back straight.
Pull handles towards your lower abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep elbows close to your body.
Slowly return to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking elbows. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Mini Band Overhead Fly
instructions: Loop bands around wrists,, arms extended overhead.
Pull arms outward in arc motion.
Return slowly, controlling tension throughout movement.

name: Kettlebell Squat Clean And Jerk
instructions: Start with kettlebells between legs resting on the floor with knee bend and flat back.
Pull kettlebells explosively to shoulder, catching it in a squat position.
Stand tall, dip slightly, then drive up to press kettlebells overhead.

name: Kettlebell Front Raise
tags: How to do Kettlebell Front Raise
How To Do A Kettlebell Front Raise
instructions: Stand up straight with feet shoulder width apart, holding the kettlebell in front of your pelvis.
Keeping arms straight, raise the kettlebell slightly higher than head level.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Cable High Single Arm Reverse Bayesian Curl
instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set at elbow level.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards,  and curl.

name: Machine Hip And Glute Abduction
instructions: Stand on the platform and set the pad just over the opposing hip of the working leg.
Place the working leg over the pad.
Press your leg outward. Aim to get the longest range of motion possible.

name: Hanging Knee Raises
tags: How to do Hanging Knee Raises
How To Do A Hanging Knee Raises
instructions: Grab the bar and hang, your body still and your legs straight.
Slowly draw your knees up to your chest

Once you have raised your knees as high as possible, lower your legs and repeat. Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.
Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.

name: Hip Openers
instructions: Bring your leg to the side and place the foot by your palm.
Rotate towards the ceiling and then towards the ground, pressing the hips towards the ground.

name: Cable Seated Bayesian Hammer Curl
instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine and sit on the bench. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Bodyweight Curtsy Step Down
instructions: Stand tall on platform and cross free leg diagonally behind you.
Lower body by bending standing knee, keeping hips square.
Drive through standing heel to return upright with control.

name: Wild Thing Pose
tags: How To Do A Wild Thing Pose
How to do Wild Thing Pose
instructions: Start in a downward facing dog position.
Shift your weight onto your left hand and foot, and lift your right leg towards the ceiling.
Slowly bend your right knee and shift your weight onto your right hand as you open up your chest towards the ceiling.
Look towards your right hand and hold the pose for a few breaths before switching sides.

name: Band Leg Curl
tags: How to do Band Leg Curl
How To Do A Band Leg Curl
instructions: Loop the band around a sturdy anchor point such as a weightlifting rack or a door handle.
Lie on your back with your heels placed inside the band. Make sure the band is centered under your heels and your feet are hip-width apart.
Using your hamstrings, curl your heels towards your glutes while keeping your hips on the ground.

name: Barbell Suitcase Deadlift
tags: How to do Barbell Suitcase Deadlift
How To Do A Barbell Suitcase Deadlift
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart and holding a barbell at one side of your body, with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and knees to lower the barbell down towards the ground.
As the barbell reaches the ground, use your legs and glutes to push through your heels and extend your hips and knees to raise your body back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of reps, then switch sides and repeat the exercise with the barbell on the opposite side of your body.

name: Machine Seated Cable Row
tags: How to do Machine Seated Cable Row
How To Do A Machine Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit with your back straight on the machine and grip the handles.
Pull the handles back using your arms. Your legs and torso should be at a 90° angle. Push out your chest.
Pull the handles towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Larsen Press
instructions: Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one dumbbell above chest.
Lower dumbbell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.

name: Corpse Pose
tags: How To Do A Corpe Pose
instructions: Lie down on your back with your legs straight and arms at your sides.
Close your eyes and take deep breaths in through your nose and out through your mouth.
Allow your body to completely relax and let go of any tension.
Hold for several minutes and then slowly come back up to a seated position.

name: Seated Hip Flexion Hold
instructions: Sit on a bench without back support.
Keep an upright back and your shoulders back.
Raise one leg and maintain the position for the specified duration.

name: Ez Bar Reverse Spider Curl
instructions: Lay on an incline bench and hold the EZ bar with your elbows extended.
From this starting position, curl the bar up towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body and your core engaged.
Slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: TRX I Raise
tags: How To Do A TRX I Raise
How to do TRX I Raise
instructions: Stand facing the TRX straps and hold onto the handles with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your core engaged, slowly raise your arms forward until they are overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.

name: Jump Squats
tags: How To Do A Jump Squats
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start by doing a regular squat, then engage your core and jump up explosively.
When you land, lower your body back into the squat position.

name: Bosu Ball Hand Plank
tags: How To Do A Hand Plank
instructions: Place hands on Bosu, shoulder-width apart.
Extend legs, keeping body straight.
Hold the plank position, engaging core.

name: Dumbbell Decline Single Arm Bench Press
tags: How to do Dumbbell Decline Single Arm Bench Press
How To Do A Dumbbell Decline Single Arm Bench Press
instructions: Start by laying on a decline bench with two dumbbells.
Position the dumbbell above your chest with your elbow bent and shoulder level.
Slowly lower the dumbbell towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged while the other dumbbell remains pointed toward the ceiling.
Once the dumbbell reaches your side, pause for a moment and then press the weight back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to your other arm.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Forward Lunge
tags: How to do Kettlebell Forward Lunge
How To Do A Kettlebell Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand straight with your feet slightly apart and hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Bring the same leg as the arm holding the kettlebell in front of you, squat down until your thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Row (Single)
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

name: Plate Reach
tags: How To Do A Plate Reach
instructions: Start in a standing position with a plate against your chest.
Press the plate away from your body until your elbows are extended.

name: Cable Incline Bench Straight Leg Kickback
instructions: Use an ankle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. Put the bench at incline level. The cable should be set to shoulder height.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

name: Barbell Shrug
tags: How To Do A Barbell Shrug
instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell in front of you.
Bend down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
Stand up straight, lifting the barbell off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.
Once the barbell is at your hips, raise your shoulders as high as you can, holding the position for a moment.

name: Dumbbell Seated Shrug
tags: How to do Dumbbell Seated Shrug
How To Do A Dumbbell Seated Shrug
instructions: Sit on a bench with dumbbells in both hands, palms facing your body, back straight.
Elevate your shoulders and hold the contracted position at the apex of the motion.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Seated Rear Delt Row
instructions: Sit on a bench. Put your chest in your lap. Try to get your torso as close to parallel with the ground as your mobility will allow for.
Let your arms hang in front of you. Pull your elbows back towards the ceiling while flaring your elbows outward.

name: Stability Ball Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor, place upper back on a stability ball, feet flat, knees bent.
Drive hips upward by squeezing glutes, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower hips slowly without touching the floor, maintaining core engagement, then repeat.

name: Dumbbell Somersault Squat
instructions: Start in a deep squat holding a dumbbell between your thighs.
Extend your knees until mostly extended without extending the hips.

name: Extended side Angle Pose With Block
tags: How to do Extended side Angle Pose With Block
How To Do A Extended side Angle Pose With Block
instructions: Begin in a lunge position with your right foot forward and your left foot back.
Place a block on the outside of your right foot and place your right hand on top of it.
Look down towards your right foot as you reach your left arm towards the front of the room, feeling a stretch in your side body. Hold for a few breaths and then switch sides.

name: Barbell Sumo Pause Deadlift
instructions: Set up for a sumo deadlift, grip the barbell.
Lift, pause at knee height.
Hold briefly, then complete the lift; reset and repeat for desired reps.

name: Mini Band Around The World Plank
instructions: Loop band around wrists, hold high plank position.
Move one hand forward, outward, then back in circular pattern.
Alternate sides, keeping hips level and core braced.

name: Cardio Single Leg Forward Hop
instructions: Pick up one leg off the ground.
Hop forward and backward quickly while staying on your toes.

name: QL Mobilisation Floor Foam Roller
instructions: Lie on the floor keeping your knees bent and the feet on the floor.
Place a massage ball under your lower back and move around till the ball presses into a tight/sore spot.
If you use a foam roller you would have to be seated and leaning back into the roller.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Single Arm Thruster
instructions: Hold two dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing inward.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing one dumbbell overhead.
Lower dumbbell as you descend again, alternating arms each rep.

name: Bodyweight Alternating Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Place the barbell on your back
Step your foot back and around while simultaneously bringing the weight down.
Return to start and repeat on other leg.

name: Dumbbell Decline Guillotine Bench Press
tags: How to do Dumbbell Decline Guillotine Bench Press
How To Do A Dumbbell Decline Guillotine Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the decline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position

name: Side Lunges
tags: How To Do A Side Lunges
instructions: Take a slow, lateral step to the right.
Extend the left knee, and drive your weight into your right side.
Flex your knee and lower your body.
Push back to the starting position.

name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Unilateral On Box
instructions: Stand on the edge of a box, knees extended.
Bend one leg while allowing the weight to push the heel of your straight leg towards the ground.
You should feel your calves being stretched.

name: Machine Reverse Hyperextension
instructions: Lay on the pad and grab the handles.
Slip your legs into the belt loop.
Push your legs back until they are horizontal with the ground.
Lower back to the starting position.

name: Double Pigeon Pose
tags: How To Do A Double Pigeon Pose
How to do Double Pigeon Pose
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Place a block under your left knee, then bend your right knee and stack it on top of your left ankle.
Flex both feet and gently press your knees towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your hips.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then switch sides and repeat.

name: Machine Back Extension
instructions: Sit on the machine and place your upper back on the rolling pad.
Extend your hips and lower back. Make sure not to hyperextend your spine.

name: Pushup to Renegade Row
tags: How to do Pushup to Renegade Row
How To Do A Pushup to Renegade Row
instructions: Start in a high plank position with a pair of dumbbells positioned under your shoulders. Your hands should grip the dumbbells, palms facing each other.
Keep your core engaged and your back straight as you row one dumbbell up towards your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: Plate Squat
tags: How To Do A Plate Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a weight plate in front of your chest with both hands.
Keep your back straight, lower your body as if you were sitting back into a chair.
Go as low as you can while keeping your heels flat on the ground, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Pendlay Row
tags: How to do Dumbbell Pendlay Row
How To Do A Dumbbell Pendlay Row
instructions: The dumbbells should be placed on the floor.
Hinge forward with a flat back and grab the dumbbells.
Pull both dumbbells back and your elbows toward the ceiling.
Return the dumbbells back to the floor softly on each rep.

name: Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise
How to do Kettlebell Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sitting comfortably on a chair with your core stomach muscles engaged, place your feet on the floor.
Place the kettlebell on your legs, just above the knees and raise your heels upwards off the floor.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Barbell Low Bar Good Morning
tags: How To Do A Barbell Low Bar Good Morning
How to do Barbell Low Bar Good Morning
instructions: Place the bar between your traps and rear delts. Pull your shoulder blades back to give the bar a shelf to sit on.
Push your hips back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings. This means you're nearing the end of your Range of Motion with out rounding your spine.
When you feel the stretch push your hips forward until you'e in a standing position.

name: I Into W
instructions: Lie on your front with your arms extended and above your head.
Point the thumbs up. Try to raise your arms off the ground keeping them straight.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit tall with one dumbbell at your side, palm facing inward.
Lift arm outward until shoulder height, keeping elbow slightly bent.
Lower smoothly and repeat, keeping torso still.

name: Stability Ball Goblet Wall Squat
instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall at about hip height.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Break at the hips and knees until you hit parallel or just below, then squat back up.

name: Barbell Bent Over Row
tags: How To Do A Barbell Bent Over Row
How to do Barbell Bent Over Row
instructions: Grab a barbell with a shoulder width pronated or supinated grip.
Bend forward at your hips while maintaining a flat back.
Pull the weight toward your upper abdomen.
Lower the weight in a controlled manner and repeat.

name: Bodyweight Ninety Ninety Hip Stretch
instructions: Sit with one leg in front of you flat on the ground.
While the other leg is to your side, also flat on the ground with your foot pointed backwards.
Hold this position for the prescribed amount of time then change sides.

name: Dumbbell Internal Rotation
instructions: Lay flat on the ground with your elbow on the floor and dumbbell pointed toward the ceiling.
Lower the dumbbell until your knuckles get close to the ground. Then back to the starting position.

name: Plate Hip Abduction
instructions: Stand tall holding plate against outer thigh or anchored between legs.
Lift leg outward to the side while keeping torso still and toes forward.
Lower slowly under control, maintaining tension on outer hip.

name: Cardio Knee Taps
instructions: Stand straight, feet hip-width apart, engage core.
Lift knees alternately, tap with same side hand.
Continue rhythmically, maintain posture, increase speed as able.

name: Lat And Lateral Line Stretch
instructions: Start from the standing position with an upright posture.
Cross your right leg over the left and raise your right arm over your head.
Lean towards your left and reach with your right arm as far to the left as possible.
Repeat on the opposite side by crossing the left leg over the right.
You can do the same exercise against a wall or by holding onto a pull-up bar.

name: Band Face Pull
tags: How to do Band Face Pull
How To Do A Band Face Pull
instructions: Anchor the band at eye level. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Use an overhand grip with both hands. Pull the band to the bridge of your nose flaring your elbows out.

name: Dumbbell Incline Skullcrusher
instructions: Set bench to incline and hold dumbbells above chest with palms facing in.
Bend elbows to lower dumbbells toward forehead under control.
Extend arms fully, squeezing triceps at the top.

name: Landmine Russian Twist
tags: How to do Landmine Russian Twist
How To Do A Landmine Russian Twist
instructions: Start sitting on the ground facing the landmine attachment, holding the end of the bar in both hands slightly in front of and above your chest while holding your feet off the ground and knees bent.

Bending your elbows as little as possible and keeping your core tight and feet elevated, lower the end of the bar with control to the ground on one side of your body, then contract your obliques to return the bar to the center. Repeat on the other side.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Half Lotus
tags: How To Do A Half Lotus
instructions: Sit on a yoga mat with legs straight in front of you.
Bend the right knee and place the right foot on top of the left thigh. Allow the right knee to fall towards the floor.
Bring the left foot onto the right thigh. Keep the spine straight and rest hands on the knees.
Hold for several breaths and then release.

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Fly
instructions: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at chest height with slight arm bend.
Bring arm across chest in a smooth arc without rotating your torso.
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly to starting position.

name: Plate Single Leg Deadlift
tags: How To Do A Plate Single Leg Deadlift
How to do Plate Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Engage your core and straighten your legs to lift the plate off the ground.
Stand on one leg, keeping the other leg off the ground, while holding the plate in front of your body.
Keep your back straight and maintain a neutral head position while looking straight ahead.
Lower the plate back down to the ground while keeping your balance on one leg.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Single Arm Floor Fly
instructions: Lie on your back holding one dumbbell above chest with palm turned downward.
Lower arm out wide while keeping internal rotation and slight elbow bend.
Bring dumbbell back over chest, squeezing pec at the top.

name: Dumbbell Flat Preacher Curl
instructions: Start with a with a dumbbell in one hand and your tricep resting on flat bench.
From this starting position, curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary on the bench.

name: Seated Ulnar Nerve Slider
instructions: Abduct your arm at 90° palm facing down.
Bend your elbow and wrist bringing your front of your fingertips to your temple while leaning the head towards the the arm.
Lean the head away from the arm as you extend the elbow and flex the wrist.
Alternate between positions to mobilise the ulnar nerve.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Arnold Press
tags: How to do Dumbbell Alternating Arnold Press
How To Do A Dumbbell Alternating Arnold Press
instructions: Start in a standing position

name: Plate Russian Twist
tags: How To Do A Plate Russian Twist
How to do Plate Russian Twist
instructions: Start by sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground
Engage your core muscles by pulling your belly button toward your spine.
Slowly twist your upper body to the right, keeping your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold for a second and then twist to the left, holding for another second.

name: Cable Standing Leg Extension
tags: How To Do A Cable Standing Leg Extension
How to do Cable Standing Leg Extension
instructions: Stand upright facing away from the cable crossover with the cable set to the height of your hips. Use an ankle/wrist attachment.
Extend at the knee against the cable.

name: TRX Rear Delt Row
tags: How To Do A TRX Rear Delt Row
How to do TRX Rear Delt Row
instructions: Stand facing away from the TRX straps and grab the handles with both hands.
Step away so your body is leaning away from the anchor point.
Flex your elbows and pull your elbows straight back behind your body.
Make sure to keep your elbows flared outward.

name: Barbell Clean And Press
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, grip barbell just outside thighs.
Explosively extend hips and pull bar to shoulders in one motion.
Press overhead until arms lock out, then lower bar under control.

name: Bodyweight Single Leg Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
instructions: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on a plate or low box.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Incline Reverse Curl
tags: How to do Dumbbell Incline Reverse Curl
How To Do A Dumbbell Incline Reverse Curl
instructions: Lay on an incline bench.
Grab the dumbbells with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
Flex at the elbows until your biceps touch your forearms. Try not to let your elbows flair outward.

name: Smith Machine Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Start by sitting on a bench or box with the bar resting on your knees. Your feet should be flat on the ground, about hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell for support, and lift your heels off the ground.
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back to the ground.

name: Barbell Behind The Back Wrist Curl
tags: How to do Barbell Behind The Back Wrist Curl
How To Do A Barbell Behind The Back Wrist Curl
instructions: Stand straight and hold the barbell behind you using a pronated grip with your hands and feet shoulder-width apart.
Slowly curl your wrists in a semi-circular motion upwards.
Hold the barbell at the apex of the motion and then slowly lower the barbell back down to starting position.

name: Barbell Toes Up Calf Raise
tags: How To Do A Barbell Toes Up Calf Raise
How to do Barbell Toes Up Calf Raise
instructions: Begin by standing on a raised surface (such as a step or box) with the balls of your feet on the edge of the surface and your heels hanging off. Hold a barbell across your upper back and shoulders, using an overhand grip.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels up as high as you can.
Lower your heels back down to the starting position, allowing your calves to stretch.

name: Cable Half Kneeling Low To High Wood Chopper
instructions: Set the cable at a low position. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust
How to do Kettlebell Single Leg Hip Thrust
instructions: Sitting on the floor with one knee bent with the foot firmly on the floor and one leg extended, lean your back against the bench.
Resting the kettlebell on your pelvis, raise your pelvis until your stomach, pelvis and thighs are in line.
Slowly lower until you are in the starting position and repeat.

name: Medicine Ball Lateral Lunge Slam
tags: How to do Lateral Lunge Slam
How To Do A Lateral Lunge Slam
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball.
Step laterally, performing a lunge, then slam the ball.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: Stability Ball Atomic Push Up
instructions: Place feet on a stability ball, hands on the floor in a push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the floor, then push up while tucking knees toward your chest.
Extend legs back to starting position, maintaining control and stability throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Row
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell in one hand.
Bend at hips, row kettlebell to chest.
Alternate hands for each row.

name: Machine Seated Shrug
instructions: Have a seat on the machine, and grab each handle.
Pull your shoulder blades straight up toward the ceiling.

name: Kettlebell Curl
instructions: Grab two kettlebells, stand tall.
Curl kettlebells toward chest.
Lower kettlebells, repeat.

name: Cable Reverse Bayesian Curl
instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Rower Pike
instructions: Place your feet on the rower seat and get in to a plank position.
Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.

name: Cable Rope Pullover
instructions: Use a rope attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Imagine trying to pull the attachment through your thighs at the bottom.

name: Quads Stretch Variation One
tags: How To Do A Quads Stretch Variation One
How to do Quads Stretch Variation One
instructions: Stand perpendicular to a wall, using one arm against the wall for balance. With your other arm, grab the top of your foot.
Pull your leg upwards and back to engage your quads, pausing at the apex of the stretch for a few seconds.
Return to starting position and repeat with your other leg.

name: Bodyweight Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
instructions: Put your shoulder blades on a bench. Both feet on a low box or a plate.
Start with your hips up.
Drop your hips and then push your hips up toward the ceiling.

name: Easy Pose Neck Stretch
tags: How to do Easy Pose Neck Stretch
How To Do A Easy Pose Neck Stretch
instructions: Begin by sitting cross-legged on the floor.
Slowly drop your chin towards your chest, feeling a stretch in the back of your neck.
Inhale and lift your head up, then exhale and drop your right ear towards your right shoulder.
Hold for a few breaths, then switch sides and repeat the stretch.

name: Pyramid Pose Blocks
tags: How to do Pyramid Pose Blocks
How To Do A Pyramid Pose Blocks
instructions: Begin in Tadasana (Mountain Pose) with two blocks at the top of your mat.
Step your left foot back about 3-4 feet and place your heel down, keeping your toes pointing forward.
Place the blocks on either side of your right foot at a height that allows you to comfortably place your hands on them.
Inhale and lengthen your spine, then exhale and fold forward from your hips, bringing your hands to the blocks. Hold for several breaths, then switch sides and repeat.

name: Biceps Stretch Variation Three
tags: How To Do A Biceps Stretch Variation Three
How to do Biceps Stretch Variation Three
instructions: Bend your arm at the elbow, raising your hand to your shoulder.
Using your other hand, stretch the arm down to its full extent.

name: Seated Quad Stretch
instructions: Sit against the wall with one leg slightly bent.
Wrap a stretch strap or towel around your ankle and pull the heel towards the hips.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers Walk
instructions: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, walk for a specified distance or duration.
Stay upright and don't lean to one side.

name: Band Hip Adduction
tags: How To Do A Band Hip Adduction
How to do Band Hip Adduction
instructions: Attach a band to a stable anchor point, such as a door handle or post.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your ankles.
Keeping your feet together, move your legs out to the sides and then back to the midline of your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Lower back Stretch Variation One
tags: How to do Lower back Stretch Variation One
How To Do A Lower back Stretch Variation One
instructions: Sit on the floor with the tops of your feet pointed and flat on the ground. Move your arms out in front of you in the diving position, placing your palms flat against the ground.
With your arms fully extended, rest your buttocks on the heels of your feet, you can crawl your hands forward to extend the stretch if need be.
Hold the extended position for a few seconds, and return to starting position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hold a kettlebell with palms facing down.
Lift kettlebell toward shoulders, squeezing biceps, then lower with control.

name: Single Arm Rapunzel Pushdown
tags: How To Do A Single Arm Rapunzel Pushdown
How to do Single Arm Rapunzel Pushdown
instructions: Stand with a band anchored to a high point. Face away from the band. Hold the loop in one hand.
Keep your elbow tucked in to your side. Extend your elbow. When you extend, don't let your upper arm raise. The band should land over your shoulder.

name: Calf Raise 1B Bilateral Floor
instructions: From the standing position, shift your weight onto the balls of your feet
Raise the heels off the ground, before lowering them back to the ground
Do not rest at the bottom. As soon as you feel your heels touch the ground, repeat the movement
You should feel your calves working

name: Bodyweight Knee Plank Up Down
instructions: Start from a kneeling plank position.
Go to one elbow then the other. Try to avoid rocking back and forth.

name: TRX Squat
tags: How To Do A TRX Squat
instructions: Hold the two TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point.
Flex at the hips and knees in to a squat position.
You can use your arms and the straps to assist you back into the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Plank Arm Lift
instructions: Start in a plank position.
Raise your arm out in front of you.
Return to the starting position, then raise the opposing arm.
Make sure to keep your hips stable. If you're unable to, try performing this exercise from the knees.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Calf Raise
instructions: Standing straight with a kettlebell in a goblet position, raise your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Bench Wrist Extension
instructions: Grab two dumbbells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Bulgarian Split Squat
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Goblet Bulgarian Split Squat
How to do Dumbbell Goblet Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Holding the dumbbell in a goblet squat place your foot on a bench or box.
Break at the hips and knees. Try to go to the point where your hamstring is parallel with the ground. Or until your back knee taps the floor.
Make sure to keep your back flat and your elbows directly under your fists.

name: Medicine Ball Pushup
instructions: Place hands on medicine ball, in push-up position.
Perform push-up, maintaining proper form.

name: Bodyweight Step Up Knee Drive
instructions: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box, bring your off leg all the way through until your leg is parallel with the ground.
Step back down with your right foot, lowering your left foot to the ground.

name: Cable Kneeling Oblique Crunch
instructions: Kneel sideways to cable and hold rope behind head, elbows pointed out.
Crunch torso toward hip on cable side, keeping hips stable.
Slowly return to upright, maintaining constant tension on obliques.

name: Glute Bridge
tags: How To Do A Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie down with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Push your hips up so that your butt is elevated and your back straight.
Tense your glutes and raise your hips towards the ceiling.
Once you are at the highest point you can manage, hold the position for a few seconds, and then slowly return to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Goblet Side Step Up
instructions: Begin by standing beside a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height, holding a dumbbell with a goblet grip.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box.
Step back down with your right foot.

name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Take a shoulder width, double overhand or mixed grip.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Kettlebell Gorilla Row
instructions: Stand with kettlebell between legs.
Hinge at hips, grab kettlebell, pull to chest and rotate at the torso

name: Mountain Climber
tags: How To Do A Mountain Climber
instructions: To perform a bodyweight mountain climber, start in a plank position with your hands placed directly under your shoulders.
Bring your right knee towards your chest, keeping your foot close to your hand. Quickly switch legs, bringing your left knee towards your chest.
Continue this movement, alternating legs, at a quick pace for a set amount of time or repetitions.

name: Barbell Larsen Bench Press
tags: How To Do A Barbell Larsen Bench Press
How to do Barbell Larsen Bench Press
instructions: Start in a bench press position with your legs elevated. Try to keep your knees with a slight bend in them.
Unrack the bar then initiate the rep.
Bring the bar to your torso and tap your ribcage before pressing back to the ceiling.

name: Barbell Suitcase Carry
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart with the bar on the ground at your side.
Lift the bar to your side and walk for the allotted amount of time or distance.
Set the bar down and switch sides.

name: Smith Machine Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand facing away from the machine, positioning your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart to provide a stable base, and then reach behind you to firmly grip the bar with both hands, maintaining an overhand grip.
Initiate the movement by leaning backward, allowing your upper body to incline while simultaneously bending your knees. As you descend, maintain control
drive through your quadriceps while pushing your hips forward, gradually straightening your knees. Maintain a slow, controlled pace

name: Cable Bayesian Curl
instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
How to do Dumbbell Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
instructions: Lay on an incline bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement. You should have an overhand grip.
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

name: TRX Lateral Lunge
tags: How To Do A TRX Lateral Lunge
How to do TRX Lateral Lunge
instructions: Grasp the TRX handles with both hands and extend your arms straight in front of you.
Step laterally to one side, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged.
Lower your body into a lunge position, keeping your front knee bent at a 90-degree angle and your back leg straight.
Push off your front foot to return to the starting position, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged.

name: Smith Machine Seated Overhead Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support. Raise the bar to shoulder height with your palms forward.
Raise the bar upwards and pause at the contracted position.
Lower the weight back to starting position.

name: Smith Machine Sumo Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stance width can vary with a sumo DL. Some prefer toes near the plates. Others prefer a more narrow stance to get more drive off the floor.
Make sure your arms are inside your legs. The bar should be just over your mid-foot. Flatten your back and unrack the bar
Leave your knees mostly extended and flex and extend your hips.

name: Cable High Internally Rotated Reverse Fly
instructions: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arms. Internally rotate the shoulders.
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

name: Cardio Band Seal Jacks
instructions: Loop a band around your back. Start with both arms extended at your side.
As you perform the jack. Bring both arms together and make a little clap.

name: Landmine Sit Up
tags: How to do Landmine Sit Up
How To Do A Landmine Sit Up
instructions: Lay flat on the ground and hold the end of the bar with your arms extended.
Raise your back off the ground until you are sitting at a 90 degree angle.
Then lower slowly back to the floor.

name: Bodyweight Russian Twist
tags: How to do Bodyweight Russian Twist
How To Do A Bodyweight Russian Twist
instructions: Hover your heels just off the ground.
Stick your chest out and maintain a flat back. Make all the movement happen at your mid and upper spine.
Point your chest to the left, then rotate at the spine until your chest is pointed right.

name: Trap Bar Staggered Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand inside trap bar. Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Push Press
instructions: Hold dumbbell at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip slightly at knees, then drive upward, pressing dumbbell overhead.
Lock out arm briefly, then lower dumbbell under control.

name: Elbow Extensor Isometric Seated Overhead Dumbbell
instructions: Sit on a box or bench without any back support.
Raise the weight over your head and extend your elbow.
From there, bend the elbow 1/4 of the way.
Hold isometrically for the prescribed amount of time.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Single Arm Press
tags: How to do Dumbbell Alternating Single Arm Press
How To Do A Dumbbell Alternating Single Arm Press
instructions: Start in a bench press position with two dumbbells.
Break at one of your elbows first while keeping the other elbow extended.
Your working arm should reach your side before pressing back to the ceiling.
Then alternate to the other arm.

name: Abductor Leg Raise Side Lying
instructions: Stabilise yourself in the side lying position, using your upper arm and under leg
Raise your upper leg till it is parallel to the ground. This is your starting point.
Raise your leg and lower back to parallel for the specified amount of reps and/or sets
Feel your bum (glute med) and the lateral line of your leg worked

name: Crunches
instructions: Lay flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the ground, about a foot from your lower back.
Place your fingertips on your temples with your palms facing out.
Draw your belly into the base of your spine to engage the muscles, then raise your head and shoulders off the floor. Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
tags: How to do Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
How To Do A Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
instructions: Hold two dumbbells by your side.
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push through your right heel to return to standing, bringing your left leg back to starting position.
Repeat the movement on the other side, stepping backwards with your right leg and lowering your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground and your left knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.

name: Cable Incline Bench Press
instructions: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set fairly low.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

name: Band Pushup
tags: How To Do A Band Pushup
instructions: Loop the band around your mid-back. The ends of the bands should be around your hands between your thumb and pointer finger.
This exercise can be done from the knees or the toes depending on experience level.
Begin by breaking at the elbows until your upper arm is by your side. Then extend at the elbows back into the top position.

name: Barbell Front Raise
tags: How to do Barbell Front Raise
How To Do A Barbell Front Raise
instructions: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the barbell. Raise your arms until your fists are around eye level.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.

name: Plate Staggered Pinch Grip Deadlift
tags: How To Do A Plate Staggered Pinch Grip Deadlift
How to do Plate Staggered Pinch Grip Deadlift
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding two plates with a pinch grip.
Place one foot slightly behind the other, with the heel of your back foot elevated.
From this starting position, bend at the hips and knees to lower the plates towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.

name: Decline Push Up
tags: How To Do A Decline Push Up
How to do Decline Push Up
instructions: Use a bench to elevate your feet.
Put your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Slowly lower your body until your chest almost touches the ground
Raise your body until you almost lock your elbows.

name: Cable Rope Kneeling Face Pull
instructions: Start with the cables at the top. Use a rope attachment. Fall to a half kneeling position.
Pull the metal piece in the middle of the rope to the bridge of your nose.

name: Towel Knee Extension Hold
instructions: Sit on the floor and use your palms to lean back into.
Place a rolled towel under your knee so it is slightly bent.
Try to squeeze the towel between the back of your knee and the ground by extending the leg.

name: Machine Hamstring Curl
tags: How to do Machine Hamstring Curl
How To Do A Machine Hamstring Curl
instructions: Lay down on the machine, placing your legs beneath the padded lever. Position your legs so that the padded lever is below your calve muscles.
Support yourself by grabbing the side handles of the machine, and slowly raise the weight with your legs, toes pointed straight.
Pause at the apex of the motion, then slowly return to starting position.

name: Laying Bent Leg Raise
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Raise both knees towards your chest.
Lower back down without touching the floor; repeat for desired reps.

name: Hamstrings Stretch Variation One
tags: How To Do A Hamstrings Stretch Variation One
How to do Hamstrings Stretch Variation One
instructions: Lie down with your legs reaching up the wall. your bum should be slightly off the floor.
Bend one leg and leave the other outstretched.
Push your thigh towards the wall.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then return to starting position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Rear Delt Row
instructions: Hinge at hips with back flat, holding kettlebell under shoulder.
Pull elbow out and back at a wide angle, targeting rear delt.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.

name: Medicine Ball Reverse Lunge Twist
tags: How to do Reverse Lunge Twist
How To Do A Reverse Lunge Twist
instructions: Hold medicine ball at chest.
Step back into lunge position, extend your arms, twist torso.
Return to starting position. Repeat on other leg.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Hammer Incline Curl
instructions: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
Take a neutral grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Floor Incline Leg Raise
instructions: Sit on the floor and lean back into your palms or on your elbows.
Raise a straight leg a few centimeters off the ground and hold the position for the specified duration.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Incline Curl
instructions: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Floor Knee Pull Bilateral
instructions: Lie on your back with bent knees.
Hug your knees and pull them towards your chest.
Feel your lower back come off the ground.
You can add a you can add an abduction to target the hips as well.

name: Barbell Snatch Grip High Pull
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, gripping the barbell with a wide (snatch-width) grip. Keep your back straight, chest up, and bar close to your body.
Drive through your legs, extending your hips, knees, and ankles while pulling the barbell up explosively.
Shrug your shoulders forcefully and pull the bar as high as possible, keeping elbows above the bar.
Lower the bar back to the starting position in a controlled manner and reset for the next rep.

name: Narrow Pulldown
instructions: Use the Straight Bar attachment.
Hold the attachment as you sit on the machine and put your legs under the leg pads.
Pull the bar to your clavicle, then raise back up until your arm are extended.

name: Knee Pull And Lumbar Rotation
instructions: Lie on your back and flatten you lower back against the ground
Pull one knee towards your chest and then across your body till it forces your lower back into a rotated position.

name: Hip Extension 4Pt Position Hold
instructions: Start on the 4 point position (on all fours).
Straighten and raise one leg till it is parallel to the ground.
Make sure your spine remains in a neutral position.
If you feel your lower back stiff or sore when performing this exercise, ask a trainer or therapist to guide you through.

name: TRX Hammer Curl
tags: How to do TRX Hammer Curl
How To Do A TRX Hammer Curl
instructions: Grab the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point.
Maintain a neutral grip. Flex your elbows and pull your fists to either sides of your temples.

name: Kettlebell Single Leg Calf Raise
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Single Leg Calf Raise
How to do Kettlebell Single Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the same foot as the side without the kettlebell off the floor.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Mini Band Mountain Climber
instructions: Loop band around feet, start in high plank.
Drive one knee toward chest against resistance.
Alternate legs quickly while keeping hips stable.

name: Hamstring Stretch Supine Static
instructions: Place a theraband or stretch strap around your foot.
Lie back onto the ground.
Raise your leg to stretching point with the aid of the band (strap).
Tug onto the strap on the end of range to dynamically stretch the hamstring.

name: Cable Single Arm Incline Bench Press
instructions: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set fairly low.
Bring the handle across your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulder and elbow simultaneously.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Crunch
instructions: Place your feet under the foot pads and grab the handles with your hands.
Flex your spine and bring your upper and lower body together.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Alternating Overhead Press
tags: How to do Dumbbell Neutral Alternating Overhead Press
How To Do A Dumbbell Neutral Alternating Overhead Press
instructions: Start with two dumbbells near your shoulders with a neutral grip.
Press one of the dumbbells toward the ceiling while keeping the other in position.
Let the first dumbbell return to its starting position before pressing the other.

name: Inverted Row
tags: How To Do A Inverted Row
instructions: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: Plate Halo
tags: How To Do A Plate Halo
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate held in front of your face with both hands, palms facing each other.
Rotate the plate around the head, keeping the arms extended and moving the plate in a circular motion.
Complete one full circle, then reverse the direction to complete another circle.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Reverse Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbell with palm facing down and arm straight by your side.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder, leading with back of hand.
Lower slowly to starting position, keeping wrist stable.

name: Kettlebell Hang Clean And Jerk
instructions: Hold kettlebells just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
Explosively pull kettlebells to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press kettlebells overhead until arms are fully extended.

name: Cable Oblique Pushdown
instructions: Set the cable just over your head. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, push the handle down until your elbow is extended. Flex your obliques until you feel a contraction.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Full Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand up straight with dumbbells at either side, palms facing your hips.
Raise your arms on either side with a slight bend in your elbow until they are over head. Pause at the top of the motion.
Slowly return your arms down to starting position.

name: Kettlebell Kickstand Squat
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind. Hold kettlebell in a goblet position.
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Press
tags: How to do Dumbbell Single Arm Press
How To Do A Dumbbell Single Arm Press
instructions: Start by laying on a bench with two dumbbells.
Position the dumbbell above your chest with your elbow bent and shoulder level.
Slowly lower the dumbbell towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged while the other dumbbell remains pointed toward the ceiling.
Once the dumbbell reaches your side, pause for a moment and then press the weight back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to your other arm.

name: Bodyweight Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
tags: How to do Bodyweight Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
How To Do A Bodyweight Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
instructions: Start by lying on your back with your knees bent and feet in a staggered position on the box.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips off the floor, making sure to keep your feet and knees pointing forward.

name: Kettlebell Conventional Deadlift (Double)
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Bend at hips and knees to lift kettlebells.
Stand tall, then lower.

name: Trap Bar Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold trap bar, stand tall with slight knee bend.
Hinge hips back, lowering bar along thighs.
Keep back neutral and tension in hamstrings.
Drive hips forward to return upright.

name: Bosu Ball Burpee
instructions: Stand on Bosu with feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into squat position and place hands on Bosu.
Jump feet back into plank, perform a pushup, then jump back to squat.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Floor Press
instructions: Start flat on your back with a kettlebell extended over you.
Bring your elbow to the floor, rest for a second to remove all the momentum from the rep, then press to a lockout.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Floor Fly
instructions: Lie on your back holding one kettlebell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arm out wide until elbow lightly touches the floor.
Bring kettlebell back over chest, squeezing pec at the top.

name: Oblique Crunch
instructions: Lie on your side, knees bent, hands behind head.
Bring your elbow towards your knees and flex your obliques.

name: Plate Reverse Lunge Twist
tags: How To Do A Plate Reverse Lunge Twist
How to do Plate Reverse Lunge Twist
instructions: Step back with your right foot into a lunge position, both knees bent at 90 degrees.
Twist your torso to the right, keeping the plate close to your chest.
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Laying Incline Lateral Raise
instructions: Lay on your side on an incline bench. Brace yourself by holding onto the bench.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, raise the dumbbell to the side.
The end of the range of motion is when the dumbbell is pointed toward the ceiling.
Make sure you don't flex and extend your elbow.

name: TRX Hand Plank
tags: How To Do A TRX Hand Plank
How to do TRX Hand Plank
instructions: Start by facing away from the TRX straps and placing your feet in the TRX handles with your palms on the ground.
Lift your knees off the ground to begin the set.
Engage your core and maintain this position for the desired amount of time, holding a steady plank.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the ground with a bench behind you. Have the bar over your legs just above your hips.
Lean back against the bench so that your shoulders are resting upon it, stretch your arms out to either side using the bench as support.
Raise the weight by driving through your feet and extending your hips upwards. Support the weight with your shoulders and feet.
Slowly extend as far as you can, and then slowly return to the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Calf Raise
