Press arms straight up until elbows extend without locking.
Lower elbows back to floor under control, keeping tension throughout.

name: Medicine Ball Halo
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hold a medicine ball.
Circle the ball around your head, maintaining control.
Complete the desired number of repetitions in both directions.

name: Scapular Elevation
instructions: From the standing or seated position straighten your back.
Pull the shoulders back but keep them relaxed.
Move shoulders towards from your ears and return to the starting, relaxed position.

name: Shoulders Stretch Variation Four
tags: How To Do A Shoulders Stretch Variation Four
How to do Shoulders Stretch Variation Four
instructions: Stand with you feet shoulder width apart. Place one arm across the front of your chest at shoulder height, press the forearm of your other arm above the elbow, hooking the stretching arm with your hand.
Press the arm until it is straight and rotate your upper torso to engage the stretch even deeper.
Repeat with your other arm.

name: Plate Reverse Lunge
tags: How to do Plate Reverse Lunge
How To Do A Plate Reverse Lunge
instructions: Hold the plate at chest height close to your body
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push through your right heel to return to standing, bringing your left leg back to starting position.
Repeat the movement on the other side, stepping backwards with your right leg and lowering your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground and your left knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.

name: Half Kneeling Hip Hinge
instructions: Place one knee on a bench.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Clamshells 3 Internal External Rotations Side Lying
instructions: Lay on your side with knees bent. 90° angle at hips, knees and feet.
Lift your top leg a few centimeters off of the under leg (15-20cm)
Externally rotate the top knee without dropping your hip back.
Hold for a split second (or as indicated by therapist/trainer) and then internally rotate the knee

name: Downward Dog
tags: How To Do A Downward Dog
instructions: Begin on your hands and knees with your hands shoulder-width apart and your knees hip-width apart.
Spread your fingers wide and press down into your palms, making sure that your fingers are evenly spaced and facing forward.
Tuck your toes under and lift your knees off the ground, straightening your legs as much as possible.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulder blades spread apart, and try to press your heels down towards the ground.
Hold the pose for several breaths, then release and return to your starting position.

name: Cable Cross Pushdown
tags: How To Do A Cable Cross Pushdown
How to do Cable Cross Pushdown
instructions: Either use two handles or no attachment at all. Both sides of the cable crossover should be set to the top.
Stand in the center of the machine holding each Cable in the opposing hand. Your upper arm should be at a 45 degree angle with your torso.
Extend your elbows until you feel a contraction and then return to the starting position

name: Cable Single Arm Underhand Grip Row
instructions: Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a handle attachment. Face your palm upward.
Pull the handle back using your arms. Push out your chest.
Pull the handle towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

name: Curve Treadmill
instructions: Get the treadmill up to a comfortable speed where you are doing a walk.

name: Band Squat Hold Single Arm Row
instructions: Anchor the band to a stable point and take a half squat position.
Hold the band loop in one hand and pull your elbow straight back.

name: Restful Cow Face Pose Legs
tags: How To Do A Restful Cow Face Pose Legs
How to do Restful Cow Face Pose Legs
instructions: Start in a seated position with your legs extended in front of you.
Cross your right leg over your left leg, placing your right foot on the floor beside your left hip.
Cross your left leg over your right leg, placing your left foot on the floor beside your right hip.
Relax your arms by your sides or place them on your abdomen and take deep breaths.

name: Dumbbell Decline Squeeze Press
tags: How to do Dumbbell Decline Squeeze Press
How To Do A Dumbbell Decline Squeeze Press
instructions: Lay flat on a decline bench with two dumbbells pressed to one another.
Break at the elbows and keep your elbows tucked as you bring the dumbbells to your chest.
Continue to press the dumbbells into one another throughout the rep.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, press back toward the ceiling.

name: Kettlebell Goblet Good Morning
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Goblet Good Morning
How to do Kettlebell Goblet Good Morning
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your chest.
Bend forward at the hips keeping your back and knees straight and the kettlebell close to your chest.
Return to standing position and thrust your pelvis forward.

name: Cable Braced Single Arm Internally Rotated Chest Fly
instructions: Stand sideways to cable, hinge forward, and hold handle at shoulder height with an internally rotated shoulder.
Brace free hand against support, then bring working arm across chest in an arc.
Squeeze chest at the end, then slowly return to starting position.

name: Glute Hip Rotator Stretch 3 Seated
instructions: Sit on a bench.
Cross the ankle of one leg over the knee of the other.
Push your knee away from you and lean forward for a specified amount of time.

name: Mini Band Glute Bridge
instructions: Loop band above knees, lie on back knees bent.
Drive through heels, lift hips until fully extended.
Lower slowly, keeping knees pressed outward.

name: Smith Machine Situp
instructions: Set up the Smith machine bar at an appropriate height.
Lie on your back beneath the bar, gripping it with your hands.
Engage your core, lift your upper body toward the bar, and exhale.
Lower your upper body back down in a controlled manner, inhaling.

name: Medicine Ball Chest Press Toss
tags: How to do Chest Press Toss
How To Do A Chest Press Toss
instructions: Stand in front of a wall holding a medicine ball.
Press the ball forward, extending arms and tossing it.
Catch the ball and return to the starting position.

name: Bench Lift Off Active
instructions: While seated on a bench, place your palms on the bench by your sides
Palm placement should allow room for the fingers to grip the edge of the bench
Try to lift your bodyweight off the bench by pushing the palms into the bench
Lockout your elbows and repeat or hold isometrically

name: Hip Extension External Rotation 4Pt Position
instructions: Start on the 4 point position (on all fours).
Straighten and raise one leg till it is parallel to the ground.
Maintain the position but externally rotate the leg (knee aims out)
If you feel your lower back stiff or sore when performing this exercise, ask a trainer or therapist to guide you through.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Curl
tags: How to do Kettlebell Single Arm Curl
How To Do A Kettlebell Single Arm Curl
instructions: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in one hand with your forearm facing out.
Raise the kettlebell, bending your arm at the elbow and keeping your forearm vertical until your palm faces the shoulder.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

name: Glute Hip Rotator Stretch 1 Seated
instructions: Sit on a bench.
Cross the ankle of one leg over the knee of the other.
Press the knee of the crossed leg outwards.

name: Triceps Stretch Variation Two
tags: How to do Triceps Stretch Variation Two
How To Do A Triceps Stretch Variation Two
instructions: Hold a band so it is in line with your spine. Hold the top with your right hand and the bottom with your left.
Keeping the top still, pull down on the band.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then repeat with the other arm.

name: Kettlebell Bench Wrist Extension
instructions: Grab two kettlebells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Extension
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Wrist Extension
How to do Dumbbell Wrist Extension
instructions: Grab two dumbbells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across your knees.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

name: Trap Bar Squat
instructions: Stand inside trap bar, feet shoulder-width, grip handles.
Sit hips down and back, keeping chest upright.
Lower until thighs are at least parallel.
Push your heels into the floor and squat back to a standing position.

name: Stretcher
instructions: Place your foot on the leg pad for leverage and grab the attachment.
Start with your arms extended and your head between your arms.
Begin to pull. As you pull, lean backwards until the attachment touches your chest.

name: Mini Band Laying Hip Flexion
instructions: Loop band around feet, lie flat on back.
Lift one leg upward, keeping knee straight.
Lower slowly and alternate sides under control.

name: Table Top Pose Variation 2
tags: How to do Table Top Pose Variation 2
How To Do A Table Top Pose Variation 2
instructions: Start in a tabletop position on your hands and knees with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Turn your hands so that your fingers are pointing towards your knees and the tops of your hands are on the floor.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold the pose for several breaths or as long as is comfortable.

name: Plate Hollow Hold
tags: How to do Plate Hollow Hold
How To Do A Plate Hollow Hold
instructions: Lay flat on the ground with your arms extended over head holding a weight plate.
Pick your upper back and your legs off the ground. Your body should be in a banana shape.

name: Band Seated Single Arm Pulldown
instructions: Sit facing anchor with band overhead, holding handle in one hand.
Pull elbow down toward your hip while keeping chest tall.
Squeeze lat at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.

name: Band Low To High Pallof Press Wood Chopper
instructions: Stand sideways to band anchored low, holding handle at chest with both hands.
Press arms straight forward, then rotate torso pulling band diagonally upward.
Return to center and bring hands back to chest under control.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back, arms extended upward, legs raised with knees bent.
Lower opposite arm and leg to floor, keeping back pressed against ground.
Alternate sides, maintain core engagement, and repeat for desired reps or time.

name: Table Top Pose Variation 3
tags: How to do Table Top Pose Variation 3
How To Do A Table Top Pose Variation 3
instructions: Come onto your hands and knees on the mat with your wrists directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Turn your palms down and spread your fingers wide, with your fingertips pointing towards your knees.
Press into your palms and extend your arms fully to lift your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, and then release by slowly lowering your hands to the mat and coming back to a neutral tabletop position.

name: Kettlebell Walking Farmers March
instructions: Standing straight with kettlebells, start walking towards a set point. Pulling your knee up toward the ceiling.
Make sure to keep your chest tall and shoulder blades pulled back.
Try to keep your stride distance roughly the same.

name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge
tags: How to do Dumbbell Forward Lunge
How To Do A Dumbbell Forward Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other.
Take a big step forward with your right foot, lowering your hips until your right thigh is parallel to the ground and your left knee is hovering just above the floor.
Push through your right heel to straighten your right leg and return to the starting position.

name: Barbell Side Step Up
tags: How To Do A Barbell Side Step Up
How to do Barbell Side Step Up
instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with a barbell on your shoulders. Your feet should be slightly pointed outward, and your shoulders should be down and relaxed.
Place a step or box beside you, and step up onto it with one foot. Your other foot should remain on the ground.
Push off your grounded foot, raising your body up onto the step.
Step back down with the same foot, returning to the starting position.

name: Monkey Pose
tags: How To Do A Monkey Pose
instructions: Begin in a low lunge with your right foot forward and your left knee on the ground.
Slowly slide your left knee back while extending your right leg forward, keeping both legs straight.
Lower your body down to the ground, using your hands for support if needed.
Hold the pose for a few breaths, then switch sides and repeat.

name: Plate Staggered Deadlift
tags: How To Do A Plate Staggered Deadlift
How to do Plate Staggered Deadlift
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a weight plate.
Place one foot slightly behind the other, with the heel of your back foot elevated.
From this starting position, bend at the hips and knees to lower the plate towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Once the plate is below your knees, drive through your heels to stand back up to the starting position.

name: Seated Radial Nerve Tensioner
instructions: Bend your elbow bringing your thumb to the centre of your chest.
Extend your elbow to the side with the palm facing back, and wrist flexed
As your extending the arm, lean your head towards the opposite shoulder
Once you reach maximum tension (without pain) hold the position

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
tags: How to do Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
How To Do A Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand with a shoulder width stance. Push your butt back while leaving your knees MOSTLY extended.
You should feel a stretch in your hamstrings. When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward to complete the rep.
Do not push your hips all the way forward. This will hyperextend your spine. Just go to a normal standing position.

name: Swipe Around
instructions: Lie on your front, arms above head. Squeeze glutes to protect lower back
Raise your chest and arms off the ground. Adduct (bring your arms by your hips)

name: Band Glute Kickback Hold
instructions: Attach a band to a fixed point. Wrap the loose end of the band around your ankle.
Face the attachment point. Shift you weight onto one leg (use balancing aids if needed).
Extend your working leg and maintain the position.

name: Band Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
tags: How To Do A Band Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
How to do Band Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
instructions: Place the band at about eye level. Fall into a kneeling position.
The knee that is on the ground should be the same side as the working arm. Stick your chest out.
And then pull your elbow straight back. Flex your lats and then extend into the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge
tags: How To Do A Bodyweight Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge
How to do Bodyweight Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge
instructions: Start by lying on your back with your knees bent and feet on top of a sturdy box, bench or elevated surface.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips off the floor, making sure to keep your feet and knees pointing forward.

name: Band Pull Apart
tags: How to do Band Pull Apart
How To Do A Band Pull Apart
instructions: Grab the band with a shoulder width grip. Point your arms straight in front of you.
Retract your shoulder blades and shoulder joint until the band taps your chest.

name: Forearms Stretch Variation One
tags: How To Do A Forearms Stretch Variation One
How to do Forearms Stretch Variation One
instructions: Place your palm flush against the wall.
Take one step forward and straighten your arm slowly to extend your bicep.
Hold at the peak of the stretch.
Return to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
tags: How to do Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
How To Do A Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
instructions: With dumbbells in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Arch your back above your knees, and start with the weights touching in front of your chest.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Press your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat position, thighs parallel to the floor, knees above ankles.
Hold the position, maintaining tension in your core and legs.

name: Machine Squat Press
instructions: Place your legs on the platform with your feet at shoulder width.
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the pad. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.

name: Kettlebell Single Leg Single Arm Calf Raise
instructions: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the opposing foot off the floor.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: TRX Curl
tags: How To Do A TRX Curl
instructions: Hold the TRX straps with an underhand grip and lean back and away from the anchor point.
Keep your elbows high as you flex your elbows. Pull your fists toward your forehead.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up
instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a kettlebell at one shoulder.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
tags: How to do Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
How To Do A Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Find a box or bench that is roughly knee height or a few inches lower. (The lower the box is the lower the mobility requirement).
You can either place your toes or the top of your foot on the box. Point your front foot forward or slightly turned outwards and break at the knees and hips simultaneously.
Aim to get your front leg to hit parallel depth (hamstring parallel with the ground) or lower.
The further forward your front foot is, the longer the Range of Motion is at your hips. The further back your front foot is, the longer the ROM at your knees.

name: Kettlebell Half Kneeling Goblet Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Place one knee on a bench and hold a kettlebell in a goblet position.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Bodyweight Hand Plank Jack
instructions: Start in high plank, hands under shoulders, body straight.
Jump hands outward simultaneously while keeping feet planted and core tight.
Jump hands back under shoulders, maintaining stable hips and spine.

name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Unilateral On Wall
instructions: Stand by a wall but not too close.
Place the palms on the wall and extend one leg behind you, while slightly bending the front leg.
Push the wall in order to drive the heel of the extended leg into the ground till you feel a stretch in your calf.

name: Barbell Drag Curl
instructions: Grab a barbell with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

name: Cable Braced Wrist Extension
instructions: Stand facing cable, brace forearm on support with palm down holding handle.
Lower wrist slowly to feel stretch in top of forearm.
Extend wrist upward, contracting forearm extensors fully.

name: Dumbbell Drag Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides with palms forward and elbows tight to body.
Curl dumbbells by dragging them along torso, moving elbows behind you.
Squeeze biceps at top, then lower slowly to start position.

name: Barbell Conventional Pause Deadlift
instructions: Set up for a standard deadlift, grip the barbell.
Lift, pause at knee height.
Hold briefly, then complete the lift; reset and repeat for desired reps.

name: Bosu Ball Single Leg Elevated Glute Bridge
tags: How to do Single Leg Elevated Glute Bridge
How To Do A Single Leg Elevated Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back, place one foot on Bosu, knee bent.
Lift hips, squeezing glutes, one leg extended.
Lower hips back down and switch legs.

name: Plate Good Morning
tags: How To Do A Plate Good Morning
How to do Plate Good Morning
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, the plate held behind the neck and the knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping the back straight, until the torso is parallel to the floor.
Push through the hips to return to the starting position.

name: Cable Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Bring a bench over to the cable stack, put the cable at head height (when seated). Use an ankle attachment.
Sit on the bench.
Flex at the knee and pull your ankle straight back.

name: Slalom Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands directly under shoulders.
Drive knees toward left elbow.
Go back to starting position, then drive knees to right elbow, mimicking a zigzag slalom motion.

name: Band Squat
tags: How To Do A Band Squat
instructions: Stand with a shoulder width grip. Both feet should be on the band with the band loops in each of your hand.
Push your butt back and also break at the knees.
Try to hit parallel depth (bottom of your leg should be parallel with the ground). If you can't tell your squat depth, then try squatting in front of a mirror and watch your form.

name: Cable Rope Single Arm Low Lateral Raise
instructions: Use a rope attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arms straight out to the side.
Raise until your arms are parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.

name: Barbell Landmine Row
tags: How to do Barbell Landmine Row
How To Do A Barbell Landmine Row
instructions: Position a barbell in a landmine or corner of a room and stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the end of the barbell with a neutral grip, keeping your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the ground.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together as you row the weight up.

name: Kettlebell Quad Stomp
instructions: Place your foot on a plate or a low box. Hold two kettlebells in each hand.
Put all of your weight on your front foot and lean forward.
Lower until your calves touch your hamstrings and then extend back up.

name: Cable Quadruped Hip Abduction
instructions: Use an ankle attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the bottom.
Take a quadruped position with the cable going across your planted leg.
Abduct at the hips and raise your leg out to the side.
Return to the starting position and stop just short of the cables touching back down (to keep tension on the muscle).

name: Kettlebell Tate Press
tags: How to do Kettlebell Tate Press
How To Do A Kettlebell Tate Press
instructions: Lie flat on your back. Keeping your arm straight, hold the kettlebell above your chest with your palm facing away from your body.
Bend your arm, touching the kettlebell to the top of the shoulder opposite to the arm being worked.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Smith Machine Split Squat
instructions: Take a large step forward with one leg until your shoulders are under the smith machine
lower your body until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Your front knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle, and your back leg should be straight.
Push through the heel of your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.

name: Cable Belt Squat
instructions: Put on a dip belt. Attach the strap/chain to the cable's carabiner.
Take a few steps back. Begin to squat by flexing at the knees and hips.
Let the weight pull you forward as you squat. Then push your toes through the front of your shoes as you squat back to the start position.

name: Biceps Stretch Variation One
tags: How To Do A Biceps Stretch Variation One
How to do Biceps Stretch Variation One
instructions: Stand one foot in front of the other with the wall to your right, an arms width away.
Place your hand on the wall, fingers pointing away from you.
Gently lean forward, keeping your hand stationary.
Repeat with the other arm.

name: Dumbbell Guillotine Incline Bench Press
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Guillotine Incline Bench Press
How to do Dumbbell Guillotine Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the incline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out. As you lower the dumbbells, exhale deeply.
Once your elbows reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Long Lever Russian Twist
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Long Lever Russian Twist
How to do Dumbbell Long Lever Russian Twist
instructions: Start by sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground. Hold a dumbbell in both hands with your arms extended straight in front of you.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing the dumbbell towards the ground, then return to the center. Repeat on the left side, twisting to the left and bringing the dumbbell towards the ground.
Continue this twisting motion, alternating sides, for the desired number of repetitions. Keep your core engaged and avoid swinging your arms to generate momentum.

name: Kettlebell Preacher Curl
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Preacher Curl
How to do Kettlebell Preacher Curl
instructions: Stand behind a bench, with your chest leaning over the edge of the bench.
With one arm resting on the bench, hold the kettlebell, bending the arm at the elbow.
Lower your arm using the bench as a guide, keeping your forearm straight.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Bench Braced Reverse Incline Curl
instructions: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
Take an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: EZ Bar Reverse Preacher Curl
instructions: Sit on preacher bench, grip EZ bar overhand at shoulder width, elbows resting on pad.
Curl bar towards chin, keep elbows stable.
Lower bar slowly to starting position, maintaining control throughout.

name: Kettlebell Wrist Extension
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Wrist Extension
How to do Kettlebell Wrist Extension
instructions: Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, with your forearms facing inwards.
Flex your wrist upwards until wrists are fully extended.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Bottoms Up Single Arm Overhead Press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding one kettlebell with the bottom of the kettlebell facing up.
Bring the kettlebell to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the kettlebell are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Cable Half Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper
instructions: Set the cable just over your head. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Chest Press
instructions: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Decline Neutral Bench Press
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Decline Neutral Bench Press
How to do Dumbbell Decline Neutral Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the decline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Mini Band Alternating Bent Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Loop band around elbows, arms bent 90 degrees at sides.
Raise one elbow outward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly and alternate, keeping tension on band.

name: Bodyweight Standing Hamstring Curl Isometric
instructions: Stand up straight using a balancing aid.
Shift your weight on one leg.
Bend the non-weight bearing leg and hold.
Knees should remain aligned.

name: Bodyweight Pike Shrug
instructions: Start in a plank position and raise your hips toward the ceiling.
Slowly lower your body (scapula) while keeping your elbows locked (this is key)
Slowly raise your body back to the start position.

name: Mini Band Plank Glute Kickback
instructions: Loop band around feet, hold high plank.
Extend one leg back, squeezing glute at top.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Forward Lunge
tags: How To Do A Forward Lunge
instructions: Step forward with one leg and lower your body until your front thigh is parallel to the floor and your back knee almost touches the ground. Keep your chest up and your front foot flat on the floor.
Push through your front foot to straighten your legs and return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your other leg.

name: One Arm Cow Face Pose
tags: How to do One Arm Cow Face Pose
How To Do A One Arm Cow Face Pose
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your left knee and place your left foot on the floor, close to your right hip.
Cross your right leg over your left leg, stacking your knees on top of each other.
Bring your left arm up overhead, and bend your elbow so that your left hand reaches towards your upper back. Reach your right hand behind your back and try to clasp your left hand. Hold

name: Machine Dips
instructions: Sit on the machine and grab the handles.
Press the handles down until your elbows are nearly extended.

name: Seated Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit upright on bench or box.
Hold dumbbells at sides
Lift arms to shoulder height.

name: Barbell High Bar Good Morning
tags: How To Do A Barbell High Bar Good Morning
How to do Barbell High Bar Good Morning
instructions: Place the bar on your traps. You may need a pad so the bar doesn't dig into your cervical spine.
Push your hips straight back. Your knees should stay MOSTLY extended (think soft knees). Also make sure to
Look for what feels like a stretch in your hamstrings. The stretch feeling means you're likely nearing the end of your Range of Motion without rounding your spine.
When you feel the stretch push your hips forward until you're in a standing position.

name: Standing Neck Mobility Circumductions
instructions: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back
Circumduct the head both clockwise and anti-clockwise making sure you  are working on the end range throughout the movement.

name: Machine Hip Adduction
instructions: Sit in the machine with your legs apart, pads against your outer thighs. Adjust the seat and pad position comfortably.
Slowly squeeze your legs together, focusing on using your inner thigh muscles. Pause when the pads are close together.
Slowly return to the starting position, maintaining control. Avoid letting the weights slam. Repeat for desired reps and sets.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand or sit tall holding dumbbell at your side with palm facing inward.
Curl dumbbell toward shoulder while keeping elbow tight to torso.
Squeeze bicep, then lower slowly to full extension under control.

name: Hamstrings Stretch Variation Two
tags: How to do Hamstrings Stretch Variation Two
How To Do A Hamstrings Stretch Variation Two
instructions: Stand with one foot in front of the other.
Bend your rear leg as much as you can, keeping the front leg straight.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then return to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Glute Bridge
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Single Leg Glute Bridge
How to do Dumbbell Single Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Start by lying on your back with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell on your hips.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Laying 30 Degree Shrug
tags: How to do Dumbbell Laying 30 Degree Shrug
How To Do A Dumbbell Laying 30 Degree Shrug
instructions: Lay sideways on a bench letting your arm hang freely.
Pull your shoulder blade and joint toward the ceiling.

name: Skydiver
instructions: Lie on your front with your arms by your side, palms facing down.
Tense your back muscles to raise both ends of your body off the ground.
Keep your core engaged as you will be supporting your weight on your belly.

name: Child Pose Elbows On Block
tags: How to do Child Pose Elbows On Block
How To Do A Child Pose Elbows On Block
instructions: Place two blocks on the floor, shoulder-width apart.
Kneel in front of the blocks, and lower your torso down so that your elbows are resting on the blocks, and your forehead is resting on the floor.
Relax your arms, shoulders, and neck, and breathe deeply.
Hold for a few breaths, then release.

name: Bosu Ball Forearm Plank
tags: How To Do A Forearm Plank
instructions: Place forearms on Bosu, elbows under shoulders.
Extend legs, keeping body straight.
Hold the plank position, engaging core.

name: Dumbbell Standing Tibialis Raise
instructions: Place your heels on a step or plate, and hold dumbbells to your side.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.
Hold at the top for extra benefit. Slowly return to the starting position.

name: Landmine Staggered Romanian Deadlift
tags: How To Do A Landmine Staggered Romanian Deadlift
How to do Landmine Staggered Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand in a staggered position. With the back leg bent and the front mostly extended.
Push your hips back until you feel a stretch through your front hamstring.
Push your hips back forward until you are standing.

name: Barbell Seated Full Front Raise
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with an overhand grip on the barbell. Raise your arms until your fists are pointed toward the ceiling.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.

name: Plate Lateral Lunge
tags: How To Do A Plate Lateral Lunge
How to do Plate Lateral Lunge
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the plate held in front of the torso.
Take a step to the side with one foot, bending the knee and lowering the hips into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side by stepping to the other side with the other foot.

name: Cardio Single Leg Lateral Hop
instructions: Pick up one leg off the ground.
Hop laterally quickly while staying on your toes.

name: Barbell Reverse Deadlift
tags: How to do Barbell Reverse Deadlift
How To Do A Barbell Reverse Deadlift
instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with your toes pointed slightly outward.
Place a barbell on the floor behind you, with the weight plates on either side.
Bend down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
Stand up straight, lifting the barbell off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.

name: Kettlebell Superman
instructions: Begin by lying face down on the floor with a kettlebell in each hand, arms extended.
Lift your chest and legs off the ground simultaneously while squeezing your glutes and raising the kettlebells.
Lower your body and kettlebells back to the floor, then repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Glutes Stretch Variation Three
tags: How To Do A Glutes Stretch Variation Three
How to do Glutes Stretch Variation Three
instructions: Lay flat and bring your left leg to 90 degrees.
Hold your left leg with both hands and slowly rotate your hips to the right hand side.
Hold at the peak of the stretch, then slowly return to starting position.
Switch sides and repeat.

name: Cable Single Arm Bayesian Curl
tags: How To Do A Cable Bayesian Curl
How to do Cable Bayesian Curl
instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: TRX Forearm Plank
tags: How to do TRX Forearm Plank
How To Do A TRX Forearm Plank
instructions: Lie face down on the ground and place your forearms on the ground directly under your shoulders.
With your feet in the stirrups, kick both feet into the TRX straps and hold the handles above your head.
Tighten your abs, glutes, and legs to form a straight line from your head to your feet.

name: Plate Pinch Grip Deadlift
tags: How To Do A Plate Pinch Grip Deadlift
How to do Plate Pinch Grip Deadlift
instructions: Stand facing the plate with your feet shoulder-width apart and the plate positioned between your feet.
Bend down and grasp the plate from the top edges with both hands, making sure your thumbs and fingers are evenly spaced.
Keep your back straight, chest up and core engaged, and stand up with the plate, keeping it close to your body.
Lower the plate back down to the ground, keeping control and maintaining good posture.

name: Plate Bicep Curl
tags: How To Do A Plate Bicep Curl
How to do Plate Bicep Curl
instructions: Hold plate in both hands.
Flex your elbows until the plate nears your chest.
Extend your elbows until they are fully extended.

name: Mini Band Plank Hand Step Out
instructions: Loop band around wrists, hold high plank.
Step one hand outward against band tension.
Return and alternate, keeping hips level.

name: Cardio In In Out Out Shuffle
instructions: Start with your feet side by side.
Bring one foot laterally, then the other.
Return the first foot to its starting position, then the other.

name: Kettlebell Incline Bench Press
instructions: Position the bench between 30 and 45 degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the kettlebells to your mid chest
Raise the kettlebells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers March
instructions: Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the knee of one leg off the floor to knee height.
Bring the leg back to standing and repeat with the other leg, keeping the kettlebell on the same side.
Repeat.

name: Stability Ball Wall Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, placing a stability ball between your lower back and wall.
Slowly squat down by bending knees to 90 degrees, keeping back straight and core engaged.
Press through heels, straighten legs, and return to standing while maintaining balance and control.

name: Dumbbell Supinated Row
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Supinated Row
How to do Dumbbell Supinated Row
instructions: Grab both dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips. Make sure you keep a flat back.
The closer your torso is to parallel with the ground the longer the range of motion will be at your shoulder. The better the results you'll get from the exercise.
Let your arms hang freely, maintain an underhand grip, and then pull your elbow joint straight back toward the ceiling.

name: Machine Bicep Curl
instructions: Adjust the seat to fit your height and place your elbows on the elbow pad.
Grab the handles and flex your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Lateral Lunge
instructions: Hold one dumbbell with one or both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step out to one side, bending the knee.
Push off, return to center, then switch sides.

name: Band Reverse Curl
tags: How To Do A Band Reverse Curl
How to do Band Reverse Curl
instructions: Start by standing on the center of the band with both feet, shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with both hands, palms facing down, arms extended straight in front of you.
Slowly curl your hands towards your shoulders, pulling the band tight, then lower your arms back to the starting position, keeping tension on the band throughout the exercise.

name: Dumbbell Floor Fly
instructions: Lie on your back holding dumbbells above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arms out wide until elbows lightly touch the floor.
Bring dumbbells back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.

name: Dumbbell Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Grab a stick of some sort or hold onto something stable (rack, bench).
Grab a box that is knee height or slightly lower.
Hold the stick in your right arm, dumbbell in the other and put your right leg on the box.
Begin your squat by breaking at the knees. Get your knee close to the floor or all the way to the floor. Make sure to keep your chest tall.

name: Cable Incline Chest Fly
instructions: Place the cable anchor at a lower level than your shoulders.
Sit on the bench, leave your elbows mostly extended.
Bring your fists together and flex your pecs.

name: Machine Goblet Sissy Squat
instructions: Place the sissy squat pad just behind the knees and the front pad all the way up against your ankles.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Sit straight back into a squat. Then push your calves into the back of the pad and extend your knees back to the original position.

name: Machine Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Adjust the pad to suit your height.
Grab the v bar (or other attachment) and extend your elbows until they are almost fully extended.
Flex your elbows and look to feel a stretch at the bottom of each rep.

name: Glute Stretch Knee Pull Dynamic Standing
instructions: Stand up straight with a good form.
Alternate between pulling your knees towards you chest.
Make sure you maintain an upright posture throughout the movement.

name: Adductor Raise Side Lying Long Lever
instructions: From the side lying position, place your upper leg on a bench
Raise your hips off the ground by pressing your leg into the bench

name: Frog Sit Up
instructions: Lay on your back with knees bent and your feet together.
Keep your arms extended overhead. Swing your arms to generate some momentum and sit up.

name: Landmine Single Arm Overhead Press
tags: How To Do A Landmine Single Arm Overhead Press
How to do Landmine Single Arm Overhead Press
instructions: Stand in front of the landmine with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent. Grasp the landmine barbell with one hand, palm facing in, and bring it to shoulder height with your elbow tucked beneath your hand.

Press the barbell overhead by extending your arm fully, pushing the weight upward. Keep your core engaged, your back straight, and your shoulder down throughout the movement. Pause briefly at the top of the movement with your arm fully extended overhead. Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position at shoulder height with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps on one side before switching sides.

name: Dumbbell Box Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart with a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

name: Bodyweight Partial Step Down
instructions: Stand on platform with one foot hanging off edge.
Lower hanging foot toward floor by bending standing knee slightly.
Drive through standing heel to return upright under control.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single Arm Hammer Curl
instructions: Hold dumbbell at side with palm facing inward, elbow tight to body.
Curl dumbbell upward while maintaining neutral grip throughout.
Lower under control, keeping tension on biceps and forearm.

name: Cardio Band Press Jacks
instructions: Stand with the band looped under both feet and the other end of the band in both hands in an overhead press position.
Do a light hop and bring both feet outward while pressing the band overhead.

name: Hip Flexor Stretch Kneeling Lunge 1
instructions: Bring yourself to kneeling lunge position. Keep a 90° angle at knees.
Slide the front knee forward while gently leaning back.
Squeeze the glute on the side of the leg that's to the front to avoid lower back complaints.

name: Plate Clean And Press
tags: How To Do A Plate Clean And Press
How to do Plate Clean And Press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the feet.
Bend the knees and hips to pick up the plate, keeping the back straight and core engaged.
Stand up, lock the hips and legs, and press the plate overhead with straight arms.
Lower the plate back to the starting position, keeping control of it, and repeat for desired reps.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Single Arm Row
How to do Kettlebell Single Arm Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, shifting one foot behind you. Hold the kettlebell in the same hand as the leg shifted backwards.
Bend forwards at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knee, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

name: Cable Pallof Press Rotation
instructions: Use a handle attachment, set the cable at nipple level, walk a few steps away, and face sideways.
Start with both hands on the handle and your fists against your chest.
Press the handle forward until your elbows are fully extended, then rotate away from the cable stack.
Then pull the handle back to your chest.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Squeeze Press
How to do Dumbbell Squeeze Press
instructions: Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells pressed to one another.
Break at the elbows and keep your elbows tucked as you bring the dumbbells to your chest.
Continue to press the dumbbells into one another throughout the rep.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, press back toward the ceiling.

name: Landmine Alternating Lunge To Chest Press
tags: How To Do A Landmine Alternating Lunge To Chest Press
How to do Landmine Alternating Lunge To Chest Press
instructions: Stand facing the landmine with feet hip-width apart and holding the end of the landmine barbell with both hands, keeping elbows bent and close to your body.
Step backward with the right foot, lunge down, and press the landmine away from your chest.
Push through the left heel to return to the starting position while pulling the landmine back to your chest.
Repeat on the opposite side, alternating for the desired number of reps.

name: Plate Rear Delt Fly
tags: How To Do A Plate Rear Delt Fly
How to do Plate Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Keep your back straight and bend forward slightly at the waist.
With arms extended, raise the weights out to your sides until they are in line with your shoulders.
Pause briefly and then lower the weights back to the starting position.

name: Landmine Hollow Hold
tags: How to do Landmine Hollow Hold
How To Do A Landmine Hollow Hold
instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your legs extended towards the landmine attachment and your arms overhead, holding the landmine barbell with both hands while engaging your core muscles by pressing your lower back into the ground and drawing your belly button in towards your spine.
Lift your legs off the ground, keeping them together and straight, and simultaneously raise your upper body off the ground, reaching the landmine barbell away from your face.
Hold this position for the desired duration, then carefully lower the barbell to the ground.

name: Triceps Stretch Variation Three
tags: How to do Triceps Stretch Variation Three
How To Do A Triceps Stretch Variation Three
instructions: Bend your left arm so your hand is at your shoulder, and hold your elbow with the opposite hand.
Gently push on your elbow so it is raised by your head.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then repeat with the other arm.

name: Dumbbell Side Plank Up Down
tags: How to do Dumbbell Side Plank Up Down
How To Do A Dumbbell Side Plank Up Down
instructions: Start by lying on your side with your feet stacked on top of each other and a dumbbell on your hip.
Place your bottom elbow on the ground beneath your shoulder and engage your core to raise your hips off the ground.

name: Abductor Leg Raise Side Lying Isometric
instructions: Stabilise yourself in the side lying position, using your upper arm and under leg
Raise your upper leg till it is parallel to the ground and hold isometrically for the specified amount of time.
Feel your bum (glute med) and the lateral line of your leg worked

name: Bosu Ball Squat
instructions: Stand on Bosu, feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, keeping knees aligned with toes.
Push through heels to stand back up.

name: Dumbbell Incline Curl
instructions: Hold the dumbbells with an underhand grip. Seated on an incline bench.
Slowly lift the dumbbell up to chest height
Return to starting position and repeat.

name: Plate Curl To Overhead Press
tags: How to do Plate Curl To Overhead Press
How To Do A Plate Curl To Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso, palms facing forward.
Curl the plate up to the front of the shoulder while keeping the elbows close to the body.
Rotate the palms to face forward and press the plate overhead, locking out the arms.
Lower the plate back to the starting position, keeping control of it, and repeat for desired reps.

name: Single Leg Concentric Squat
instructions: From the standing position lower your body into a squat.
Shift your weight onto one leg (the other is still in contact with the ground for balance).
Use the loaded leg to lift your body into standing position.

name: Cable Rope Front Raise
instructions: Face away from the cables. Use a rope attachment.
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.

name: Bodyweight Box Assisted Dips
instructions: Grip the edge of the boxes with your hands, Keep your feet together and legs straight.
Lower your body straight down.
Slowly press back up to the starting point.
TIP: Make this harder by raising your feet off the floor and adding weight.

name: Crow Pose
tags: How To Do A Crow Pose
instructions: Begin in a squatting position with your feet together and your knees apart.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you, shoulder-width apart. Keep your arms straight and engage your core.
Slowly shift your weight forward and lift your feet off the ground, coming onto your tiptoes.
Bend your elbows and lean your weight onto your hands, shifting your knees towards your upper arms.
Gently lift one foot off the ground, and then the other, balancing on your hands. Hold the pose for a few breaths before releasing back to the ground.

name: Kettlebell Hip Thrust
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Hip Thrust
How to do Kettlebell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sitting on the floor with your knees bent and feet planted firmly on the floor, lean your back against the bench.
Resting the kettlebell on your pelvis, raise your pelvis until your stomach, pelvis and thighs are in line.
Slowly lower until you are in the starting position and repeat.

name: Cable Bar Romanian Deadlift
tags: How To Do A Cable Romanian Deadlift
How to do Cable Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Start with a straight bar or ez bar attachment set to the bottom of the machine. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back
Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.

name: Barbell Close Grip Bench Press
tags: How to do Barbell Close Grip Bench Press
How To Do A Barbell Close Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With a narrow grip on the bar, straighten your arms
Lower the bar to your lower-mid chest
Slowly raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Cable Rope Rolling Pushdown
instructions: Stand facing cable holding rope, elbows bent, and shoulders flexed.
First extend your shoulders (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbows.

name: Smith Machine Side Plank Up Down
instructions: Start by lying on your side with your feet stacked on top of each other and the bar on your hip.
Place your bottom elbow on the ground beneath your shoulder and engage your core to raise your hips off the ground.

name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Standing straight with a dumbbell in one hand, lift the same foot as the side without the dumbbell off the floor. Hold onto something for balance.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Cardio Lateral Shuffle
instructions: Start with a wide stance.
Shuffle sideways for a specified distance while maintaining a quarter squat position.

name: Cable Single Arm 30 Degree Shrug
instructions: Use a handle attachment. With the cable attachment set all the way to the bottom.
Grab one handle and make sure you are centered in the machine. Let your arm hang freely.
Pull your shoulder blade up and in towards your ears. Let your shoulder blade depress back to the starting position.

name: Ez Bar Upright Row
instructions: Take a double overhand roughly shoulder width grip.
Pull your elbows straight up the ceiling. Aim to get the bar to chin level or slightly higher.

name: Ring Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Stand facing rings and grab the handles.
Step forward so that your body is in a plank position, with your arms straight and your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Chest Press
instructions: Lie on bench holding one dumbbell above chest with arm extended.
Lower dumbbell toward chest while keeping torso stable and level.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting.

name: Thoracic Flexion And Extensions
instructions: Bring yourself on all 4's. Push the ground away from you, rounding back and shoulders as much as possible.
To enhance the spine flexion suck the belly button in and tuck the tailbone (coccyx) under. Hold this position for a brief moment
Now do the exact opposite, try to bend the spine backwards. Go back and forth on these positions

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Sit on the machine and grab the handles with an overhand grip.
Adjust the machine to get the longest range of motion possible.
Press until your elbows are not extended but not hyperextended.

name: Dumbbell Bent Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a 90 degree bend at your elbows.
Lateral raise your arms straight out to the side until your arms are about parallel with the ground.

name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding kettlebells in front.
Hinge at hips, keeping back straight, and lower kettlebells towards ground.
Return to start position, squeezing glutes at the top.

name: Machine Assisted Pull Up
instructions: Adjust weight for assistance. Stand on platform, grip handles above shoulder-width. Knees on pad if available.
Slowly pull up until chin is above the bar. Keep elbows close, core engaged.
Lower back with control. Pause at bottom. Repeat for reps.

name: Cardio Quick Feet
instructions: Quickly tap each foot to the ground.

name: Barbell Behind The Back Shrug
instructions: Hold barbell behind your hips with overhand grip, arms straight.
Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears without bending elbows.
Lower slowly, maintaining tension in traps throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Reverse Curl
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hold kettlebell with palms facing down.
Lift kettlebell toward shoulders, squeezing biceps, then lower with control.

name: Barbell Landmine Side Bend
tags: How To Do A Barbell Landmine Side Bend
How to do Barbell Landmine Side Bend
instructions: Stand straight and hold the end of the Barbell
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
Return to the upright position.
Switch hands and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Clean And Jerk
instructions: Swing kettlebell between legs, then pull it up to rack position.
Dip slightly, drive through legs, and press kettlebell overhead.
Lower back to rack, then swing down for next repetition.

name: Dumbbell Full Front Raise
instructions: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the dumbbell. Raise your arms until your fists are pointed toward the ceiling.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.

name: Dumbbell Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the ground with a bench behind you. Place both feet on a plate or low box. Have the dumbbell over your legs just above your hips.
Lean back against the bench so that your shoulders are resting upon it, stretch your arms out to either side using the bench as support.
Raise the weight by driving through your feet and extending your hips upwards. Support the weight with your shoulders and feet.
Slowly extend as far as you can, and then slowly return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Laying Curl
instructions: Hold the dumbbells with an underhand grip. Seated on a bench.
Start with the dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling, then lower the dumbbells toward your sides.
Fully extend your elbows, but don't let your upper arm fall behind your torso.

name: Box Supported Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Place a box behind you and one foot on it. Keep your chest up and the back straight
Tilt at the hips to perform a deadlift. Use the box for balance and support
Make sure you straighten your back leg when performing the deadlift.
As you get comfortable with the movement, try to lift the leg off the box when you reach the end range of the deadlift.

name: Dumbbell Y Press
instructions: Stand tall, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Press the dumbbells outward into a y shape.

name: Calves Stretch Variation One
tags: How to do Calves Stretch Variation One
How To Do A Calves Stretch Variation One
instructions: Place the ball of your foot against the wall with your heel on the ground. Place your hands on the wall in front of your shoulders.
Keeping your knee straight, slowly lean towards the wall, pause for a few seconds when you feel the stretch extending through your calf muscle.
Return to the starting position, and repeat the stretch with your other leg.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Snatch
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell between legs.
Squat, grip kettlebell, explode hips, and lift kettlebell overhead.
Lower kettlebell safely to start position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Rear Delt Row
instructions: Hinge at hips with back flat, holding dumbbell under shoulder with arm extended.
Pull elbow out and back at a wide angle, targeting rear delt.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to full stretch.

name: Bodyweight Standing Inverted Row
instructions: Grab a door frame or a rack and place your feet near the frame.
Start with your elbows extended, row your body towards your hands.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: Band Good Morning
tags: How To Do A Band Good Morning
How to do Band Good Morning
instructions: Anchor the band at hip level. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Push your hips back while keeping your back flat until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.

name: Glute Ham Raise
tags: How To Do A Glute Ham Raise
How to do Glute Ham Raise
instructions: Position yourself on a glute ham raise machine or find a suitable substitute like a stability ball or bench.
Adjust the equipment to fit your body by setting the footplate at an appropriate height and making sure your feet are securely anchored.
Begin the movement by slowly lowering your upper body towards the ground while keeping your torso and legs aligned.
Once you reach the lowest point where your body is parallel to the ground or as far as you can comfortably go, pause briefly.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings again as you push yourself back up to the starting position, using the strength of your posterior chain muscles.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up
instructions: Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold one dumbbell on your shoulder with an overhand grip.
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench and stand up straight, keeping the barbell at your shoulders.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, to return to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
tags: How to do Dumbbell Overhead Press
How To Do A Dumbbell Overhead Press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the dumbbells are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Alternating Pole Rotation
instructions: Start with the pole in front of you with an overhand wider than shoulder width grip.
Rotate one arm overhead and behind while keeping the other arm in front of you.
Then rotate the other arm.
Bring the original arm back to the starting position, then the other arm. Repeat.

name: Barbell Feet Elevated Glute Bridge
tags: How to do Barbell Feet Elevated Glute Bridge
How To Do A Barbell Feet Elevated Glute Bridge
instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Superman
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Superman
instructions: Lay flat on the ground on your stomach with your arms extended overhead. Hold a dumbbell with a neutral grip.
Lift your legs and chest off the ground simultaneously and hold for a 1 count at the top.
Relax your lower back and lower your legs and chest back to the floor.

name: Machine Plate Loaded T Bar Row
instructions: Hinge forward while keeping your back flat.
Grab the handles and pull the weight toward your chest.
Make sure to fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep. Also make sure to not use momentum.

name: Bodyweight Overhand Inverted Row
instructions: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Row Knee
tags: How to do Dumbbell Single Arm Row Knee
How To Do A Dumbbell Single Arm Row Knee
instructions: Start by placing your elbow on one knee.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand, with your palm facing inwards towards your body.
From this starting position, row the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and your core engaged.

name: Walking Calf Raises
tags: How To Do A Walking Calf Raises
How to do Walking Calf Raises
instructions: Walk forward and push your toe into the ground
Lift you heel off the ground each step and tense your calf muscle
Repeat on each leg and walk forward slowly

name: Hamstring Stretch Supine Dynamic Band
instructions: Place a theraband or stretch strap around your foot.
Lie back onto the ground.
Raise your leg to stretching point with the aid of the band (strap).
Tug onto the strap on the end of range to dynamically stretch the hamstring.

name: Crescent Moon Pose Quad Stretch
tags: How to do Crescent Moon Pose Quad Stretch
How To Do A Crescent Moon Pose Quad Stretch
instructions: Begin in Crescent Moon Pose with your right foot forward and a block nearby.
Place the block at the highest height under your left hand.
Reach your left arm behind you and take hold of your left foot or ankle.

Gently pull your foot towards your buttocks while pressing your left hand into the block to deepen the stretch in your left quad. Hold for a few breaths before releasing and repeating on the other side.

name: TRX Pike
tags: How To Do A TRX Pike
instructions: Place your feet in the stirrups and get in to a plank position.
Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.

name: Landmine Lateral Raise
tags: How To Do A Landmine Lateral Raise
How to do Landmine Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand perpendicularly to the barbell, holding the end of the bar at your outer hip with your inner hand and your palm facing your body.
While keeping your core braced and your arm straight, lift the barbell diagonally up and towards the direction of the landmine attachment, then return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Medicine Ball Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
tags: How to do Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
How To Do A Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
instructions: Kneel with one knee down, holding a medicine ball.
Rotate torso and until the medicine ball is pointed the opposite direction.
Repeat the movement on the other side.

name: Pole Rotation
instructions: Start with the pole in front of you with an overhand wider than shoulder width grip.
Rotate both arms overhead and behind you while leaving your elbows mostly extended.

name: Cable Single Arm Cross Pushdown
instructions: Either use a handle or no attachment at all. The cable crossover should be set to the top.
Stand in the center of the machine holding the cable in the opposing hand. Your upper arm should be at a 45 degree angle with your torso.
Extend your elbow until you feel a contraction and then return to the starting position

name: Dumbbell Staggered Deadlift
tags: How to do Dumbbell Staggered Deadlift
How To Do A Dumbbell Staggered Deadlift
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place one foot slightly behind the other, with the heel of your back foot elevated on a step or weight plate.
From this starting position, bend at the hips and knees to lower the dumbbells towards the ground, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Once the dumbbells are below your knees, drive through your heels to stand back up to the starting position.

name: Barbell High Incline Bench Press
instructions: Position the bench between 45 and 60 degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With straight arms unrack the bar.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the bar (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

name: Kettlebell Hollow Hold
instructions: Grab a kettlebell.
Hold kettlebell above your head, engage core, and maintain position.

name: Plate Weighted Inverted Row
instructions: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip. Place a plate on your chest.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: Bodyweight Tricep Extension
instructions: Begin in a plank position. Hands shoulder width apart. Break at the elbows while letting your elbows fall to the floor.
Extend your elbows until you are back in the starting position.

name: Cable Bent Over Bar Pullover
tags: How To Do A Cable Pullover
instructions: You can use any attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Imagine trying to pull the attachment through your thighs at the bottom.

name: Machine Assisted Narrow Pull Up
instructions: Adjust weight for assistance. Stand on platform, grip handles above shoulder-width. Knees on pad if available.
Slowly pull up until chin is above the bar. Keep elbows close, core engaged.
Lower back with control. Pause at bottom. Repeat for reps.

name: Calf Isometric On Step
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step (on the balls of your feet)
Support your weight in this position for the given amount of time
You should feel your calves working

name: Traps mid back Stretch Variation One
tags: How To Do A Traps mid back Stretch Variation One
How to do Traps mid back Stretch Variation One
instructions: Stand up with your feet shoulder width apart. Place one arm across the front of your chest at shoulder height, press the forearm of your other arm above the elbow, hooking the stretching arm with your hand.
Press the arm until it is straight and rotate your upper torso to engage the stretch even deeper.
Repeat with your other arm.

name: Internally Rotated Seated Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Sit with your chest in your lap, dumbbells in hands, arms bent, internally rotate shoulders.
Raise dumbbells out to sides, squeeze rear delts.
Lower weights, repeat for reps.

name: Cable Single Arm Incline Chest Fly
instructions: Place the cable anchor at a lower level than your shoulders.
Sit on the bench, leave your elbows mostly extended.
Bring your arm across your chest and flex your pec.

name: Cable High Reverse Fly
instructions: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arm.
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

name: TRX Rear Delt Fly
tags: How To Do A TRX Rear Delt Fly
How to do TRX Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Stand facing away from the TRX straps and grab the handles with both hands.
Step forward so that your body is in a plank position, with your arms straight and your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.

name: Plate Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly
tags: How to do Plate Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly
How To Do A Plate Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly
instructions: With plates in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Hinge forward with a flat back.
Maintain an overhand grip and internally rotated shoulders.
Raise your arms backward toward the ceiling while maintaining a light band in your elbows.

name: Cable Seated Bar Face Pull
instructions: Sit facing cable machine and grasp bar with shoulder-width overhand grip.
Pull bar toward upper face while driving elbows outward and back.
Squeeze rear delts at the end, then return bar slowly with control.

name: Plate Overhead Squat
tags: How to do Plate Overhead Squat
How To Do A Plate Overhead Squat
instructions: Hold a weight plate at arm's length overhead, with your arms fully extended. The plate should be directly above your head and your elbows should be locked.
Begin to bend your knees, lowering your body as far as you can while keeping the weight plate overhead. Make sure to keep your back straight and your chest lifted.
Once your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can go, pause for a moment.
Push through your heels to return to a standing position, keeping the weight plate overhead the entire time.

name: Traps Stretch Variation One
tags: How To Do A Traps Stretch Variation One
How to do Traps Stretch Variation One
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.
Place your left hand on your head and gently pull your head down towards your left shoulder. Then return to centre point.
Repeat, using your right hand pulling towards your right shoulder.

name: Band Half Kneeling Single Arm Pulldown
instructions: Kneel facing anchor with band overhead, holding the end of the band in one hand.
Keep torso tall and pull elbow down toward your hip.
Squeeze lat at the bottom, then return arm slowly to starting position.

name: Kettlebell Concentration Curl
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Concentration Curl
How to do Kettlebell Concentration Curl
instructions: Sitting on a chair with your legs apart, rest your arm against your thigh and hold the kettlebell with your arm extended towards the floor.
Bending your arm at the elbow, lift the kettlebell until your palm faces your shoulder.
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

name: Cable Standing Single Arm Incline Chest Press
instructions: Stand sideways to cable with handle set low, holding it at chest height.
Press handle upward and forward at a slight diagonal, keeping torso stable.
Squeeze chest at the top, then return slowly to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Quad Stomp
instructions: Place your front foot on a low box and take a split stance. Put all of your weight on your front foot.
Break at the knees and lower yourself until your calves touch your hamstrings.
Push yourself back to the starting position.

name: Plate Deficit Pushup
tags: How To Do A Plate Deficit Pushup
How to do Plate Deficit Pushup
instructions: Start in a pushup position with both hands on a plate. This will extend your range of motion.
Break at the elbows and shoulders until your upper arm travels behind the body slightly.
Then press back into the original position.

name: Backward Arm Circle
instructions: Hold your arms out to your sides.
Rotate your arms backwards in small circles.

name: Warrior Three
tags: How To Do A Warrior Three
instructions: Start in mountain pose, standing with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Step your left foot back about 3-4 feet and raise it off the ground, while keeping your right foot facing forward.
Inhale and reach your arms forward, parallel to the ground.
Exhale and hinge forward at your hips, bringing your torso parallel to the ground and extending your left leg straight back. Keep your arms and right leg straight and hold the pose for a few breaths
inhale and return to mountain pose. Repeat on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Skullcrusher
instructions: Set bench to incline and hold dumbbell above chest with palmsfacing in.
Bend elbow to lower dumbbell toward forehead under control.
Extend arm fully, squeezing tricep at the top.

name: Band Kneeling Pulldown
instructions: Kneel facing anchor with band overhead and arms extended.
Pull elbows down toward ribs while keeping chest tall.
Squeeze lats at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.

name: Cable Low Bilateral Lateral Raise
instructions: Use a handle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arms straight out to the side.
Raise until your arms are parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.

name: TRX Single Arm row
tags: How To Do A TRX Single Arm row
How to do TRX Single Arm row
instructions: Hold the TRX strap with one hand.
Lean back until the strap is taut. Fully extend your elbow.
Pull your elbow behind the body. Make sure to avoid twisting. Try to keep your shoulders even.

name: Bodyweight Single Leg Calf Raise
instructions: Hold onto something for balance. Raise one foot off the ground.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Glute Piriformis Mobilisation 1 Floor Seated Lacrosse Ball
instructions: Sit on a massage ball distributing your weight between feet, palm and glute.
Lean to the side and try to find a tight/painful spot while wiggling on the ball.
Follow the pain as it shifts around your glute.

name: Cable Bar Curl
instructions: Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Stability Ball Windshield Wiper
instructions: Lie on your back, legs extended, stability ball between your feet, arms out for support.
Engage your core, lift your legs, and rotate them side to side in a controlled motion.
Keep your upper body stable, move slowly, and return to center before switching directions.

name: Bodyweight Butterfly Stretch
instructions: Sit on your butt with your knees bent and feet touching each other.
Grab your feet and lean forward until you feel a stretch in your groin.

name: Mini Band Single Leg Raise
instructions: Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
Lift one leg forward with straight knee.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Cardio Forward Scissor
instructions: Do a light hop and split your stance.
Land lightly on your toes, and then bring the opposing leg forward.

name: Cable Single Arm Face Pull
instructions: Stand facing cable and hold handle at shoulder height with arm extended.
Pull handle toward upper face while driving elbow outward and back.
Squeeze rear delt at the end, then return slowly with control.

name: Cardio Ski Erg
instructions: Leap sideways, land on right foot, left leg behind to the side.
Drop into a single-leg burpee, right leg only, hands to ground.
Return to standing on right, leap sideways to left, repeat with left leg.

name: Smith Machine Side Bend
instructions: Stand beside the bar.
Keep your hips and shoulders facing forward, bend to one side slowly
Return to the upright position.
Switch hands and repeat.

name: Cable Standing Straight Leg Mid Kickback
instructions: Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set to halfway up the crossover machine.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

name: Bodyweight Pop Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start by doing a regular squat, tap the floor, then engage your core and jump up explosively.
Bring your feet mostly together, tap your toes back to the floor, then bring your feet back their original width.

name: Bosu Ball Pushup
instructions: Place hands on Bosu, shoulder-width apart.
Lower chest to the ground, keeping the body straight.
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
tags: How to do Barbell Sumo Deadlift
How To Do A Barbell Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stance width can vary with a sumo DL. Some prefer toes near the plates. Others prefer a more narrow stance to get more drive off the floor.
