Holding a kettlebell in one hand, keeping your arm fully extended with a slight bend in the elbow and your forearms facing upwards, lift the kettlebell above your chest.
Lower the kettlebell to the starting position and repeat.

name: Stability Ball V Up Pass
instructions: Lie on your back, holding a stability ball between your feet, arms extended overhead.
Engage your core, lift your legs and arms, passing the ball from feet to hands.
Lower arms and legs back down, then repeat, passing the ball back to feet.

name: Barbell Banded Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Loop bands under your feet or anchors and around the barbell. Stand tall with soft knees.
Hinge at the hips, keeping the bar close and back straight throughout.
Squeeze glutes, drive hips forward, and return to full standing position.

name: Bodyweight Hip Abduction
instructions: Abduct at the hips and raise your leg out to the side.
Return to the starting position and stop just short of your foot touching back to the ground (to keep tension on the muscle).

name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Goblet Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Place one knee on a bench and hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

name: Landmine Single Arm Staggered Overhead Press
tags: How To Do A Landmine Single Arm Staggered Overhead Press
How to do Landmine Single Arm Staggered Overhead Press
instructions: Stand facing the bar in a split stance with one leg forward and bent and the other back and straight. Hold the bar in the hand on the side of the leg that is back with the end of the bar at your shoulder with your elbow tucked beneath your hand.
Drive the bar upwards until your arm is fully extended. Pause briefly before lowering the end of the bar back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Child Pose Arms On Side
tags: How to do Child Pose Arms On Side
How To Do A Child Pose Arms On Side
instructions: Begin in a tabletop position with your hands and knees on the ground.
Sit back onto your heels and place your arms at your sides with your palms facing up.
Rest your forehead on the ground.
Hold for a few breaths and then release.

name: Barbell Calf Raises
tags: How to do Barbell Calf Raises
How To Do A Barbell Calf Raises
instructions: Place the bar on your back
Start with feet flat on the ground
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Stand tall with two dumbbells. Pull your shoulder blades up. Give a one second squeeze at the top.

name: Bodyweight Thoracic Spine Rotation
instructions: Start on all fours then bring your chest to the ground. Place one hand on the ground in front of you. The other hand behind your head/ear.
On the side of the hand that is behind your head, rotate until your elbow is pointed at the ceiling and then hold this position.

name: Barbell Full Front Raise
instructions: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the barbell. Raise your arms until your fists are pointed toward the ceiling.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.

name: Landmine Split Jerk
tags: How To Do A Landmine Split Jerk
How to do Landmine Split Jerk
instructions: Hold the bar over one shoulder. Stand with a shoulder width stance.
Dip at the hips and knees, generate some momentum and press the bar.
As you press, split your stance. Bring the leg of the working arm back and the other forward.

name: Band Pallof Press To Wood Chopper
instructions: Stand sideways to band, hold handle at chest, and brace your core.
Press arms straight forward, resisting rotation.
Rotate torso and pull band across body in a wood chopper motion, then return.

name: Ring Standing Pushup
instructions: Start by setting up the rings to a secure anchor point and adjust the straps so that they hang about waist height when you stand under them.
Stand facing the rings grab the handles with both hands, and step forward so that your body is in a plank position with your hands directly beneath your shoulders.
Lower your body down by bending your elbows until your chest nearly touches the handles. Keep your core tight and your body in a straight line.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms as you do so. Make sure to engage your chest, triceps, and core throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Hang Clean And Press
instructions: Hold kettlebells just above knees with slight bend in hips and knees.
Explosively pull kettlebells to shoulders, catching it in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press kettlebells overhead until arms are fully extended.

name: Machine Standing Lateral Raise
instructions: Grab the two handles and raise the arms straight out to your sides.

name: Kettlebell Incline Guillotine Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench, hold kettlebell with both hands over chest.
Lower kettlebells, elbows flared.
Press kettlebells upward, fully extending arms. Repeat.

name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Bilateral On Box
instructions: Stand on the edge of a box, knees extended.
Let your weight push your heels towards the ground.
You should feel your calves being stretched.

name: Bodyweight Clapping Push Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest, explode up, clap hands.
Land softly, repeat for reps.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
tags: How to do Dumbbell Upright Row
How To Do A Dumbbell Upright Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding 2 dumbbells in each hand.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted, engage your core to maintain balance.
Begin the movement by lifting the dumbbells straight up towards your chin, keeping your elbow close to your body and the weight in line with your shoulder.
Continue to lift the weight until it reaches the chin or neck level, keeping the elbow high and close to the body.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Push Press
instructions: Hold kettlebell at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip slightly at knees, then drive upward, pressing kettlebell overhead.
Lock out arm briefly, then lower kettlebell under control.

name: Stability Ball Straight Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, heels on a stability ball, legs straight, arms by your sides.
Press through your heels, lift hips, engage glutes and core, forming a straight line.
Slowly lower hips, maintaining control, then repeat for reps.

name: Band Lateral Raise
tags: How To Do A Band Lateral Raise
How to do Band Lateral Raise
instructions: Grab the band at shoulder width. Raise your arms straight out to the side.
The band should scrape against your shirt.

name: Band Shoulder Y Raise
instructions: Hold one end of a band with your arm to the side and behind your body.
Hold the other end in front of your body (overhand grip).
Move your arm away from your body and upward while externally rotating your shoulder.
Finish with your arm over your head and thumb up

name: Band Standing Chest Press
instructions: Loop the band around your back. The two end loops in each of your hands.
Extend your shoulder joint and elbow across your body until your arm is fully extended.

name: Dumbbell Elevated Pushup
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Elevated Pushup
How to do Dumbbell Elevated Pushup
instructions: Start by placing two dumbbells on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the dumbbells, keeping your arms straight.
Keep your feet together, with your toes resting on the floor.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the dumbbells.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Plate Curtsy Lunge
tags: How To Do A Plate Curtsy Lunge
How to do Plate Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso.
Step back and across the body with the right foot, bending both legs to lower into a lunge position.
Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side by stepping back and across with the left foot.
Continue alternating sides for desired reps.

name: Barbell Supinated Pendlay Row
tags: How to do Barbell Supinated Pendlay Row
How To Do A Barbell Supinated Pendlay Row
instructions: Begin by standing in front of a barbell with your feet about hip-width apart and your palms facing towards your body.
Bend at the hips and knees to grab the barbell with a pronated (overhand) grip, positioning the barbell about an inch away from your shins.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, use your back muscles to lift the barbell straight up towards your chest.
As the barbell reaches your chest, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing towards your body (supinated grip), and then lower the barbell back to the starting position.

name: Standing Neck Side Flexions
instructions: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Lean your head to the side (bring your ear to your shoulder) without shrugging your shoulder or leaning the spine to the side.

name: Barbell High Pull
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width, and keep your back straight.
Drive through your legs, extending your hips, knees, and ankles explosively while pulling the barbell upward.
As the bar rises, pull it close to your body, leading with your elbows until it reaches chest level.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Deficit Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbell in a goblet position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.

name: Wrist Extensor Kneeling Hold
instructions: Drape your forearm over a bench.
Hold a dumbbell in a neutral wrist position with your palm facing downwards.

name: Barbell Wrist Extension
instructions: Grab a barbell with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

name: Tip Toe Walking
tags: How To Do A Tip Toe Walking
How to do Tip Toe Walking
instructions: Point your toes into the floor.
Slowly walk forwards and backward
Keep your heels in the air as long as possible while walking.
It may be beneficial to do this last at the end of your workout.

name: Cable Rope Skullcrusher
tags: How To Do A Cable Skullcrusher
instructions: Use a rope attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Face away from the machine with your elbows up and the attachment just behind your head.
Extend at the elbows until you feel a contraction in your triceps and then flex at the elbow back to the starting position.

name: Bodyweight Incline Knee Push Up
instructions: Start by placing two boxes (or one) on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the box, keeping your arms straight.
Put your knees on the floor.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the box.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Cable Bar Face Pull
instructions: Facing the pulley, pull the weight towards you while keeping your arms parallel to the ground.
Pull your hands back to both sides of your head and hold the position.
Slowly return weight to starting position. Repeat.

name: Cardio Skater
instructions: Stand, balance on right foot, left foot behind, slightly bent knees.
Jump to left, landing on left foot, right foot behind, swinging arms.
Continue leaping side-to-side, maintaining balance and speed, like a speed skater.

name: Thread The Needle Hip Over Knees
tags: Thread The Needle Hip Over Knee
How To Do A Thread The Needle Hip Over Knees
How to do Thread The Needle Hip Over Knees
instructions: Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position.
Slide your right knee up between your hands and place your right foot close to your left wrist.
Take your left leg back and lower it down to the ground, keeping your toes tucked.
Twist your torso to the right and reach your right arm underneath your left arm, threading the needle. Hold for a few breaths, then switch sides.

name: Pole Overhead Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and hold a pole overhead, using an overhand grip.
Begin the squat by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your core tight and the dumbbells balanced overhead.
Lower your body as far as you can while keeping the dumbbells overhead, then push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, making sure to keep your back straight, chest lifted, and the dumbbells stable overhead throughout the entire movement.

name: Cable Silverback Shrug
tags: How To Do A Cable Silverback Shrug
How to do Cable Silverback Shrug
instructions: Use a bar attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the bottom.
Stand up with the attachment in hand, walk a couple of steps back make sure you are standing upright and not leaning backwards.
Retract your shoulder blades and then protract to return to the starting position.

name: Band Horizontal Shrug
tags: How To Do A Band Horizontal Shrug
How to do Band Horizontal Shrug
instructions: Anchor the band at shoulder height. Take a few steps away until the band is taut.
Retract your shoulder blades straight back in schools. Then protract to the starting position.

name: Cable Seated Leg Extension
instructions: Use an ankle/wrist attachment. Pull the cable under the bench and attach it at your ankle.
Extend at the knee against the cable.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Lateral Lunge
tags: How to do Dumbbell Goblet Lateral Lunge
How To Do A Dumbbell Goblet Lateral Lunge
instructions: Engage your core by drawing your belly button towards your spine. This will help to stabilize your body. Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Take a large step to the side with your right foot, planting it firmly on the ground.
As you step, bend your right knee and lower your hips until your right thigh is parallel to the ground. Your left leg should remain straight.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position. Repeat on the opposite side by stepping out with your left foot.

name: Trap Bar Pause Deadlift
instructions: Set up inside trap bar with strong brace and neutral spine.
Lift bar slightly, pause just below knees.
Hold tension, then continue to full lockout.
Lower bar slowly back to floor.

name: Scorpion Twist Pose
tags: How to do Scorpion Twist Pose
How To Do A Scorpion Twist Pose
instructions: Begin in a downward-facing dog pose.
Slowly lift one leg up towards the ceiling, keeping your hips level and your toes pointed.
Bend your lifted leg and try to touch your toes to the back of your head.
Once you have a firm grip with your toes, slowly begin to twist your torso towards the lifted leg.
Keep your hands and feet firmly planted on the ground as you hold the pose for a few breaths. Release the pose and repeat on the other side.

name: Stationary Bike
instructions: Hold the handles and maintain a neutral spine.
Pedal at a moderate pace and try to minimise rocking back and forth.

name: Kettlebell Kneeling Bottoms Up Overhead Press
instructions: Start by taking a kneeling position and holding a kettlebell in each hand with the bottom of the kettlebell facing up.
Bring the kettlebells to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the kettlebells are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Press
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Single Arm Press
How to do Kettlebell Single Arm Press
instructions: Laying on the floor with your knees bent and feet firmly on the floor, leave one arm resting to the side of the body.
Using the other arm, hold the kettlebell at arms length directly upwards of your shoulder.
Lower your arm until your upper arm to elbow is resting on the floor.
Return to starting position.

name: Cable Bent Over Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Face away from cable, hinge at hips, and grasp handle behind head.
Keep upper arm still and extend elbow until arm is straight.
Squeeze tricep at the top, then slowly return to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Crunch
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Crunch
instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell over your clavicle.
Engage your core muscles and lift your torso off the floor until your shoulders are a few inches off the ground.
Lower yourself back down to the starting position, but avoid resting completely on the floor between reps.

name: Machine Reverse Fly
instructions: Sit on machine and press your chest into the pad.
Grab the handles with an overhand grip. Keep your elbows mostly extended.
Bring your arms backwards and squeeze your scapula together.

name: Barbell Front Squat With Straps
instructions: Measure your shoulders against the bar to make sure you're even. Wrap a pair of lifting straps around the bar. Hold the ends of the straps. Throw your shoulders under the bar. The bar should be digging into your neck slightly.
Make sure to push your elbows up to the ceiling for the entire rep. To make sure you don't get too pitched forward.
Use the squat stance you would use for a back or goblet squat. Push your hips back to initiate the squat. Break at the knees until you hit parallel depth.
Squat back up to a standing position.

name: Hamstrings Stretch Variation Four
tags: How to do Hamstrings Stretch Variation Four
How To Do A Hamstrings Stretch Variation Four
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs out in front of you.
Reach forward to try and touch your toes. Reach as far forward as you can go.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds then return to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Split Squat
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Split Squat
How to do Dumbbell Split Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Take a large step forward with one leg, and lower your body until your back knee nearly touches the ground. Your front knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle, and your back leg should be straight.
Push through the heel of your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.

name: Yogi Arm Clock
tags: How To Do A Yogi Arm Clock
How to do Yogi Arm Clock
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your arms extended and your palms pressing into the wall at shoulder height.
Slowly begin to walk your feet away from the wall, keeping your arms straight and your hands pressing into the wall.
Walk until your arms are fully extended and your body is at a 45-degree angle to the ground.
Repeat From High to Low Angles starting above the shoulder, and ending below the chest.

name: Machine Sissy Squat
instructions: Place the sissy squat pad just behind the knees and the front pad all the way up against your ankles.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Sit straight back into a squat. Then push your calves into the back of the pad and extend your knees back to the original position.

name: Revolved Head To Knee
tags: How to do Revolved Head To Knee
How To Do A Revolved Head To Knee
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and bring your heel towards your perineum.
Place your left hand on the outside of your right knee and twist your body to the right.
Reach your right hand towards your left foot and look up towards the ceiling. Hold the pose for a few breaths before switching sides.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Pullover
instructions: Lie on bench holding one kettlebell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower kettlebell in an arc behind head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull kettlebell back over chest using lats and triceps, keeping control.

name: Abdominals Stretch Variation Four
tags: How to do Abdominals Stretch Variation Four
How To Do A Abdominals Stretch Variation Four
instructions: Lay on a ball or a Bosu ball with your feet firmly planted on the floor.
Lean all the way back until you feel a stretch in your abdomen.
Crunch upwards and hold for a 1-2 count.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Machine Horizontal Sissy Leg Press
instructions: Place your feet at the bottom the platform at shoulder width. Lift your heels up.
Press against the platform and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the pad. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.

name: Cardio Box Quick Feet
instructions: Stay light on your toes and tap both feet to the ground in quick succession.
Move in a square pattern.

name: Dumbbell Leg Extension
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Leg Extension
How to do Dumbbell Leg Extension
instructions: Place a dumbbell between your feet. Lean back slightly and hold on to the bench.
Extend your knees until you feel your quads contract hard.

name: Dumbbell Service Exercise
instructions: Stand up straight and hold a dumbbell in one arm. Perform a bicep curl across your body
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder and rotate palm and elbow out.
Point the elbow towards the ceiling while the dumbbell remains just over the shoulder.
Extend your elbow to raise the dumbbell over your head. Start lowering your arm to your side as you turn the palm to face down

name: Band Straight Leg Hip Flexions
instructions: Attach a band to a fixed point.
Wrap the loose end of the band around your ankle.
Face away from the attachment point.
Raise your working leg against the resistance.

name: Plank IYTW
tags: How To Do A Plank IYTW
instructions: Start in a plank position. Hold one dumbbell.
Raise the dumbbell straight out in front of you (I), at a 45 degree angle (Y), out to the side (T), and then bend at the elbow while raising (W).
Going through IYTW counts as one rep.
Make sure to keep your hips stable. If you're unable to, try performing this exercise from the knees.

name: TRX Hamstring Curl
tags: How To Do A TRX Hamstring Curl
How to do TRX Hamstring Curl
instructions: Start by facing the TRX straps and positioning yourself in a push-up position with your hands on the ground and your feet in the TRX foot cradles.
Keeping your core engaged and body in a straight line, bend your knees and bring your heels towards your glutes.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Curtsy Deficit Lunge
instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbells in front rack, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Plate Glute Bridge to Pullover
tags: How To Do A Plate Glute Bridge to Pullover
How to do Plate Glute Bridge to Pullover
instructions: Lay flat on the ground with a plate on your chest.
Push your hips up toward the ceiling and maintain that extended position.
Extend your elbows mostly, break at the shoulder joint while maintaining hip extension and the slight bend in your elbows.
Let the plate tap the floor (or get close) and then pull the plate back into the starting position.

name: Cable Pull Through
tags: How To Do A Cable Pull Through
How to do Cable Pull Through
instructions: This exercise works best with a rope attachment but can be done with anything. The attachment should be set to the bottom of the machine.
Break at the hips while maintaining a flat back and mostly extended knees.
Push hips forward until you are back in a standing position.

name: Crosslateral Core Stabilisation Unilateral Load Kettlebell
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet hip-width apart and holding a kettlebell at one side of your body, with your palms facing your thighs.
Hing forward with a flat back and lift the kettlebell.
Hold the kettlebell at your side and make sure to not lean to one side.

name: Barbell Front Rack Deficit Lunge
instructions: Stand on a platform, barbell in front rack, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Standing Inversions Hold
instructions: Stand up straight with a relatively narrow stance.
Roll your feet out and balance.
Make sure you do not roll out excessively or you are risking re-injury.

name: Wall Supported Dorsal Flexion
instructions: Lean against a wall, raise your toes and balance on your heels for the given duration.
Maintain a good upper body form.

name: Cable Single Arm Internally Rotated High Reverse Fly
instructions: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arms. Internally rotate the shoulders.
From there, your shoulder should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

name: Kettlebell Spinal Jefferson Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding kettlebells in front with feet hip-width apart.
Slowly roll down through spine one vertebra at a time, reaching toward toes.
Reverse the motion, rolling up through spine until standing tall again.

name: Plate Staggered Waiters Bow
instructions: Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

name: Kettlebell Thruster
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Bring the kettlebells to your shoulders, with your palms facing inward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, dip your knees slightly and then quickly extend them as you press the kettlebells upwards.
As you press the kettlebells upwards, also push your hips forward to help generate additional power.
Slowly lower the kettlebells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Elevated Pike Press
tags: How To Do A Elevated Pike Press
How to do Elevated Pike Press
instructions: Use a bench or an object to elevate your feet.
Lower your head towards the floor by bending your elbows
Push through your hands and return to the starting pike position.
Repeat

name: Ez Bar Front Raise
instructions: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the barbell. Raise your arms until your fists are around eye level.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.

name: Dumbbell Plank Pullthrough
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Plank Pullthrough
How to do Dumbbell Plank Pullthrough
instructions: Get into a plank position. Either from your knees or toes.
Start with the DB by your right hand. Reach with your left and pull the dumbbell to your left arm. Then repeat with the right.

name: Seated Arm Stretch
tags: How To Do A Seated Arm Stretch
How to do Seated Arm Stretch
instructions: Sit cross-legged on the floor.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, palms facing forward.
Cross your right arm over your left arm and interlace your fingers.
Pull your hands away from your body and hold for a few breaths, then release and repeat with the opposite arm on top.

name: Abdominals Stretch Variation One
tags: How to do Abdominals Stretch Variation One
How To Do A Abdominals Stretch Variation One
instructions: Lay on your stomach on the floor with your forearms flat on the ground.
Extend your elbows and push your upper body upwards.
Push your upper body upwards until you feel a stretch in your abs, then return to the starting position and repeat.

name: Medicine Ball Chest Press Slam
tags: How To Do A Chest Press Slam
How to do Chest Press Slam
instructions: Hold medicine ball at chest, feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend arms forward, slamming ball to the ground.
Catch the ball on the rebound and repeat for reps.

name: Forward Arm Circle
instructions: Hold your arms out to your sides.
Rotate your arms forward in small circles.

name: Kettlebell Lateral Lunge
instructions: Hold kettlebells in front of you.
Step sideways, lunge down and let the kettlebells land between your legs.
Push off, return to start. Repeat.

name: Forward Lunges
tags: How To Do A Forward Lunges
instructions: Step forward with one leg.
Lower your body until your rear knee nearly touches the ground.
Ensure you remain upright, and your front knee stay above the front foot.
Push off the floor with your front foot until you return to the starting position. Switch legs.

name: Treadmill Jog
instructions: Get the treadmill up to a comfortable speed where you are doing a light jog.

name: Cable Single Arm Rear Delt Row
instructions: Use a handle attachment, grab with an overhand grip and take a position with the cable crossing your body.
Pull your elbows back while flaring your elbows outward.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Reverse Lunge
instructions: Hold two kettlebells by your side.
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push back up and switch legs, alternating each rep.

name: Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat
tags: How to do Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat
How To Do A Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Grab a stick of some sort or hold onto something stable (rack, bench).
Grab a box that is knee height or slightly lower.
Hold the stick in your right arm and put your right leg on the box.
Begin your squat by breaking at the knees. Get your knee close to the floor or all the way to the floor. Make sure to keep your chest tall.

name: Band Wood Chopper
tags: How To Do A Band Wood Chopper
How to do Band Wood Chopper
instructions: Anchor band at shoulder height. Stand sideways, feet shoulder-width, slight knee bend.
Grip band with both hands, arms extended.
Pull across body, rotating torso.

name: Dumbbell Incline Skullover
instructions: Lay flat on an incline bench with two dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling.
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arms to the sides of your head.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.

name: Cable Twisting Curl
tags: How to do Cable Twisting Curl
How To Do A Cable Twisting Curl
instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Start with a neutral grip. Flex at the elbow. While flexing twist your palm. When you hit the top of the movement your palm should be facing upward.

name: Reverse Prayer
tags: How To Do A Reverse Prayer
instructions: Start seated or standing with your arms at your sides.
Bring your hands behind your back and interlace your fingers with your palms facing up.
Inhale and draw your shoulder blades together, lifting your chest.
Exhale and gently press your hands down towards the floor as you continue to lift your chest.

name: Dumbbell Weighted Chin Ups
instructions: Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you). Use a dip belt and the let the weight hang between your legs.
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

name: Landmine Curtsy Lunge
tags: How To Do A Landmine Curtsy Lunge
How to do Landmine Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Stand facing the barbell while holding the end of the bar at your side with one hand.

With the leg on the same side of your body as the barbell, lunge backward and across your body at a 45 degree angle while keeping your weight on your front heel to lower your back knee gently to the ground.
Drive through your front heel as you step back to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Landmine Single Leg Glute Bridge
tags: How To Do A Landmine Single Leg Glute Bridge
How to do Landmine Single Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Setup a landmine with your back on a box.
Lay the end of the bar over your hip.
Push your hips toward the ceiling until you feel a contraction, then bring your hips back toward the floor.

name: Plate Situp
tags: How To Do A Plate Situp
instructions: Start by lying on your back on a mat with your legs bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a weight plate over your head with both hands, making sure to keep your arms straight.
Engage your core and use your abdominal muscles to sit up, keeping the weight plate towards the ceiling.

name: Medicine Ball Plank
instructions: Place forearms on medicine ball, extend legs.
Maintain straight body position for desired time.

name: Machine Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your height. Place your elbows on the pad, grab the handles. The vertical pad should be resting on your lower back.
Raise your heels toward the ceiling.

name: Gluteator
instructions: Sit on the seat upright with your knees placed on the pads and your feet on the foot pads.
Push your legs outwards and backwards and flex your glutes.

name: Bodyweight Underhand Inverted Row
instructions: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with an underhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

name: Weighted Pull Ups
instructions: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended. Weight hanging between your legs.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.

name: Band Seated Pulldown
instructions: Sit facing anchor with band overhead and arms extended.
Pull elbows down toward ribs while keeping chest lifted.
Squeeze lats at the bottom, then return slowly to full stretch.

name: Butt Kick
instructions: Stand tall, jog in place, bringing heels toward your glutes.
Keep your core tight and swing arms naturally.
Alternate legs quickly, maintaining a steady rhythm.

name: Standing Doming
instructions: From the standing position press the big toe into the ground till you feel the inside part of your foot raise off the ground
The arch of your foot should now look more pronounced.
Do not roll your foot out to lift the inside part of your foot.

name: Smith Machine Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Maintain the natural arch in your back and put the bar on your back. Squeezing your shoulder blades and raise your chest.
Grip the bar across your shoulders and support it on your upper back. Unwrack the smith machine by straightening your legs.
Bend your knees as you lower the weight without altering the form of your back until your hips are below your knees.
Raise the bar back to starting position, lift with your legs and exhale at the top.

name: Cable Bench Press
instructions: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set to shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

name: Medicine Ball Partner Side Toss
tags: How to do Partner Side Toss
How To Do A Partner Side Toss
instructions: Stand facing partner, side by side.
Toss medicine ball to partner's side.
Catch and repeat toss on other side.

name: Barbell Behind The Neck Press
instructions: Grip bar slightly wider than shoulders and rest it across upper traps.
Brace core, press bar upward until arms are fully extended overhead.
Lower bar slowly behind head under control and repeat.

name: Cable Behind The Back Lateral Raise
instructions: Place the cable all the way at the bottom and stand with the cable crossing behind your body.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, lift your arm until it's parallel with the floor.

name: Barbell Step Up Knee Drive
instructions: Hold barbell on upper back and place one foot firmly on platform.
Drive through front heel to step up, keeping torso tall and balanced.
Lift trailing knee high at the top, then step down slowly with control.

name: Medicine Ball Clean And Press Slam
tags: How To Do A Clean And Press Slam
How to do Clean And Press Slam
instructions: Hold the medicine ball with an overhand grip.
Lift the ball explosively, clean it to shoulder height.
Press the ball overhead, then slam it to the ground.

name: Sphinx Pose
tags: How To Do A Sphinx Pose
instructions: Start by lying down on your stomach on a yoga mat or a comfortable surface.
Place your elbows underneath your shoulders, keeping your forearms parallel to each other.
Press your palms and forearms firmly into the ground to lift your chest up, while keeping your hips and legs relaxed.
Make sure your shoulders are relaxed and away from your ears. Gently roll your shoulder blades down and back to open up your chest.
Lengthen your spine by lifting the crown of your head towards the ceiling, while keeping your chin tucked in slightly.

name: Mini Band Laying Hip Abduction
instructions: Loop band above knees, lie on side legs straight.
Lift top leg upward without rotating hips.
Lower slowly, keeping tension on band.

name: Kettlebell Pullover
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Pullover
instructions: Rest your upper back on the bench and place soles of your feet firmly on the floor keeping torso and thighs suspended and parallel to the floor.
Hold the kettlebell with both hands above your chest, keeping your arms straight.
Keeping your arms straight, move the kettlebell in the direction of your head until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Return to starting to position and repeat.

name: Barbell Meadows Row
tags: How To Do A Barbell Meadows Row
How to do Barbell Meadows Row
instructions: Position a barbell in a landmine or corner of a room and stand facing sideways with a staggered stance and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the end of the barbell with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the ground.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together as you row the weight up.
*Named after the late John Meadows

name: TRX Forearm Side Plank
tags: How To Do A TRX Forearm Side Plank
How to do TRX Forearm Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and your feet resting in the TRX foot cradles.
Prop yourself up on your forearm and engage your core to maintain a straight line from your head to your feet.

name: Alphabet
instructions: Sit on a box or bench
Keep one foot off the ground by pulling onto your knee, or by crossing one leg over the opposite knee.
Try to form the letters of the Alphabet with your foot.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Squat
tags: How to do Dumbbell Front Rack Squat
How To Do A Dumbbell Front Rack Squat
instructions: Place two dumbbells on your shoulders and push your elbows upward.
Push your hips back and break at the knees.
Hit parallel depth and then drive through your heels back to the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Alternating Lateral Lunge
instructions: Hold one kettlebell with one or both hands, feet hip-width apart.
Step out to one side, bending the knee.
Push off, return to center, then switch sides.

name: Plate Weighted Dip
instructions: Use a dip belt to attach a plate to yourself. Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
Lower slowly until elbows are at 90 degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

name: Machine Bent Arm Pec Fly
instructions: Adjust seat height so handles align with chest. Put your elbows on the pads.
Slowly bring pads together in front, keeping tension. Focus on squeezing chest muscles.
Return pads to starting position with controlled motion. Keep chest up throughout. Repeat for reps.

name: Traps Stretch Variation Two
tags: How To Do A Traps Stretch Variation Two
How to do Traps Stretch Variation Two
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.
Keeping your chest facing forward, turn your head 90 degrees to the left. Then return to centre point.
Repeat, turning your head in the other direction.

name: Bodyweight Pulse Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in goblet position.
Squat down to parallel depth and then halfway back up.
Stay in this short range of motion for the duration of the set.

name: Barbell Snatch Grip Deadlift
tags: How to do Barbell Snatch Grip Deadlift
How To Do A Barbell Snatch Grip Deadlift
instructions: Start by standing with your feet about hip-width apart, with your toes pointed slightly outward.
Place a barbell on the floor in front of you, with the weight plates on either side. Make sure that the bar is directly in line with your feet.
Bend down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, your hands much wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and your shoulders down as you grip the bar.
Stand up straight, lifting the barbell off the ground and pulling it toward your hips. Keep your elbows close to your body and your shoulders down as you do this.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the ground, making sure to keep your back straight and your shoulders down throughout the movement.

name: Chest Stretch Variation One
tags: How To Do A Chest Stretch Variation One
How to do Chest Stretch Variation One
instructions: Using a raised wall, place your arm at a 90 degree angle against it.
With a staggered stance, lean into the wall extending your chest.
Pause for a few seconds and then return to starting position and repeat on opposite side.

name: Bodyweight Stability Ball Hyperextension
instructions: Lie face-down on a stability ball, hips centered, feet anchored, hands behind your head.
Engage your core, lift your upper body until aligned with legs, keeping your neck neutral.
Lower your torso slowly back to the starting position, maintaining control and steady breathing.

name: Landmine Kneeling Twist
tags: How To Do A Landmine Kneeling Twist
How to do Landmine Kneeling Twist
instructions: Kneel down facing the landmine with your knees hip-width apart and your back straight. Grasp the landmine barbell with both hands, interlacing your fingers and holding it above and slightly in front of your body.

Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, twist your torso to one side, rotating your arms and the landmine along with it. Pause briefly at the end of the twist, feeling the contraction in your oblique muscles.
Slowly rotate back to the starting position, then twist to the opposite side, repeating the same motion.
Repeat both sides of the rotation for the desired number of reps.

name: Machine Standing Shrug
instructions: Grab both handles and stand upright. Make sure you keep a flat back while lifting to the starting position.
Pull your shoulder blades straight up toward the ceiling.

name: Mini Band Standing Hip Abduction
instructions: Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
Lift one leg out to side, torso upright.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Kettlebell Swing
tags: How To Do A Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell between your legs, with your knees slightly bent.
Keeping your back straight, swing the kettlebell upwards until the kettlebell is level with your chest and carefully lower.
Repeat

name: Dumbbell Cuban Press
instructions: Perform an upright row until elbows are bent at 90 degrees and arms parallel to the ground.
Rotate your shoulders, raising the dumbbells overhead. Then press overhead.

name: Stability Ball Side Crunch
instructions: Lie sideways on a stability ball, feet anchored, hands behind head, core engaged.
Crunch sideways by contracting obliques, bringing your upper body toward your hip.

name: Cable Lat Prayer
tags: How To Do A Cable Lat Prayer
How to do Cable Lat Prayer
instructions: You can use any attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ears should be between your arms.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.

name: Dumbbell Incline Chest Fly
tags: How to do Dumbbell Incline Chest Fly
How To Do A Dumbbell Incline Chest Fly
instructions: Lay on an incline bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement.
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

name: Kettlebell Front Rack Reverse Lunge (Double)
instructions: Start with kettlebell in front rack.
Step back into lunge.
Return to start position.

name: Switch Jump Mountain Climber
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands under shoulders.
Jump one foot forward, switch legs mid-air.
Alternate legs quickly, maintaining a steady plank.

name: Band Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench with band looped behind your back.
Lower hands toward chest while keeping elbows at a comfortable angle.
Press upward and squeeze chest at the top, maintaining band tension.

name: Dumbbell Elbow Side Plank
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Elbow Side Plank
How to do Dumbbell Elbow Side Plank
instructions: Take an elbow side plank position. Place a dumbbell on your hip.
Raise your hip up into position for the allotted amount of time.

name: Cable Bar Staggered Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Start with a straight bar attachment set to the bottom of the machine. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back.
Stand with a staggered stance. Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.

name: Standing Forward Bend
tags: How to do Standing Forward Bend
How To Do A Standing Forward Bend
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at your hips, reaching your hands towards the ground.
Allow your head to hang heavy and feel a stretch in the back of your legs.
Hold for a few breaths and then slowly roll up to a standing position.

name: Cardio Long Jump
instructions: Stand feet shoulder-width, knees slightly bent, arms behind you, eyes forward.
Swing arms backward, squat deeply, loading legs for explosive power.
Swing arms, explode forward, extend legs mid-air, land softly on both feet.

name: Medicine Ball Wood Chopper
tags: How To Do A Wood Chopper
instructions: Hold medicine ball with both hands and arms extended.
Swing ball diagonally across body, engaging core.

name: Box Jump
tags: How To Do A Box Jump
instructions: Stand in front of a box.
*Start with a low box if this is your first time*
Sink into a quarter of half squat and then pop your hips forward.
Try to land in the middle of the box as softly as possible to minimise impact on your joints.

name: Bodyweight Alternating Jump Lunge
instructions: Start in a standing position.
Lunge forward, switch legs mid-air.
Land and repeat.

name: Kettlebell High Incline Bench Press
instructions: Position the bench between 45 and 60 degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the kettlebells to your mid chest
Raise the kettlebells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Leg Extension
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the cushion and adjust the machine you are using so that your knees are at a 90 degree angle at the starting position.
Raise the weight by extending your knees outward, then lower your leg to the starting position. Both movements should be done in a slow, controlled motion.

name: Machine Belt Squat
instructions: Put the belt around your waist and hook the end of the belt onto the machines.
Stand up to disengage the holding mechanism. Hold the arms while you squat.
Once you've completed your set, reset the holding mechanism.

name: Lat And Shoulder External Rotation Stretch 1 Kneeling Dowel
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench, placing your elbows on with palms facing up while holding the dowel at shoulder width.
Sit your hips back onto your heels, pressing the head in between the arms.
You should feel a stretch in your lats, triceps and deep in the shoulder joint.
You can add movement (bend-extended arms) to mobilise the shoulder joint.

name: Dumbbell Feet Down Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with feet on floor, lean back slightly, holding dumbbell at chest.
Rotate torso and move dumbbell toward one side without letting feet lift.
Twist to opposite side, keeping core tight and movement controlled.

name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
How to do Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Start by sitting on a bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand placed on each leg.
From this starting position, raise your heels as high as you can by pushing up through your toes.
Slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Incline Curl
instructions: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Landmine Single Arm Chest Press
tags: How to do Landmine Single Arm Chest Press
How To Do A Landmine Single Arm Chest Press
instructions: Starting lying on your back perpendicularly to the barbell while holding the end of the bar in your hand that is further away from the landmine attachment. Your elbow should be rest on the ground at a 45 to 60 degree angle from your torso, with your wrist stacked over your elbow.
Drive the end of the bar upwards, squeezing your chest at the top of the movement. Lower the bar back down until your elbow gently touches the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of reps on one side before switching sides.

name: Ez Bar Curl
instructions: Stand tall, hold EZ bar with shoulder-width underhand grip.
Curl bar upward, keeping elbows tucked and torso stable.
Pause and squeeze biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until arms fully extended.

name: Band Bent Over Row
instructions: Stand on band with feet hip-width, holding handles with palms facing in.
Hinge at hips, keeping back flat and elbows close to ribs.
Pull handles toward torso, squeeze back, then lower slowly with control.

name: Smith Machine Guillotine Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the flat bench, grasp the bar at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Slowly lower the bar to your chest, keeping your elbows flared out.
Once you feel a stretch in your chest press the weight back up.

name: Core Stability 4 Crosslateral Limb Raise Push Up Position
instructions: Bring yourself to a strict push-up position
Maintain a toe placement roughly at shoulder width (the wider the leg stance the easier the exercise - the narrower the stance the more difficult it becomes.
Tap your opposite shoulder with your fingertips.
Do not tilt or shift your hips. Do not round or arch your back.

name: TRX Rotating Row
tags: How To Do A TRX Rotating Row
How to do TRX Rotating Row
instructions: Grab the TRX straps and lean away from the anchor point until the strap is taut.
Start with an overhand grip. Pull your elbows back and rotate your grip.
By the time your elbows reach your side, your palms should be facing upwards.

name: Seated Radial Nerve Slider
instructions: From the seated position bring your arm out to the side with the palm facing back.
Flex your wrist at the same time you are leaning your head towards your outstretched arm.
Bend your head away from the the outstretched arm while simultaneously extending the wrist.

name: Laying Ts
instructions: Lie on your front, arms outstretched to the side.
Raise head and chest off the ground.
Raise and lower your arms (flapping wings motion) by contracting and relaxing the muscles in between your shoulder blades.

name: Serratus Activation Plank
instructions: Support your weight on your forearms and toes (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.

name: Headstand
instructions: Begin on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Place your forearms on the floor and interlace your fingers.
Place the crown of your head on the floor and tuck your toes under.
Walk your feet towards your head and lift your hips up.
Straighten your legs and find your balance. Hold for several breaths and then release.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Reverse Curl
instructions: Lay on an incline bench.
Grab a dumbbell with a pronated (overhand) grip. You can do this exercise thumbless if it's more comfortable on your wrists.
Flex at the elbows until your bicep touches your forearm. Try not to let your elbow flair outward.

name: Plate Curl To Overhead Press To Tricep Extension
tags: How To Do A Plate Curl To Overhead Press To Tricep Extension
How to do Plate Curl To Overhead Press To Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the plate in front of the torso, palms facing forward.
Curl the plate up to the front of the shoulder while keeping the elbows close to the body.
Rotate the palms to face forward and press the plate overhead, locking out the arms.
Lower the plate back behind the head to the starting position of a tricep extension.
Push the plate back up overhead, then lower it back to the starting position and repeat for desired reps.

name: Single Leg Bosu Ball Balance 2
instructions: Place the supporting leg on the middle of a bosu ball.
Keep the knee of the suspended leg slightly bent.
Try to maintain your balance on the bosu ball while bouncing a tennis ball off the wall.

name: Kettlebell Superman Hold
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, kettlebell in one hand, arm fully extended, and hinge at hips.
Lift opposite leg straight behind you, forming a straight line from head to heel.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, switch sides, and repeat for a balanced kettlebell superman hold.

name: Bodyweight Pike Press
instructions: Start in a plank position. Push your hips up toward the ceiling.
Lower your head towards the floor by bending your elbows
Push through your hands and return to the starting pike position.
Repeat

name: Dumbbell Offset Squat
tags: How to do Dumbbell Offset Squat
How To Do A Dumbbell Offset Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell over one shoulder.
Initiate the squat by pushing your hips back.
Avoid doing any twisting. Try to keep your shoulders even.

name: Bodyweight Hanging L Sit
instructions: Grip bar, hang with arms extended, body straight.
Engage core, lift knees towards chest.
Hold that position for the specified amount of time.

name: Runners Lunge
tags: How To Do A Runners Lunge
instructions: Begin in Downward Facing Dog pose (Adho Mukha Svanasana).
Step your right foot forward between your hands.
Place your left knee on the ground behind you and slide it back until you feel a stretch in your left hip flexor.
Keep your hands on the ground or lift them to the sky and hold for a few breaths before repeating on the other side.

name: Bodyweight Explosive Push Up
instructions: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest, explode up.
Land softly, repeat for reps.

name: Cable Decline Bench Press
instructions: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set above height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

name: Smith Machine Drag Curl
instructions: Grab the bar with an underhand grip.
Pull your elbows straight back and let the bar drag against your upper body (or very close to it).

name: Kettlebell Windmill Bottom Hand
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart. Hold the kettlebell in your bottom hand and extend the other arm above your head.
Keeping your legs straight and the kettlebell inside your thigh, lower the kettlebell towards the ground, twisting your body towards the side of the raised arm.
Return to the starting position, tilt your pelvis forward and repeat.

name: Kettlebell Snatch (Double)
instructions: Begin with a two kettlebells between your legs, hinge at hips, then swing it upwards explosively.
As they rise, lock out arm overhead, wrist straight.
Control the descent, then repeat.

name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart, toes pointing slightly outward, and kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Bend at hips and knees, keeping back straight, and grip the kettlebell handle.
Lift the kettlebell by extending hips and knees, stand up straight, and return to the starting position.

name: Cable Archer Row
instructions: Place the cable at shoulder height.
On the same side as the working arm, step back and rotate outwards.
Pull your elbow back while flaring your elbow out.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Hip Thrust
How to do Dumbbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Place your shoulder blades against a box or bench that won't move.
Both your feet should be planted and your heels should not come off the floor. Point your toes forward.
Break at the hips. Seek the longest range of motion possible. Focus on the top end of the movement. Push your hips as high as possible on each rep.

name: Cable Pull In
tags: How to do Cable Pull In
How To Do A Cable Pull In
instructions: Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
Walk a few steps away from the cable machine. Face your body sideways.
Face your palm up toward the ceiling. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

name: Lord Of The Dance
tags: How To Do A Lord Of The Dance
How to do Lord Of The Dance
instructions: Begin by standing tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and bring your right heel towards your glute.
Reach your right arm back and grab onto the inside of your right foot or ankle.
Inhale and lift your right foot away from your glute while extending your left arm forward. Hold for 5-10 breaths before switching sides.

name: Landmine Stationary Twist
tags: How to do Landmine Stationary Twist
How To Do A Landmine Stationary Twist
instructions: Hold the end of the bar. Start with a shoulder width stance.
Bring both arms to one side and keep your elbows mostly extended.
Rotate back and forth and try to resist twisting too much.

name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
tags: How to do Dumbbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
How To Do A Dumbbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
instructions: Start by lying on your back with your knees bent and feet in a staggered position on the box.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips off the floor, making sure to keep your feet and knees pointing forward.

name: Bodyweight Superman Pull
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended straight in front of you.
Lift arms, chest, and legs off floor while squeezing glutes.
Pull elbows toward ribs, squeeze lats, then extend arms again.

name: Traps Stretch Variation Three
tags: How To Do A Traps Stretch Variation Three
How to do Traps Stretch Variation Three
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.
Nod your head forward, bringing your chin to your chest.
You will feel the stretch across your neck.

name: Smith Machine Narrow Stance Squat
instructions: Place the bar on top of your traps. Take a narrow stance.
Push your hips back and break at the knees. Push your elbows forward to keep yourself from getting pitched too far forward.
Aim to get your hamstrings to parallel with the floor.
Push your heels into the floor and squat back to a standing position.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Curtsy Deficit Lunge
instructions: Stand on a platform, dumbbell in goblet squat position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.
Stand on a platform, dumbbell in goblet squat position, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

name: Dumbbell Seated Curl
instructions: Sit tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing forward.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders, keeping elbows tight to torso.
Squeeze biceps, then lower slowly to full extension.

name: Hollow Hold
tags: How To Do A Hollow Hold
instructions: Lay flat on the ground with your arms extended over head.
Pick your upper back and your legs off the ground. Your body should be in a banana shape.
Hold in this position.

name: Machine Plate Loaded Hip Thrust
instructions: Adjust the machine for your height, sit with your back against the pad, knees bent, feet flat on the platform.
Brace your core, push through your heels, and extend your hips upwards, lifting the weight while squeezing your glutes.
Lower the weight slowly back to the starting position, ensuring controlled movement; repeat for desired reps and sets.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Supinations Pronations
instructions: Sit by a bench or table and lean your arm on it.
Hold a dumbbell/weight/lever on one end.
Rotate the wrist so the palm faces down and up in succession.

name: Medicine Ball Self Toss
tags: How To Do A Self Toss
instructions: Toss medicine ball up, catch with both hands.
Repeat toss and catch for desired reps.

name: Two Arms Cow Face Pose
tags: How to do Two Arms Cow Face Pose
How To Do A Two Arms Cow Face Pose
instructions: Begin in a comfortable seated position on your mat, with your legs crossed and your spine straight.
Extend your right arm up toward the ceiling and bend it at the elbow, bringing your right hand behind your head.
Reach your left arm behind your back and bend it at the elbow, bringing your left hand up between your shoulder blades.
Clasp your hands behind your back, trying to touch your fingertips together. If you can't quite reach, you can use a strap or towel to bridge the gap between your hands.

name: Bodyweight Deadlift
instructions: Stand up straight with a good form.
Send your hips back and start tilting the upper body.
Maintain a straight back as you aim for your toes.
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.

name: Barbell Thruster
instructions: Hold the bar in a front rack position.
Push your hips back and sink into a squat.
Push through your heels and squat back up. Use the momentum you generate at the legs to push the bar over head.
Let the bar return to the front rack position before starting the next rep.

name: Seated Lateral Line Stretch
instructions: Start from a seated position with an upright posture.
Cross your right leg over the left and raise your right arm over your head.
Lean towards your left and reach with your right arm as far to the left as possible.
Repeat on the opposite side by crossing the left leg over the right.
You can do the same exercise against a wall or by holding onto a pull-up bar.

name: Plate Pinch Grip Farmer's Carry
tags: How to do Plate Pinch Grip Farmer's Carry
How To Do A Plate Pinch Grip Farmer's Carry
instructions: Stand tall holding two plates in each hand with a pinch grip.
Walk for the desired distance or time.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Sit with hinged over position, dumbbells in hands, arms slightly bent, internally rotate shoulders.
Raise dumbbells out to sides, squeeze rear delts.
Lower weights, repeat for reps.

name: Hamstring Stretch Static Standing Single Leg
instructions: From the standing position, bring one leg slightly forward.
Raise your toes and lean over towards them.
Maintain the position.

name: Ez Bar Overhead Press
instructions: Take a roughly shoulder width grip. There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).
Pull your chin back and press the weight toward the ceiling by extending at the elbow joint and flexing at the shoulder joint.
Press until your elbows are extended and push your head forward slightly.
Return to the start position with control. Pulling your chin back to allow the bar to pass your face safely.

name: Cable Goblet Squat
tags: How to do Cable Goblet Squat
How To Do A Cable Goblet Squat
instructions: Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment .
Get your elbows directly underneath the bar, squat straight up and then walk back a few steps.
Break at your knees and hips to initiate the squat. Make sure you maintain a flat back.
Squat all the way back to a standing position.

name: Adductor Raise Side Lying Short Lever
instructions: From the side lying position, bend your upper leg and place it on a bench
Raise your hips off the ground by pressing your leg into the bench

name: Smith Machine Bodyweight Skullcrusher
instructions: Hold the smith bar and lean forward.
Keep your elbows tucked in and then flex and extend at the elbows.

name: Band Squat Hold Row
instructions: Anchor the band to a stable point.
Take a half squat position and hold there.
Perform a row while holding the squat position.

name: Medicine Ball Partner Situp Toss
tags: How to do Partner Situp Toss
How To Do A Partner Situp Toss
instructions: Lie facing partner, knees bent.
Sit up, toss medicine ball to partner.
Catch and lower down. Repeat for desired reps.

name: Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands
tags: How to do Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands
How To Do A Revolved Side Angle Pose With Prayer Hands
instructions: Begin in Warrior II pose, with your right foot forward and your left foot back.
Bring your hands together in a prayer position at your heart.
Exhale and twist your torso to the right, placing your left elbow on the outside of your right knee.
Hold for several breaths and then repeat on the other side.

name: Dumbbell Skullcrusher
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Skullcrusher
instructions: Lay flat on the floor or a bench with your fists extended to the ceiling and a neutral grip.
Break at the elbows until your fists are by your temples. Then extend your elbows and flex your triceps at the top.

name: TRX Jumping Squat
tags: How to do TRX Jumping Squat
How To Do A TRX Jumping Squat
instructions: Stand facing the TRX straps and place your feet shoulder-width apart.
Begin by lowering into a squat position by bending at the knees and hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Explosively jump up off the ground, using your arms for momentum if desired.
Land softly back in the squat position, making sure to absorb the impact with your legs.

name: Cat Pose
tags: How To Do A Cat Pose
instructions: Begin on your hands and knees with your wrists directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Inhale and arch your back, lifting your tailbone and head towards the ceiling, while lowering your belly towards the floor.
Exhale and round your spine, tucking your chin towards your chest, and bringing your tailbone towards your knees.
Repeat these movements, flowing smoothly between the two poses, for several breaths.

name: Landmine Squat
tags: How To Do A Landmine Squat
instructions: Hold the end of the bar in a goblet position.
Push your hips back and break at the knees.
Reach at least parallel with the ground before pushing through your heels back to the starting position.

name: Calf Raise 1C Bilateral Eccentric From Box
instructions: While standing on the edge of a step, shift your weight on your toes while quickly raising the heals
Hold the top position for a split second and then very slowly lower your heels below the level of the step until you start feeling a stretch in the calves
Try to avoid muscular (calf) contraction while raising the heels and then exert muscular contraction on the eccentric phase
Pause on both ends of range

name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Russian Twist
How to do Dumbbell Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor and flex your knees and hips to a 90 degree angle.
Your feet should be hovering off the ground. (If that's too hard start with heels on the floor)
Rotate your upper spine to engage your obliques.

name: Plate Full Lateral Raise
tags: How To Do A Plate Full Lateral Raise
How to do Plate Full Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall holding two plates at your side.
Lateral raise the plates to your side and continue until the plates are pointed at the ceiling.
Let your shoulder joint naturally rotate. At the bottom you should have a neutral or overhand grip. By the time the plates are overhead, your palms should be facing forward.

name: Cable Single Arm Decline Bench Chest Fly
instructions: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cable above shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbow stays in a fixed position.

name: Plate Weighted Dead Hang
instructions: Attach weight to yourself using a dip belt. Grip a pull-up bar with palms facing forward.
Hang with arms fully extended.
Hold for recommended amount of time, keeping your core engaged.

name: Landmine Seated Single Arm Overhead Press
tags: How To Do A Landmine Seated Single Arm Overhead Press
How to do Landmine Seated Single Arm Overhead Press
instructions: Sit on the ground facing the landmine with your legs spread. Hold the end of the bar in one hand in front of that shoulder with your palm facing across your body.

While keeping your torso tall and your core braced, drive the bar upwards until your arm is fully extended, leaning forward slightly for full range of motion in the shoulder joint. Lower the bar back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for desired number of reps on one side, then switch sides.

name: Slider Hamstring Curl Single Leg
instructions: Lie on your back keeping both knees bent.
Have a slider under the heel of the working leg.
Extend and bend the working lag applying gentle downwards pressure.

name: Scissor Kick
instructions: Lie on your back, hands under your buttocks or on the ground for support.
Lift legs off the ground, alternate crossing them in a scissor motion.

name: Bodyweight Plank Jack
instructions: Start in a plank position, hands under shoulders, body straight.
Jump feet wide, then back together, like a jumping jack.
Keep core tight, maintain plank form, repeat for desired time or reps.

name: Medicine Ball Chest Press Partner Toss
tags: How to do Chest Press Partner Toss
How To Do A Chest Press Partner Toss
instructions: Stand tall, partner tosses medicine ball to chest.
Catch ball and press it back to partner. Repeat.

name: Mini-Band Clamshell
instructions: Loop band above knees, lie on side knees bent.
Keep feet together, lift top knee upward.
Lower slowly without rotating hips backward.

name: Neutral Chest Press
instructions: Sit on the machine and grab the handles with a neutral grip.
Adjust the machine to get the longest range of motion possible.
Press until your elbows are not extended but not hyperextended.

name: Smith Machine Close Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground. With a narrow grip on the bar, straighten your arms
Lower the bar to your lower-mid chest
Slowly raise the bar until you've locked your elbows.

name: Seated Box Jump
tags: How To Do A Seated Box Jump
How to do Seated Box Jump
instructions: Setup two boxes. One to jump on and one to sit.
Go from a seated position and pop your hips forward forcefully.
Jump and land on the box softly.

name: Elbow Extensor Mobilisation Kneeling Lacrosse Ball
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench and place a massage ball on it.
Place your tricep (back of the arm) on the ball with the elbow bent. Try to find a tight, painful spot.
Once you have found it, apply gentle pressure on the ball.
Once you get comfortable with the pain extend and bend your arm.

name: Cobra Stretch 2
instructions: Lay on your front placing your palms under your shoulders
Keep the elbows bent and close to your body
Lift your upper body off the ground supporting your weight on your palms
Keep the hips on the ground

name: Band Press Around
instructions: Stand with band behind you and hold loop at chest height.
Press one arm forward and across your body in a sweeping arc.
Squeeze chest at full extension, then return slowly and switch sides.

name: Cable Side Bend
instructions: Set the cable at the bottom of the stack. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, grab the handle, lean away from the cable.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

name: TRX Curtsy Lunge
tags: How to do TRX Curtsy Lunge
How To Do A TRX Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Stand facing away from the anchor point, holding onto the TRX handles with both hands.
Step your left foot behind your right, crossing it behind your right leg, and lower yourself into a curtsy lunge.
Push through your right foot to return to the starting position and repeat the movement with the other leg.

name: Kettlebell Single Arm Larsen Press
instructions: Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one kettlebell above chest.
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.

name: Elliptical
instructions: Step onto the pedals, grip the handles, and start moving your feet in a natural stride.
Adjust resistance and incline for desired intensity while maintaining a steady, controlled motion.
Keep your posture upright, engage your core, and maintain a consistent pace for an effective workout.

name: Cable Rope Kneeling Oblique Crunch
instructions: Use a rope attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward then fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.

name: Kettlebell Upright Row
tags: How to do Kettlebell Upright Row
How To Do A Kettlebell Upright Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

name: Glute Bridge Eccentric Unilateral
instructions: Lie down with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Push your hips up so that your butt is elevated and your back straight.
Tense your glutes and raise your hips towards the ceiling.
Once you are at the highest point you can manage, hold the position for a few seconds, and raise one leg off the ground.
Lower slowly to the start position.

name: Cable Incline Press Around
instructions: Set cables slightly below shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Press arm forward and upward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

name: Band Leg Extension
tags: How To Do A Band Leg Extension
How to do Band Leg Extension
instructions: Anchor a band to something stable and set up a bench.
Run through the band underneath the bench and loop around your feet.
Flex and extend your knees.

name: Single Leg Slider Hamstring Curl 2
instructions: Lie on your back with bent knees and heels on a slider.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back on the ground).
Press the heels into the ground to raise your hips off it.
Extend and bend the working leg.

name: Band Single Arm Row
instructions: Anchor band to a stable point.
Step back until there is no slack in the band and hold the end of the band with one hand.
Pull through the elbow straight back.

name: Cable Pallof Press
tags: How To Do A Cable Pallof Press
How to do Cable Pallof Press
instructions: Use a handle attachment, set the cable at nipple level, walk a few steps away, and face sideways.
Start with both hands on the handle and your fists against your chest.
Press the handle forward until your elbows are fully extended, then pull the handle back to your chest.

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
tags: How to do Dumbbell Chest Fly
How To Do A Dumbbell Chest Fly
instructions: Lay on a bench with two dumbbells extended in front of you.
You should have a slight bend in your elbows and maintain that bend. Your shoulder joint should do all the movement.
Bring the dumbbells out to your side. Stop the dumbbells before going behind your body.
Bring the dumbbells back together at the top.

name: Barbell Single Leg Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
instructions: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on a plate or low box and a barbell on your hips.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Elbow Plank Mountain Climber
instructions: Begin in an elbow plank position with your core engaged.
Bring your right knee towards your right elbow.
Return to plank, then switch legs quickly. Repeat.

name: Barbell Reverse Curl
tags: How to do Barbell Reverse Curl
How To Do A Barbell Reverse Curl
instructions: Take a double overhand grip that's about shoulder width. Flex your elbows while keeping your elbows tucked in. Try not to let them flare out.
Curl until your forearm presses into your bicep. Then fully extend your elbows at the bottom of each rep.

name: Single Legged Romanian Deadlifts
tags: How To Do A Single Legged Romanian Deadlifts
How to do Single Legged Romanian Deadlifts
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent and raise one leg.
Without changing the bend in your knee, bend at your hips, and lower your torso until it's almost parallel to the floor.
Tense your glutes and then bring yourself back to the starting position.

name: Mini Band Laying Glute Bridge Abduction
instructions: Loop band above knees, lie on back knees bent.
Lift hips into bridge, hold top position.
Pulse knees outward against band, controlling tension.

name: Lats Stretch Variation Three
tags: How To Do A Lats Stretch Variation Three
How to do Lats Stretch Variation Three
instructions: Find a wall to lean against, lay your tricep against the wall with your hand behind your back.
Slowly lean into the wall.
Return to starting position, then switch sides.

name: Seated Forward Bend
tags: How to do Seated Forward Bend
How To Do A Seated Forward Bend
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
