Lean forward, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged. Your body should form a slight diagonal line from your ankles to your head.
Slowly bring your arms towards each other, in front of your chest, while keeping your core engaged and your body in a stable position.

name: Deadlift Bounces Stretch
instructions: Stand up straight with a good form.
Send your hips back and start tilting the upper body.
Maintain a straight back as you aim for your toes.
Your range depends on your hamstring flexibility.

name: Cable Standing High To Low Wood Chopper
instructions: Stand sideways to cable and grasp handle with both hands overhead.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally down toward opposite hip.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

name: Jump Into Single Leg Landing
instructions: Start from the standing position. Lower your body into a semi-squatted position.
Push off the ground with two legs to perform the jump.
Land on one leg, making sure to absorb the impact by bending the knee as much as needed.

name: Kettlebell Seated Overhead Press
instructions: There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).
Sit tall and try not to arch your spine as you're pressing.
Press until your elbows are extended and push your head forward slightly.

name: Barbell Stiff Leg Deadlifts
tags: How to do Barbell Stiff Leg Deadlifts
How To Do A Barbell Stiff Leg Deadlifts
instructions: Stand with a barbell at your shins with your feet shoulder width apart.
Bend forward at your hips and keep your knees as fully extended as possible.
Grab the barbell and then extend your hips while maintaining a straight back.
From the standing position, lower the weight in a controlled manner.
You can either lower the weight to the floor or before you touch the floor, depending on your mobility.

name: Barbell Pullover
instructions: Lie flat on bench holding barbell above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower bar in an arc behind head until you feel a deep stretch.
Pull bar back over chest using lats and triceps under control.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Reverse Lunge
tags: How to do Dumbbell Goblet Reverse Lunge
How To Do A Dumbbell Goblet Reverse Lunge
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push through your right heel to return to standing, bringing your left leg back to starting position.
Repeat the movement on the other side, stepping backwards with your right leg and lowering your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground and your left knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.

name: Barbell Behind The Back 30 Degree Shrug
instructions: Hold barbell behind you with arms at a 30 degree angle with your torso.
Shrug shoulders up and slightly back toward ears, keeping elbows locked.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower under control to full stretch.

name: Barbell Banded Deadlift
instructions: Loop bands under your feet and around the barbell. Stand hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips, keep your back flat, and lower to grasp the bar.
Drive through heels, extend hips and knees, and stand tall with shoulders back.

name: Barbell Feet Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge
tags: How to do Barbell Feet Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge
How To Do A Barbell Feet Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a box, the barbell placed over your hips. Raise one leg up and off the box.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

name: Adductor Stretch Dynamic Standing Alternate
instructions: From the standing position, use a chair/bench/box for support
Transfer your weight towards one leg by bending the knee, while keeping the opposite leg straight and the foot on the ground
Feel a stretch on the inside of the thigh (adductor) of the straight leg

name: Kettlebell Alternating Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally back into a lunge.
Alternate legs, keeping your chest up and core engaged.

name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Calf Raise
How to do Dumbbell Calf Raise
instructions: Stand tall with your feet on the ground. You can put the the balls of your feet on top of a plate to extend the range of motion.
Imagine you have a string attached to your heels and pull your heels up toward the ceiling.

name: Medicine Ball Squat Reach
tags: How To Do A Squat Reach
instructions: Hold medicine ball at chest.
Squat down, reach ball to one side.
Stand up and repeat reach on other side.

name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Press
tags: How to do Dumbbell Seated Overhead Press
How To Do A Dumbbell Seated Overhead Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support. Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height with your palms forward.
Raise the dumbbells upwards and pause at the contracted position.
Lower the weights back to starting position.

name: Stability Ball Reverse Hyperextension
instructions: Lie face down on a stability ball, hands on the floor, legs extended straight.
Engage glutes and lower back, raising legs until aligned with your torso.
Slowly lower legs back down without touching the ground, maintaining core engagement. Repeat.

name: Foam Roller Quad Mobilisation
instructions: Lie on your front placing a foam roller under your thigh.
Roll up and down till you find a tight/sore spot.
Hold this position and start bending and extending your knee to mobilise the quad.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge Reach
tags: How To Do A Dumbbell Lateral Lunge Reach
How to do Dumbbell Lateral Lunge Reach
instructions: Engage your core by drawing your belly button towards your spine. This will help to stabilize your body. Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Take a large step to the side with your right foot and reach toward the floor with your single dumbbell.
As you step, bend your right knee and lower your hips until your right thigh is parallel to the ground. Your left leg should remain straight.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position. Repeat on the opposite side by stepping out with your left foot.

name: Cable High Bayesian Curl
instructions: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set to about elbow height.
Face away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Rear Delt Fly
instructions: With dumbbells in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Arch your back above your knees, and start with the weights touching in front of your chest.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.

name: Plate Superman Hold
instructions: Hold a plate in both hands.
Pull your arms and legs off the ground while and hold that position.

name: Barbell Long Landmine Row
tags: How To Do A Barbell Long Landmine Row
How to do Barbell Long Landmine Row
instructions: Position a barbell in a landmine or corner of a room and stand facing it with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the end of the barbell with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower your torso until it is almost parallel to the ground.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together as you row the weight up.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Reverse Incline Curl
instructions: Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
Take an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.
Lay off the side of a bench and place the back off your arms on the edge of your bench. Keep your hips lowered toward the floor.
Take an overhand grip. Fully extend your elbows and then flex the elbows.

name: Band Shrug
tags: How To Do A Band Shrug
instructions: Place the band under your feet. Stand upright.
Elevate your shoulder blades and then depress back to the starting position.

name: Landmine Concentration Curl
tags: How To Do A Landmine Concentration Curl
How to do Landmine Concentration Curl
instructions: Start on one knee facing the landmine, holding the end of the barbell with your hand on the side of your forward leg.
While keeping your elbow braced against the inside of your knee, curl the barbell upward towards your shoulder, then lower it back down with control.
Repeat for the desired number of reps before switching sides.

name: Landmine Kneeling Overhead Press
tags: How To Do A Landmine Kneeling Overhead Press
How to do Landmine Kneeling Overhead Press
instructions: Start kneeling in front of the landmine, facing towards it, with your knees hip-width apart and your back straight while holding the end of the bar in both hands in front of your chest.

Push the landmine up overhead by fully extending your arms until the weight is directly over your head. Pause briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the landmine back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

name: Stability Ball Sissy Squat
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, stability ball behind your back against a wall.
Lean back onto the ball, bend knees forward, lowering slowly while keeping hips extended.
Push through toes, straighten legs, and return to standing while maintaining balance and control.

name: Kettlebell Floor Fly
instructions: Lie on your back holding kettlebells above chest with slight elbow bend.
Lower arms out wide until elbows lightly touch the floor.
Bring kettlebells back together over chest, squeezing pecs at the top.

name: Smith Machine Leg Press
instructions: Place your legs on the bar with your feet at shoulder width.
Release the weight and extend your legs fully, without locking your knees.
Lower the weight until your legs are at a 90° angle (but DO NOT allow your butt and lower back to rise off of the floor. This will put your lower back in a rounded position, which is very dangerous.)
Raise the weight back to starting position.

name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Push Up Position
instructions: Get yourself in the pushup position.
Straighten your knees and try to push one heel down towards the ground.
Cross your other leg over the top to apply extra pressure to the stretch.

name: Kettlebell Assisted Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Grab a stick of some sort or hold onto something stable (rack, bench).
Grab a box that is knee height or slightly lower.
Hold the stick in your right arm, kettlebell in the other and put your right leg on the box.
Begin your squat by breaking at the knees. Get your knee close to the floor or all the way to the floor. Make sure to keep your chest tall.

name: Lumbar Rotation 5
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the feet flat on the ground.
Drop your knees towards one side and add a kick at the end of range.
To increase the intensity of the stretch you can reach up with your arms.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Alternating Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at your chest, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally back into a lunge.
Alternate legs, keeping your chest up and core engaged.

name: Bosu Ball Offset Pushup
tags: How To Do A Offset Pushup
instructions: Place one hand on Bosu, other on the floor.
Lower chest to the ground, keeping the body straight.
Push back up to the starting position.

name: Elbow Side Plank
tags: How to do Elbow Side Plank
How To Do A Elbow Side Plank
instructions: Press your elbow into the floor.
Pick your hips up off the ground and maintain this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you don't let your chest fall forward or backward.

name: Dumbbell Front Rack Stability Ball Wall Squat
instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall at about hip height.
Hold two dumbbells in front rack position.
Break at the hips and knees until you hit parallel or just below, then squat back up.

name: Barbell Deadlift
tags: How To Do A Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your mid-foot under the bar and grip the bar with your hands, about a shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees, then lift the bar by straightening your back. It is important to keep your back straight.
Stand to your full height and hold.
Lower the bar to the floor by bending your knees and keeping your back straight.

name: Kettlebell Silverback Shrug
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hold one kettlebell in each hand at your sides, and lean forward.
Lift your shoulders backward while keeping arms straight.
Lower shoulders back down, repeat for desired reps.
